title: Judges 4:4
text: And Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lapidoth, judged Israel at that time.

title: Judges 4:5
text: And she lived under the palm tree of Deborah between Ramah and Bethel in mount Ephraim. And the sons of Israel came up to her for judgment.

title: Judges 4:6
text: And she sent and called for Barak the son of Abinoam out of Kedesh in Naphtali, and said to him, Has not the LORD God of Israel commanded, saying, Go and draw toward mount Tabor, and take with you ten thousand men of the sons of Naphtali and of the sons of Zebulun?

title: Judges 4:7
text: And I will draw Sisera to you, the captain of Jabin's army, at the river Kishon, together with his chariots and his multitude. And I will deliver him into your hands.

title: Judges 4:8
text: And Barak said to her, If you will go with me, then I will go. But if you will not go with me, I will not go.

title: Judges 4:9
text: And she said, I will surely go with you. But the journey that you take shall not be for your honor, for the LORD shall sell Sisera into the hand of a woman. And Deborah arose, and went with Barak to Kedesh.

title: Judges 4:10
text: And Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali to Kedesh. And he went up with ten thousand men at his feet. And Deborah went up with him.

title: Judges 4:11
text: And Heber the Kenite, of the sons of Hobab the father-in-law of Moses, had separated himself from the Kenites and pitched his tent toward the plain of Zaanaim, near Kedesh.

title: Judges 4:12
text: And they told Sisera that Barak the son of Abinoam had gone up to Mount Tabor.

title: Judges 4:13
text: And Sisera gathered all his chariots, nine hundred chariots of iron, and all the people with him, from Harosheth of the nations to the river of Kishon.

title: Judges 4:14
text: And Deborah said to Barak, Up! For this [is] the day in which the LORD has delivered Sisera into your hand. Has not the LORD gone out before you? So Barak went down from Mount Tabor, and ten thousand men after him.

title: Judges 4:15
text: And the LORD struck Sisera, and all the chariots, and all the army, with the edge of the sword in front of Barak, so that Sisera got down from the chariot and fled on his feet.

title: Judges 4:16
text: But Barak pursued the chariots and after the army, to Harosheth of the nations. And all the army of Sisera fell by the edge of the sword. There was not a man left.

title: Judges 4:17
text: And Sisera fled on his feet to the tent of Jael, the wife of Heber the Kenite. For [there was] peace between Jabin the king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite.

title: Judges 4:18
text: And Jael went out to meet Sisera, and said to him, Turn in my lord, turn in to me. Do not fear. When he had turned in to her into the tent, she covered him with a rug.

title: Judges 4:19
text: And he said to her, Please give me a little water to drink, for I am thirsty. And she opened a skin of milk and gave him a drink, and covered him.

title: Judges 4:20
text: Again he said to her, Stand [in] the door of the tent, and it shall be when any man comes asking of you, saying, Is there any man here? You shall say, No.

title: Judges 4:21
text: Then Jael, Heber's wife, took a peg of the tent and put a hammer in her hand, and went softly to him, and struck the peg into his temple, and beat it into the ground. For he was fast asleep and weary. So he died.

title: Judges 4:22
text: And behold, as Barak followed Sisera, Jael came out to meet him and said to him, Come and I will show you the man whom you seek. And when he came into her tent, behold, Sisera lay dead, and the peg was in his temple.

title: Judges 4:23
text: And on that day God subdued Jabin the king of Canaan before the sons of Israel.

title: Judges 4:24
text: And the hand of the sons of Israel went on, and pressed hard against Jabin the king of Canaan, until they had destroyed Jabin king of Canaan.

title: Judges 5:1
text: Then Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam sang on that day, saying,

title: Judges 5:2
text: Praise the LORD for the avenging of Israel, when the people willingly offered themselves.

title: Judges 5:3
text: Hear, O, kings. Give ear, O, princes. I, [even] I, will sing to the LORD, I will sing to the LORD God of Israel.

title: Judges 5:4
text: LORD, when You went out of Seir, when You marched out of the field of Edom, the earth trembled and the heavens dropped, the clouds also dropped water.

title: Judges 5:5
text: The mountains quaked from before the LORD, even that Sinai from before the LORD God of Israel.

title: Judges 5:6
text: In the days of Shamgar the son of Anath, in the days of Jael, the highways were empty, and the travelers walked through crooked ways.

title: Judges 5:7
text: The leaders ceased in Israel, they ceased until I, Deborah, arose; until I arose, a mother in Israel.

title: Judges 5:8
text: They chose new gods; then war [was] in the gates. Was there a shield or spear seen among forty thousand in Israel?

title: Judges 5:9
text: My heart [is] toward the lawgivers of Israel who offered themselves willingly among the people. Bless the LORD.

title: Judges 5:10
text: Speak, you who ride on white asses, you who sit in judgment and walk by the way.

title: Judges 5:11
text: [Louder] than the voice of the dividers between the watering places, there shall they tell again the righteous acts of the LORD, the righteous acts of His leaders in Israel. Then shall the people of the LORD go down to the gates.

title: Judges 5:12
text: Awake, awake, Deborah. Awake, awake, sing a song. Arise, Barak, lead your captivity captive, son of Abinoam.

title: Judges 5:13
text: Then He [made me] tread on the remnant of the nobles among the people. The LORD made me have dominion over the mighty.

title: Judges 5:14
text: Out of Ephraim there was a root of them [against] Amalek; after you, Benjamin, with your peoples. Out of Machir came down commanders, and out of Zebulun came they who handle the pen of the writer.

title: Judges 5:15
text: And the rulers of Issachar [were] with Deborah, even Issachar, and also Barak. He was sent on foot into the valley. There were great thoughts of heart for the divisions of Reuben.

title: Judges 5:16
text: Why did you stay among the sheepfolds to hear the bleating of the flocks? For in the divisions of Reuben there were great searchings of heart.

title: Judges 5:17
text: Gilead stayed beyond Jordan. And why did Dan remain in ships? Asher continued on the seashore and remained in his havens.

title: Judges 5:18
text: Zebulun and Naphtali were a people who put their lives in danger of death in the high places of the field.

title: Judges 5:19
text: Kings came and fought. Then the kings of Canaan fought in Taanach by the waters of Megiddo. They took no gain of silver.

title: Judges 5:20
text: They fought from heaven; the stars in their courses fought against Sisera.

title: Judges 5:21
text: The river of Kishon swept them away, that ancient river, the river Kishon. O my soul, you trampled in strength.

title: Judges 5:22
text: Then did the hooves of horses beat, from the galloping, the galloping of their mighty ones.

title: Judges 5:23
text: Curse Meroz, said the Angel of the LORD; curse the people of it bitterly, because they did not come to the help of the LORD, to the help of the LORD against the mighty.

title: Judges 5:24
text: Blessed among women shall Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite be. She shall be blessed above women in the tent.

title: Judges 5:25
text: He asked for water, and she gave [him] milk. She brought forth butter in a lordly dish.

title: Judges 5:26
text: She put her hand to the peg, and her right hand to the workman's hammer; she hammered Sisera; she smashed his head, she pierced and struck through his temple.

title: Judges 5:27
text: He bowed between her feet, he fell, he lay down. Between her feet he bowed; he fell. Where he bowed, there he fell down dead.

title: Judges 5:28
text: The mother of Sisera looked out a window, and cried through the lattice, Why is his chariot so long in coming? Why do the wheels of his chariot wait?

title: Judges 5:29
text: Her wise ladies answered her, yea, she returned answer to herself,

title: Judges 5:30
text: Do they not find and divide the spoil? A womb, two wombs to a man's head, to Sisera a prize of dyed garments, a prize of embroidered dyed [garments] for the necks of those that take the spoil.

title: Judges 5:31
text: So let all Your enemies perish, O LORD. But let them that love Him be like the sun when He goes forth in His might. And the land had rest forty years.

title: Judges 6:1
text: And the sons of Israel did evil in the sight of the LORD. And the LORD delivered them into the hand of Midian seven years.

title: Judges 6:2
text: And the hand of Midian was strong against Israel. Before the faces of Midian, the sons of Israel made themselves dens in the mountains, and caves and strongholds.

title: Judges 6:3
text: And so it was, when Israel had sown, that the Midianites came up, and the Amalekites, and the sons of the east, even they came up against them.

title: Judges 6:4
text: And they camped against them and destroyed the increase of the earth, until you come to Gaza. And they left no food for Israel, neither sheep nor ox nor ass.

title: Judges 6:5
text: For they came up with their cattle and their tents, and they came as locusts for multitude, both they and their camels were without number. And they entered into the land to destroy it.

title: Judges 6:6
text: And Israel was made very poor because of the Midianites. And the sons of Israel cried to the LORD.

title: Judges 6:7
text: And it happened, when the sons of Israel cried to the LORD because of the Midianites,

title: Judges 6:8
text: the LORD sent a man, a prophet to the sons of Israel, who said to them, So says the LORD God of Israel: I brought you up from Egypt and brought you forth out of the house of bondage.

title: Judges 6:9
text: And I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of all who oppressed you, and drove them out from before you and gave you their land.

title: Judges 6:10
text: And I said to you, I [am] the LORD your God. Do not fear the gods of the Amorites in whose land you live. But you have not obeyed My voice.

title: Judges 6:11
text: And the Angel of the LORD came and sat under an oak which was in Ophrah, which [belonged] to Joash the Abiezrite. And his son Gideon threshed wheat by the winepress, to hide it from the Midianites.

title: Judges 6:12
text: And the Angel of the LORD appeared to him, and said to him, The LORD [is] with you, mighty warrior.

title: Judges 6:13
text: And Gideon said to Him, O, my Lord, if the LORD is with us, why then has all this happened to us? And where are all His miracles which our fathers told us of, saying, Did not the LORD bring us up from Egypt? But now the LORD has forsaken us, and delivered us into the hands of the Midianites.

title: Judges 6:14
text: And the LORD looked upon him and said, Go in your might, and you shall save Israel from the hand of the Midianites. Have I not sent you?

title: Judges 6:15
text: And he said to him, O, my Lord, with what shall I save Israel? Behold, my family [is] poor in Manasseh, and I am the least in my father's house.

title: Judges 6:16
text: And the LORD said to him, Surely, I will be with you, and you shall strike the Midianites as one man.

title: Judges 6:17
text: And he said to Him, If now I have found grace in Your sight, then show me a sign that You talk with me.

title: Judges 6:18
text: Do not depart from here, I pray, until I come to You, and bring forth my food offering and set it before You. And He said, I will stay until you come again.

title: Judges 6:19
text: And Gideon went in and made ready a kid and unleavened [cakes] of an ephah of flour. He put the flesh in a basket, and he put the broth in a pot, and brought it out to Him to the oak, and offered [it].

title: Judges 6:20
text: And the Angel of God said to him, Take the flesh and the unleavened [cakes] and lay on this rock, and pour out the broth. And he did so.

title: Judges 6:21
text: Then the Angel of the LORD put forth the end of the staff that was in His hand and touched the flesh and the unleavened [cakes]. And there rose up fire out of the rock and burned up the flesh and the unleavened [cakes]. Then the Angel of the LORD went away out of his sight.

title: Judges 6:22
text: And when Gideon saw that He was the Angel of the LORD, Gideon said, Alas, O Lord God! Because I have seen the Angel of the LORD face to face.

title: Judges 6:23
text: And the LORD said to him, Peace to you. Do not fear. You shall not die.

title: Judges 6:24
text: Then Gideon built an altar there to the LORD, and called it Jehovah-shalom. It [is] yet in Ophrah of the Abiezrites to this day.

title: Judges 6:25
text: And it happened on that night the LORD said to him, Take your father's young bull, even the second bull of seven years, and throw down the altar of Baal which your father [has], and cut down the pillar by it.

title: Judges 6:26
text: And build an altar to the LORD your God upon the top of this rock, in an orderly manner, and take the second bull and offer a burnt sacrifice with the wood of the grove which you shall cut down.

title: Judges 6:27
text: Then Gideon took ten men of his servants, and did as the LORD had said to him. And so it was, because he feared his father's household and the men of the city, that he could not do it by day. So he did it by night.

title: Judges 6:28
text: And when the men of the city arose early in the morning, behold, the altar of Baal was cast down, and the pillar which was by it was cut down, and the second bull had been offered upon the altar that was built.

title: Judges 6:29
text: And they said to one another, Who has done this thing? And when they inquired and asked, they said, Gideon the son of Joash has done this thing.

title: Judges 6:30
text: Then the men of the city said to Joash, Bring out your son so that he may die (because he had cast down the altar of Baal, and because he had cut down the pillar by it).

title: Judges 6:31
text: And Joash said to all that stood against him, Will you plead for Baal? Will you save him? He who contends for him shall be killed by the morning. If he is a god, let him plead for himself, because one has cast down his altar.

title: Judges 6:32
text: And on that day he called him Jerubbaal, saying, Let Baal contend against him because he has thrown down his altar.

title: Judges 6:33
text: Then all the Midianites and the Amalekites, and the sons of the east were gathered together, and went over and pitched in the valley of Jezreel.

title: Judges 6:34
text: But the spirit of the LORD came to Gideon, and he blew a ram's horn. And he called the Abiezrites after him.

title: Judges 6:35
text: And he sent messengers throughout all Manasseh, who also were gathered after him. And he sent messengers to Asher, and to Zebulun, and to Naphtali. And they came up to meet them.

title: Judges 6:36
text: And Gideon said to God, If You will save Israel by my hand, as You have said,

title: Judges 6:37
text: Behold, I will put a fleece of wool in the grain-floor. And if the dew is on the fleece only, and dry upon all the ground, then I shall know that You will save Israel by my hand, as You have said.

title: Judges 6:38
text: And it was so. For he rose up early in the morning and gathered the fleece together, and wrung the dew out of the fleece, a bowl full of water.

title: Judges 6:39
text: And Gideon said to God, Let not Your anger be hot against me, and I will speak but this once. I pray You, let me test but this once with the fleece. Let it now be dry only upon the fleece, and upon all the ground let there be dew.

title: Judges 6:40
text: And God did so that night. For it was dry upon the fleece only, and there was dew on all the ground.

title: Judges 7:1
text: And Jerubbaal (he [is] Gideon) and all the people that were with him, rose up early and pitched beside the well of Harod, so that the army of the Midianites was on the north side of them, by the hill of Moreh, in the valley.

title: Judges 7:2
text: And the LORD said to Gideon, The people with you [are] too many for Me to give the Midianites into their hands, lest Israel boast themselves against Me, saying, My own hand has saved me.

title: Judges 7:3
text: Now, therefore, speak in the ears of the people, saying, Whoever is fearful and afraid, let him return and go away early from Mount Gilead. And twenty-two thousand of the people returned. And there remained ten thousand.

title: Judges 7:4
text: And the LORD said to Gideon, The people are still [too] many. Bring them down to the water, and I will separate them for you there. It shall be [that of] whom I say to you, This shall go with you, the same shall go with you. And of whomever I say to you, This shall not go with you, the same shall not go.

title: Judges 7:5
text: And he brought down the people to the water. And the LORD said to Gideon, Everyone who laps the water with his tongue, as a dog laps, you shall set him apart; also everyone who bows down upon his knees to drink.

title: Judges 7:6
text: And the number of them who lapped, putting their hand to their mouth, [was] three hundred men. But all the rest of the people bowed down upon their knees to drink water.

title: Judges 7:7
text: And the LORD said to Gideon, I will save you by the three hundred men who lapped, and will deliver the Midianites into your hand. And let all the other people go, each man to his place.

title: Judges 7:8
text: And the people took provisions in their hand, and their ram's horns. And he sent away all the rest of Israel, each man to his tent, and kept those three hundred men. And the army of Midian was below him in the valley.

title: Judges 7:9
text: And it happened on that night, the LORD said to him, Arise, go down to the army, for I have delivered it into your hand.

title: Judges 7:10
text: But if you fear to go down, go with Phurah your servant down to the army.

title: Judges 7:11
text: And you shall hear what they shall say. And afterward your hands shall be strengthened to go down to the army. Then he went down with Phurah his servant to the edge of the ranks in the army.

title: Judges 7:12
text: And the Midianites and the Amalekites, and all the sons of the east lay along in the valley like locusts for multitude, and their camels without number, like the sand by the seaside for multitude.

title: Judges 7:13
text: And when Gideon had come, behold, a man told a dream to his fellow, and said, Behold, I dreamed a dream, and lo, a cake of barley bread tumbled into the host of Midian, and came to a tent, and struck it so that it fell, and overturned it, so that the tent lay along.

title: Judges 7:14
text: And his fellow answered and said, This is nothing else except the sword of Gideon the son of Joash, a man of Israel. For into his hand God has delivered Midian and all the army.

title: Judges 7:15
text: And it happened, when Gideon heard the telling of the dream and the meaning of it, he worshiped. And [he] returned to the army of Israel, and said, Arise! For the LORD has delivered the host of Midian into your hand.

title: Judges 7:16
text: And he divided the three hundred men into three companies. And he put a ram's horn in every man's hand, with empty pitchers, and torches inside the pitchers.

title: Judges 7:17
text: And he said to them, Look on me, and do likewise. And, behold, when I come to the edge of the camp, it shall be, as I do, so you shall do.

title: Judges 7:18
text: When I blow with a ram's horn, I and all who are with me, then you blow the ram's horns also on every side of all the camp, and shout, For Jehovah and for Gideon!

title: Judges 7:19
text: So Gideon and the hundred men with him came to the edge of the camp in the beginning of the middle watch. And they had but newly set the watch. And they blew the ram's horns and broke the pitchers that were in their hands.

title: Judges 7:20
text: And the three companies blew the ram's horns and broke the pitchers and held the torches in their left hands and the ram's horns in their right hands to blow. And they cried, A sword for Jehovah and for Gideon!

title: Judges 7:21
text: And they stood, each man in his place, all around the camp. And all the army ran, and cried, and fled.

title: Judges 7:22
text: And the three hundred blew the ram's horns. And the LORD set every man's sword against his fellow, even throughout all the army. And the army fled to Beth-shittah in Zererath, to the border of Abel-meholah, to Tabbath.

title: Judges 7:23
text: And the men of Israel were called out of Naphtali, and out of Asher, and out of all Manasseh, and ran after the Midianites.

title: Judges 7:24
text: And Gideon sent messengers throughout all mount Ephraim, saying, Come down against the Midianites, and take the waters to Beth-barah and Jordan before them. Then all the men of Ephraim gathered themselves. And they captured the waters to Beth-barah and Jordan.

title: Judges 7:25
text: Then they took two princes of the Midianites, Oreb and Zeeb. And they killed Oreb upon the rock Oreb, and they killed Zeeb at the winepress of Zeeb. And they pursued Midian and brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon on the other side Jordan.

title: Judges 8:1
text: And the men of Ephraim said to him, What [is] this thing you have done to us, not to call us when you went to fight with the Midianites? And they rebuked him sharply.

title: Judges 8:2
text: And he said to them, What have I done now in comparison to you? [Is] not the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abiezer?

title: Judges 8:3
text: God has delivered into your hands the princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb. And what was I able to do in comparison to you? Then their spirits toward him went away when he had said that.

title: Judges 8:4
text: And Gideon came to Jordan, crossing over, he and the three hundred men with him, faint, yet pursuing them.

title: Judges 8:5
text: And he said to the men of Succoth, I pray you, give loaves of bread to the people who follow me. For they are tired, and I [am] chasing after Zebah and Zalmunna, kings of Midian.

title: Judges 8:6
text: And the rulers of Succoth said, [Are] the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in your hand, so that we should give bread to your army?

title: Judges 8:7
text: And Gideon said, Therefore, when the LORD has delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into my hand, then I will tear your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers.

title: Judges 8:8
text: And he went up from there to Penuel, and spoke to them likewise. And the men of Penuel answered him like the men of Succoth had answered.

title: Judges 8:9
text: And he spoke also to the men of Penuel, saying, When I come again in peace, I will break down this tower.

title: Judges 8:10
text: And Zebah and Zalmunna [were] in Karkor, and their armies with them, about fifteen thousand, all who were left of all the armies of the sons of the east. For a hundred and twenty thousand men that drew sword fell.

title: Judges 8:11
text: And Gideon went up by the way of those who lived in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and struck the army. For the army was at ease.

title: Judges 8:12
text: And when Zebah and Zalmunna fled, he pursued them and took the two kings of Midian, Zebah and Zalmunna, and destroyed all the army.

title: Judges 8:13
text: And Gideon the son of Joash turned back from battle before Mount Heres.

title: Judges 8:14
text: And he caught a young man of the men of Succoth and asked of him. And he described to him the rulers of Succoth, and its elders, seventy-seven men.

title: Judges 8:15
text: And he came to the men of Succoth and said, Behold, Zebah and Zalmunna, with whom you rebuked me, saying, [Are] the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in your hand so that we should give bread to your men who are weary?

title: Judges 8:16
text: And he took the elders of the city, and thorns of the wilderness and briers, and with them he taught the men of Succoth.

title: Judges 8:17
text: And he beat down the tower of Penuel, and killed the men of the city.

title: Judges 8:18
text: And he said to Zebah and Zalmunna, How were the men whom you killed in Tabor? And they answered, As you [are], so they. [Each] one resembled the sons of a king.

title: Judges 8:19
text: And he said, They were my brothers, the sons of my mother. As the LORD lives, if you had saved them alive, I would not kill you.

title: Judges 8:20
text: And he said to Jether his first-born, Up! Kill them! But the youth did not draw his sword, for he feared, because he [was] still a youth.

title: Judges 8:21
text: And Zebah and Zalmunna said, Rise and fall upon us. For as the man is, so is his strength. And Gideon arose and killed Zebah and Zalmunna, and took away the ornaments on their camels' necks.

title: Judges 8:22
text: And the men of Israel said to Gideon, Rule over us, both you and your son, and your son's son also. For you have delivered us from the hand of Midian.

title: Judges 8:23
text: And Gideon said to them, I will not rule over you, neither shall my son rule over you. The LORD shall rule over you.

title: Judges 8:24
text: And Gideon said to them, I would desire a favor of you, that each man of you would give me the earrings of his prey. (For they had golden earrings, because they [were] Ishmaelites.)

title: Judges 8:25
text: And they answered, We will gladly give. And they spread a cloth, and each man threw the earrings of his prey in it.

title: Judges 8:26
text: And the weight of the golden earrings which he asked for was seventeen hundred of gold, besides ornaments, and pendants, and purple clothing that was on the kings of Midian, and besides the chains around their camels' necks.

title: Judges 8:27
text: And Gideon made an ephod of it, and put it in his city, in Ophrah. And all Israel went there lusting after it, which thing became a snare to Gideon and to his house.

title: Judges 8:28
text: And Midian was subdued before the sons of Israel, so that they lifted up their heads no more. And the land had rest forty years in the days of Gideon.

title: Judges 8:29
text: And Jerubbaal the son of Joash went and lived in his own house.

title: Judges 8:30
text: And Gideon had seventy sons, begotten of his body. For he had many wives.

title: Judges 8:31
text: And his concubine, who was in Shechem, also bore him a son whose name he called Abimelech.

title: Judges 8:32
text: And Gideon the son of Joash died in a good old age, and was buried in the tomb of Joash his father, in Ophrah [of] the Abiezrites.

title: Judges 8:33
text: And it happened as soon as Gideon was dead, the sons of Israel turned again and went lusting after the Baals, and made Baal-berith their god.

title: Judges 8:34
text: And the sons of Israel did not remember the LORD their God, who had delivered them out of the hands of all their enemies on every side.

title: Judges 8:35
text: Neither did they show kindness to the house of Jerubbaal, Gideon, according to all the goodness which he had shown to Israel.

title: Judges 9:1
text: And Abimelech the son of Jerubbaal went to Shechem, to his mother's brothers. And he talked with them and with all the family of the house of his mother's father, saying,

title: Judges 9:2
text: I pray you, speak in the ears of all the men of Shechem: Which is better for you, either that all the sons of Jerubbaal, seventy persons, reign over you, or that one reign over you? Remember also that I [am] your bone and your flesh.

title: Judges 9:3
text: And his mother's brothers spoke of him in the ears of all the men of Shechem with all these words. And their hearts were bent toward Abimelech, for they said, He is our brother.

title: Judges 9:4
text: And they gave him seventy pieces of silver out of the house of Baal-berith, with which Abimelech hired worthless and reckless persons who followed him.

title: Judges 9:5
text: And he went to his father's house at Ophrah and killed his brothers the sons of Jerubbaal, seventy persons, upon one stone. But Jotham, the youngest son of Jerubbaal, was still left; for he hid himself.

title: Judges 9:6
text: And all the leaders of Shechem gathered together, and all the house of Millo. And [they] came and made Abimelech king beside the plain of the pillar in Shechem.

title: Judges 9:7
text: And when they told Jotham, he went and stood in the top of mount Gerizim. And he lifted up his voice and cried, and said to them, Listen to me, leaders of Shechem, so that God may listen to you.

title: Judges 9:8
text: The trees went forth to anoint a king over them. And they said to the olive tree, Reign over us.

title: Judges 9:9
text: But the olive tree said to them, Should I leave my fatness with which they honor God and man by me, and go to be promoted over the trees?

title: Judges 9:10
text: And the trees said to the fig tree, You come and reign over us.

title: Judges 9:11
text: But the fig tree said to them, Should I forsake my sweetness and my good fruit, and go to be promoted over the trees?

title: Judges 9:12
text: Then the trees said to the vine, You come and reign over us.

title: Judges 9:13
text: And the vine said to them, Should I leave my wine, which cheers God and man, and go to be promoted over the trees?

title: Judges 9:14
text: Then all the trees said to the bramble-bush, You come and reign over us.

title: Judges 9:15
text: And the bramble-bush said to the trees, If you truly anoint me king over you, come put your trust in my shadow. And if not, let fire come out of the bramble and burn up the cedars of Lebanon.

title: Judges 9:16
text: And now, if you have done truly and sincerely in that you have made Abimelech king, and if you have dealt well with Jerubbaal and his house, and have done to him according to what his hands did,

title: Judges 9:17
text: [in] which my father fought for you and much endangered his life, and delivered you out of the hand of Midian.

title: Judges 9:18
text: And you have risen up against my father's house today, and have killed his sons, seventy persons, upon one stone, and have made Abimelech, the son of his slave woman, king over the men of Shechem, because he [is] your brother;

title: Judges 9:19
text: if then you have dealt truly and sincerely with Jerubbaal and with his house today, rejoice in Abimelech, and let him also rejoice in you.

title: Judges 9:20
text: But if not, let fire come out from Abimelech and burn up the men of Shechem and the house of Millo. And let fire come out from the men of Shechem, and from the house of Millo, and burn up Abimelech.

title: Judges 9:21
text: And Jotham ran away and fled, and went to Beer, and lived there for fear of Abimelech his brother.

title: Judges 9:22
text: And Abimelech reigned three years over Israel.

title: Judges 9:23
text: And God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the men of Shechem. And the men of Shechem dealt treacherously with Abimelech,

title: Judges 9:24
text: so that the cruelty to the seventy sons of Jerubbaal might come, and their blood be laid upon Abimelech their brother, who killed them, and upon the men of Shechem who helped him in the killing of his brothers.

title: Judges 9:25
text: And the men of Shechem set men lying in wait for him in the top of the mountains, and they robbed all that passed by. And it was told to Abimelech.

title: Judges 9:26
text: And Gaal the son of Ebed came with his brothers, and went over to Shechem. And the men of Shechem put their confidence in him.

title: Judges 9:27
text: And [they] went out into the fields and gathered their vineyards and trod the grapes, and made merry, and went into the house of their god, and ate and drank, and cursed Abimelech.

title: Judges 9:28
text: And Gaal the son of Ebed said, Who [is] Abimelech, and who [is] Shechem, that we should serve him? Is [he] not the son of Jerubbaal, and Zebul his officer? Serve the men of Hamor the father of Shechem: for why should we serve him?

title: Judges 9:29
text: And I wish this people were under my hand! Then I would remove Abimelech. And he said to Abimelech, Increase your army, and come out!

title: Judges 9:30
text: And Zebul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal the son of Ebed, and his anger was kindled.

title: Judges 9:31
text: And he sent messengers to Abimelech secretly, saying, Behold, Gaal the son of Ebed and his brothers have come to Shechem. And behold, they fortify the city against you.

title: Judges 9:32
text: And now come up by night, you and the people with you, and lie in wait in the field.

title: Judges 9:33
text: And it shall be in the morning, as soon as the sun is up, it shall be that you shall rise early and set upon the city. And behold, when he and the people who are with him come out against you, you may do to them as you desire.

title: Judges 9:34
text: And Abimelech rose up by night, and all the people with him, and they lay in wait against Shechem in four companies.

title: Judges 9:35
text: And Gaal the son of Ebed went out and stood in the entrance of the gate of the city. And Abimelech rose up, and the people with him, from lying in wait.

title: Judges 9:36
text: And when Gaal saw the people, he said to Zebul, Behold, people are coming down from the top of the mountains. And Zebul said to him, You are seeing the shadow of the mountains like men.

title: Judges 9:37
text: And Gaal spoke again and said, See, people [are] coming by the middle of the land, and another company coming along by way of the Sorcerers' Oak.

title: Judges 9:38
text: And Zebul said to him, Where is your mouth now, [with] which you said, Who [is] Abimelech, that we should serve him? Is not this the people whom you have despised? I pray you, go out now and fight with them.

title: Judges 9:39
text: And Gaal went out before the men of Shechem, and fought with Abimelech.

title: Judges 9:40
text: And Abimelech chased him, and he fled before him, and many were overthrown and wounded, to the entrance of the gate.

title: Judges 9:41
text: And Abimelech lived at Arumah. And Zebul put Gaal and his brothers out, so that they should not live in Shechem.

title: Judges 9:42
text: And it happened on the next day the people went out into the field. And they told Abimelech.

title: Judges 9:43
text: And he took the people and divided them into three companies, and lay in wait in the field. And they looked, and behold, the people came forth out of the city. And he rose up against them, and struck them.

title: Judges 9:44
text: And Abimelech and the company with him rushed forward and stood in the entrance of the gate of the city. And the two companies ran upon all the people in the field, and killed them.

title: Judges 9:45
text: And Abimelech fought against the city all that day. And he took the city and killed the people in it. And he beat down the city and sowed it [with] salt.

title: Judges 9:46
text: And all the men of the tower of Shechem heard, and entered into a stronghold of the house of the god Berith.

title: Judges 9:47
text: And it was told Abimelech that all the men of the tower of Shechem were gathered together.

title: Judges 9:48
text: And Abimelech went up to Mount Zalmon, he and all the people with him. And Abimelech took an axe in his hand, and cut down a limb from the trees, and took it and laid it on his shoulder, and said to the people who were with him, What you have seen me do, hurry and do likewise.

title: Judges 9:49
text: And all the people also, each man, cut down a limb for themselves, and followed Abimelech, and set [them] at the stronghold, and set on fire the stronghold. And about a thousand men and women, all the men of the tower of Shechem, died also.

title: Judges 9:50
text: And Abimelech went to Thebez, and camped against Thebez, and took it.

title: Judges 9:51
text: But there was a strong tower in the middle of the city, and all the men and women, and all the leaders of the city, fled there, and shut [it] behind them, and got up to the top of the tower.

title: Judges 9:52
text: And Abimelech came to the tower and fought against it, and went hard to the door of the tower to burn it with fire.

title: Judges 9:53
text: And a certain woman threw a piece of a millstone upon Abimelech's head and crushed his skull.

title: Judges 9:54
text: Then he called hastily to the young man who was his armor-bearer, and said to him, Draw your sword and kill me, so that men may not say of me, A woman killed him! And his young man thrust him through, and he died.

title: Judges 9:55
text: And when the men of Israel saw that Abimelech was dead, each one of them left to go to his place.

title: Judges 9:56
text: And God repaid the evil of Abimelech, that which he did to his father in killing his seventy brothers.

title: Judges 9:57
text: And all the evil of the men of Shechem God sent back upon their heads. And upon them came the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal.

title: Judges 10:1
text: And after Abimelech there arose to defend Israel, Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar. And he lived in Shamir in Mount Ephraim.

title: Judges 10:2
text: And he judged Israel twenty-three years, and died, and was buried in Shamir.

title: Judges 10:3
text: And after him arose Jair, a Gileadite, and judged Israel twenty-two years.

title: Judges 10:4
text: And he had thirty sons who rode on thirty ass colts, and they had thirty cities which are called Havoth-jair to this day in the land of Gilead.

title: Judges 10:5
text: And Jair died and was buried in Kamon.

title: Judges 10:6
text: And the sons of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD, and served the Baals and Ashtoreths, and the gods of Syria, and the gods of Sidon, and the gods of Moab, and the gods of the sons of Ammon, and the gods of the Philistines. And they left the LORD, and did not serve Him.

title: Judges 10:7
text: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel, and He sold them into the hands of the Philistines and into the hands of the sons of Ammon.

title: Judges 10:8
text: And that year they troubled and oppressed the sons of Israel; all the sons of Israel on the other side of Jordan, in the land of the Amorites, which [is] in Gilead, for eighteen years.

title: Judges 10:9
text: And the sons of Ammon passed over Jordan to fight also against Judah, and against Benjamin, and against the house of Ephraim, so that Israel was very distressed.

title: Judges 10:10
text: And the sons of Israel cried to the LORD, saying, We have sinned against You, both because we have forsaken our God and also have served the Baals.

title: Judges 10:11
text: And the LORD said to the sons of Israel, Did not [I deliver you] from Egyptians, and from the Amorites, from the sons of Ammon, and from the Philistines?

title: Judges 10:12
text: And the Sidonians and the Amalekites and the Maonites oppressed you. And you cried to Me, and I delivered you out of their hand.

title: Judges 10:13
text: Yet you have forsaken Me and served other gods; therefore, I will deliver you no more.

title: Judges 10:14
text: Go and cry to the gods which you have chosen. Let them deliver you in the time of your tribulation.

title: Judges 10:15
text: And the sons of Israel said to the LORD, We have sinned. Do You to us whatever [is] good in Your eyes; only deliver us, we pray You, today.

title: Judges 10:16
text: And they put away the strange gods from among them, and served the LORD. And His soul was moved by the misery of Israel.

title: Judges 10:17
text: Then the sons of Ammon were gathered and camped in Gilead. And the sons of Israel assembled themselves together and camped in Mizpeh.

title: Judges 10:18
text: And the people and rulers of Gilead said to one another, What man [is] there who will begin to fight against the sons of Ammon? He shall be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.

title: Judges 11:1
text: Now Jephthah, the Gileadite, was a mighty man of war. And he [was] the son of a harlot. And Gilead fathered Jephthah.

title: Judges 11:2
text: And Gilead's wife bore him sons. And his wife's sons grew up, and [they] threw Jephthah out and said to him, You shall not inherit in our father's house. For you [are] the son of another woman.

title: Judges 11:3
text: Then Jephthah fled from his brothers and lived in the land of Tob. And worthless men were gathered to Jephthah, and went out with him.

title: Judges 11:4
text: And it happened after some time the sons of Ammon made war against Israel.

title: Judges 11:5
text: And when the sons of Ammon made war against Israel, the elders of Gilead went to bring Jephthah out of the land of Tob.

title: Judges 11:6
text: And they said to Jephthah, Come and be our commander, so that we may fight with the sons of Ammon.

title: Judges 11:7
text: And Jephthah said to the elders of Gilead, Have you not hated me and thrown me out of my father's house? Why have you come to me now when you [are] in trouble?

title: Judges 11:8
text: And the elders of Gilead said to Jephthah, For this reason we turn again to you now, so that you may go with us and fight against the sons of Ammon, and be our head over all the people of Gilead.

title: Judges 11:9
text: And Jephthah said to the elders of Gilead, If you bring me home again to fight against the sons of Ammon, and the LORD delivers them before me, shall I be your head?

title: Judges 11:10
text: And the elders of Gilead said to Jephthah, The LORD is witness between us if we do not do so according to your word.

title: Judges 11:11
text: And Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him head and commander over them. And Jephthah uttered all his words before the LORD in Mizpeh.

title: Judges 11:12
text: And Jephthah sent messengers to the king of the sons of Ammon, saying, What have you to do with me, that you have come against me to fight in my land?

title: Judges 11:13
text: And the king of the sons of Ammon answered to the messengers of Jephthah, Because Israel took away my land when they came up out of Egypt, from Arnon even to Jabbok, and to Jordan. Now therefore restore those lands peaceably.

title: Judges 11:14
text: And Jephthah sent messengers again to the king of the sons of Ammon.

title: Judges 11:15
text: And he said to him, So says Jephthah, Israel did not take away the land of Moab, nor the land of the sons of Ammon.

title: Judges 11:16
text: But when they came up from Egypt, Israel walked through the wilderness to the Red Sea, and came to Kadesh.

title: Judges 11:17
text: And Israel sent messengers to the king of Edom, saying, I pray you, let me pass through your land. But the king of Edom would not listen. And in the same way they sent to the king of Moab, but he would not. And Israel stayed in Kadesh.

title: Judges 11:18
text: And they went along through the wilderness, and went around the land of Edom and the land of Moab, and came by the east side of the land of Moab and pitched on the other side of Arnon, but they did not come within the border of Moab; for Arnon was the border of Moab.

title: Judges 11:19
text: And Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, the king of Heshbon. And Israel said to him, We pray you, let us pass through your land to my place.

title: Judges 11:20
text: But Sihon did not trust Israel to pass through his border. But Sihon gathered all his people together and pitched in Jahaz, and fought against Israel.

title: Judges 11:21
text: And the LORD God of Israel delivered Sihon and all his people into the hand of Israel, and they struck them. So Israel possessed all the land of the Amorites, who lived in that country.

title: Judges 11:22
text: And they possessed all the borders of the Amorites, from Arnon even to Jabbok, and from the wilderness even to Jordan.

title: Judges 11:23
text: So now the LORD God of Israel has put out the Amorites before His people Israel, and should you possess it?

title: Judges 11:24
text: Will you not possess that which Chemosh your god gives you to possess? So whomever the LORD our God shall drive out from before us, we will possess them.

title: Judges 11:25
text: And now [are] you any better than Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab? Did he ever strive against Israel, or did he ever fight against them

title: Judges 11:26
text: when Israel lived in Heshbon and its villages, and Aroer and its villages, and in all the cities which [are] along by the borders of Arnon, for three hundred years? Why then did you not deliver them in that time?

title: Judges 11:27
text: So I have not sinned against you, but you do me wrong to war against me. The LORD, the Judge, will judge this day between the sons of Israel and the sons of Ammon.

title: Judges 11:28
text: And the king of the sons of Ammon did not listen to the words of Jephthah which he sent to him.

title: Judges 11:29
text: Then the Spirit of the LORD came on Jephthah, and he passed over Gilead and Manasseh, and passed over Mizpeh of Gilead, and from Mizpeh of Gilead passed over [to] the sons of Ammon.

title: Judges 11:30
text: And Jephthah vowed a vow to the LORD, and said, If You will indeed give the sons of Ammon into my hand,

title: Judges 11:31
text: then it shall be that whatever comes out from the doors of my house to meet me when I return in peace from the sons of Ammon, surely it shall belong to the LORD, or I will offer it up [instead of] a burnt offering.

title: Judges 11:32
text: And Jephthah passed over to the sons of Ammon to fight against them. And the LORD delivered them into his hand.

title: Judges 11:33
text: And he struck them from Aroer even until you come to Minnith, twenty cities, and to the meadow of the vineyards, with a very great slaughter. So were the sons of Ammon subdued before the sons of Israel.

title: Judges 11:34
text: And Jephthah came to Mizpeh to his house, and, behold, his daughter came out to meet him with timbrels and with dances. And she [was his] only child. Besides her he had neither son nor daughter.

title: Judges 11:35
text: And it happened when he saw her, he tore his clothes and said, Alas, my daughter! You have brought me very low, and you are one of those who trouble me. For I have opened my mouth to the LORD, and I cannot go back.

title: Judges 11:36
text: And she said to him, My father, you have opened your mouth to the Lord; do to me according to that which has come out of your mouth, because the LORD has taken vengeance for you upon your enemies, even of the sons of Ammon.

title: Judges 11:37
text: And she said to her father, Let this thing be done for me. Let me alone two months, so that I may go up and down upon the mountains and weep for my virginity, I and my companions.

title: Judges 11:38
text: And he said, Go. And he sent her away [for] two months. And she went with her companions and wept for her virginity upon the mountains.

title: Judges 11:39
text: And it happened at the end of two months she returned to her father, who did to her his vow which he had vowed. And she knew no man. And it is a custom in Israel,

title: Judges 11:40
text: that the daughters of Israel went yearly to tell again of the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite, four days in a year.

title: Judges 12:1
text: And the men of Ephraim were called together and went northward, and said to Jephthah, Why did you go over to fight against the sons of Ammon, and did not call us to go with you? We will burn your house upon you with fire.

title: Judges 12:2
text: And Jephthah said to them, My people and I were at great strife [with] the sons of Ammon. And when I called you, you did not deliver me out of their hands.

title: Judges 12:3
text: When I saw that you did not deliver me, I took my life in my hand and passed over against the sons of Ammon, and the LORD delivered them into my hand, and why have you come up against me, to fight against me today?

title: Judges 12:4
text: And Jephthah called up all the men of Gilead and fought with Ephraim. And the men of Gilead struck Ephraim, because they said, You Gileadites [are] fugitives of Ephraim among the Ephraimites and among the Manassites.

title: Judges 12:5
text: And the Gileadites took the fords of Jordan before the Ephraimites. And it happened that when one of those Ephraimites who had escaped said, Let me go over, the men of Gilead said to him, Are you an Ephraimite? And he said, No.

title: Judges 12:6
text: And they said to him, Please say Shibboleth. And he said, Sibboleth, for he could not manage to pronounce [it] right. Then they took him and killed him at the passages of Jordan. And there fell at that time forty-two thousand of the Ephraimites.

title: Judges 12:7
text: And Jephthah judged Israel six years. And Jephthah the Gileadite died, and was buried in [one of] the cities of Gilead.

title: Judges 12:8
text: And after him Ibzan of Bethlehem judged Israel.

title: Judges 12:9
text: And he had thirty sons and thirty daughters [whom] he sent abroad, and took in thirty daughters from abroad for his sons. And he judged Israel seven years.

title: Judges 12:10
text: Then Ibzan died, and was buried at Bethlehem.

title: Judges 12:11
text: And after him Elon, a Zebulonite, judged Israel. And he judged Israel ten years.

title: Judges 12:12
text: And Elon the Zebulonite died, and was buried in Aijalon, the land of Zebulun.

title: Judges 12:13
text: And after him Abdon the son of Hillel, a Pirathonite, judged Israel.

title: Judges 12:14
text: And he had forty sons and thirty grandsons, who rode on seventy ass colts. And he judged Israel eight years.

title: Judges 12:15
text: And Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died, and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim, in the mount of the Amalekites.

title: Judges 13:1
text: And the sons of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD. And the LORD delivered them into the hands of the Philistines forty years.

title: Judges 13:2
text: And there was a certain man of Zorah, of the family of the Danites, whose name [was] Manoah. And his wife was barren and did not bear.

title: Judges 13:3
text: And the Angel of the LORD appeared to the woman and said to her, Behold now, you [are] barren and do not bear. But you shall conceive and bear a son.

title: Judges 13:4
text: And now, please take heed, and do not drink wine nor strong drink, and do not eat any unclean [thing].

title: Judges 13:5
text: For lo, you shall conceive and bear a son. And no razor shall come upon his head. For the child shall be a Nazarite to God from the womb. And he shall begin to deliver Israel out of the hand of the Philistines.

title: Judges 13:6
text: And the woman came and told her husband, saying, A man of God came to me, and His face [was] like the face of an Angel of God, very terrifying. But I did not ask Him where He came from, neither did He tell me His name.

title: Judges 13:7
text: But He said to me, Behold, you shall conceive and bear a son. And now drink no wine nor strong drink, neither eat any unclean [thing], for the boy shall be a Nazirite to God from the womb to the day of his death.

title: Judges 13:8
text: And Manoah prayed to the LORD and said, O, my Lord, let the Man of God, whom You sent, come again to us and teach us what we shall do to the boy that shall be born.

title: Judges 13:9
text: And God listened to the voice of Manoah, and the Angel of God came again to the woman as she sat in the field. But Manoah her husband [was] not with her.

title: Judges 13:10
text: And the woman hurried and ran, and told her husband, and said to him, Behold, the Man has appeared to Me, the one who came to me the [other] day.

title: Judges 13:11
text: And Manoah arose and went after his wife, and came to the Man, and said to Him, [Are] You the Man who spoke to the woman? And He said, I [am].

title: Judges 13:12
text: And Manoah said, Now let Your words come to pass. [How] shall we order the child, and what shall we do to him?

title: Judges 13:13
text: And the Angel of the LORD said to Manoah, Of all that I said to the woman let her be careful.

title: Judges 13:14
text: She may not eat of all that comes from the vine, neither let her drink wine nor strong drink, nor eat any unclean [thing]. Let her do all that I commanded her.

title: Judges 13:15
text: And Manoah said to the Angel of the LORD, I pray You, let us keep You until we have made a kid ready for You.

title: Judges 13:16
text: And the Angel of the LORD said to Manoah, Though you keep Me, I will not eat of your bread. And if you will offer a burnt offering, you must offer it to the LORD. For Manoah did not know that He [was] the Angel of the LORD.

title: Judges 13:17
text: And Manoah said to the Angel of the LORD, What [is] Your name, so that when Your sayings come to pass we may do You honor?

title: Judges 13:18
text: And the Angel of the LORD said to him, Why do you ask after My name in this way? Yea, it [is] Wonderful.

title: Judges 13:19
text: And Manoah took a kid with a food offering, and offered [it] upon a rock to the LORD, and did wonderfully. And Manoah and his wife looked on.

title: Judges 13:20
text: For it happened when the flame went up toward heaven from off the altar, the Angel of the LORD went up in the flame of the altar. And Manoah and his wife looked on [it] and fell on their faces to. the ground.

title: Judges 13:21
text: But the Angel of the LORD did not appear any more to Manoah and to his wife. Then Manoah knew that He [was] an Angel of the LORD.

title: Judges 13:22
text: And Manoah said to his wife, We shall surely die because we have seen God.

title: Judges 13:23
text: But his wife said to him, If the LORD were pleased to kill us, He would not have received a burnt offering and a food offering at our hands, neither would He have showed us all these [things], nor have told us [such things] as these at this time.

title: Judges 13:24
text: And the woman bore a son and called his name Samson. And the child grew, and the LORD blessed him.

title: Judges 13:25
text: And the Spirit of the LORD began to move him at times in the camp of Dan between Zorah and Eshtaol.

title: Judges 14:1
text: And Samson went down to Timnath, and saw a woman in Timnath of the daughters of the Philistines.

title: Judges 14:2
text: And he came up and told his father and his mother, and said, I have seen a woman in Timnath of the daughters of the Philistines. And now get her for me for a wife.

title: Judges 14:3
text: And his father and his mother said to him, [Is there] no woman among the daughters of your brothers, or among all my people, that you go to take a wife from the uncircumcised Philistines? And Samson said to his father, Get her for me, for she pleases me very much.

title: Judges 14:4
text: But his father and his mother did not know that it [was] from the LORD, that He [was] looking for an occasion against the Philistines. For at that time the Philistines had the rule over Israel.

title: Judges 14:5
text: And Samson and his father and his mother went down to Timnath. And they came to the vineyards of Timnath. And, behold, a young lion roared to meet him.

title: Judges 14:6
text: And the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him, and he tore it as he would have torn a kid; and nothing was in his hand. But he did not tell his father or his mother what he had done.

title: Judges 14:7
text: And he went down and talked with the woman. And she pleased Samson very much.

title: Judges 14:8
text: And after a time he returned to take her, and he turned aside to see the dead body of the lion. And behold! A swarm of bees and honey [was] in the dead body of the lion.

title: Judges 14:9
text: And he took some of it in his hands, and went on eating, and came to his father and mother. And he gave to them, and they ate. But he did not tell them that he had taken the honey out of the dead body of the lion.

title: Judges 14:10
text: And his father went down to the woman. And Samson made a feast there, for so the young men used to do.

title: Judges 14:11
text: And it happened when they saw him, they brought thirty companions to be with him.

title: Judges 14:12
text: And Samson said to them, I will now put forth a riddle to you. If you certainly tell it to me [within] the seven days of the feast, and find [it] out, then I will give you thirty linen blouses and thirty changes of garments.

title: Judges 14:13
text: But if you cannot tell me, then you shall give me thirty linen blouses and thirty changes of garments. And they said to him, Put forth your riddle so that we may hear it.

title: Judges 14:14
text: And he said to them, Out of the eater came forth food, and out of the strong came forth sweetness. And in three days they could not tell what the riddle.

title: Judges 14:15
text: And it happened on the seventh day they said to Samson's wife, Lure your husband so that he may tell the riddle to us, lest we burn you and your father's house with fire. Have you called us to take what we have? [Is it] not [so]?

title: Judges 14:16
text: And Samson's wife wept before him, and said, You only hate me, and do not love [me]. You have put forth a riddle to the sons of my people, and have not told [it] to me. And he said to her, Behold, I have not told my father nor to my mother, and shall I tell you?

title: Judges 14:17
text: And she wept before him the seven days, while their feast lasted. And on the seventh day, he told her, because she pressed hard upon him. And she told the riddle to the sons of her people.

title: Judges 14:18
text: And the men of the city said to him on the seventh day before the sun went down, What [is] sweeter than honey, and what stronger than a lion? And he said to them, If you had not plowed with my heifer, you would not have found [out]  my riddle.

title: Judges 14:19
text: And the Spirit of the LORD came upon him, and he went down to Ashkelon and killed thirty men of them, and took their spoil, and gave changes of garments to them who told what the riddle meant. And his anger was kindled, and he went up to his father's house.

title: Judges 14:20
text: But Samson's wife was [given] to his companion, who had served as his friend.

title: Judges 15:1
text: And it happened afterward, in the days of wheat harvest, Samson visited his wife with a kid. And [he] said, I will go in to my wife into the room. But her father would not allow him to go in.

title: Judges 15:2
text: And her father said, I truly thought that you utterly hated her, and I gave her to your companion. [Is] not her younger sister fairer than she is? Please, let her be for you instead of her.

title: Judges 15:3
text: And Samson said concerning them, Now I shall be more blameless than the Philistines, though I do evil with them.

title: Judges 15:4
text: And Samson went and caught three hundred foxes and took fire brands, and turned tail to tail, and put a fire brand in the middle between two tails.

title: Judges 15:5
text: And [he] set the brands on fire, he let [them] go into the standing grain of the Philistines, and burned up both the shocks and also the standing grain, with the vineyards and olives.

title: Judges 15:6
text: And the Philistines said, Who has done this? And they answered, Samson, the son-in-law of the Timnite, because he had taken his wife and given her to his companion. And the Philistines came up and burned her and her father with fire.

title: Judges 15:7
text: And Samson said to them, Though you have done this, yet I will be avenged of you, and after that I will stop.

title: Judges 15:8
text: And he struck them hip and thigh with a great slaughter. And he went down and lived in the top of the rock Etam.

title: Judges 15:9
text: And the Philistines went up and pitched in Judah, and spread themselves in Lehi.

title: Judges 15:10
text: And the men of Judah said, Why have you come up against us? And they answered, We have come up to bind Samson, to do to him as he has done to us.

title: Judges 15:11
text: Then three thousand men of Judah went to the top of the rock Etam, and said to Samson, Do you not know that the Philistines [are] rulers over us? What have you done to us? And he said to them, As they have done to me, so I have done to them.

title: Judges 15:12
text: And they said to him, We have come to bind you so that we may deliver you into the hands of the Philistines. And Samson said to them, Swear to me that you will not fall upon me yourselves.

title: Judges 15:13
text: And they spoke to him, saying, No, but we will tie you up and deliver you into their hand. But surely we will not kill you. And they bound him with two new cords and brought him up from the rock.

title: Judges 15:14
text: He came to Lehi, and the Philistines shouted against him. And the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him, and the cords on his arms became as flax that has been burned with fire, and his bands loosed from off his hands.

title: Judges 15:15
text: And he found a new jawbone of an ass, and put forth his hand and took it, and killed a thousand men with it.

title: Judges 15:16
text: And Samson said, With the jawbone of an ass, heaps upon heaps, with the jawbone of an ass I have killed a thousand men.

title: Judges 15:17
text: And it happened when he had made an end of speaking, he threw away the jawbone out of his hand, and called that place Hill of the Jawbone.

title: Judges 15:18
text: And he was very thirsty and called upon the LORD and said, You have given this great deliverance into the hand of Your servant. And now shall I die with thirst, and fall into the hand of the uncircumcised?

title: Judges 15:19
text: But God cut open a hollow place and water came out there. And he drank, and his spirit came again, and he revived. Therefore, its name [is] called Fountain of the Praying One, which is in Lehi to this day.

title: Judges 15:20
text: And he judged Israel in the days of the Philistines twenty years.

title: Judges 16:1
text: Then Samson went to Gaza. And he saw a harlot there, and went in to her.

title: Judges 16:2
text: The Gazites [were told], saying, Samson has come here. And they surrounded him and laid wait for him all night in the gate of the city, and were quiet all the night, saying, Until the light of the morning, then we shall kill him.

title: Judges 16:3
text: And Samson lay till midnight, and arose at midnight, and took hold of the leaves of the gate of the city and the two posts, and picked them up, with the bar, and put [them] on his shoulders and carried them up to the top of a hill that [is] before Hebron.

title: Judges 16:4
text: And it happened afterwards, he loved a woman in the valley of Sorek, whose name [was] Delilah.

title: Judges 16:5
text: And the lords of the Philistines came up to her, and said to her, Lure him and see where his great strength [lies], and by what means we may prevail against him, so that we may tie him to afflict him. And each one of us will give you eleven hundred pieces [of] silver.

title: Judges 16:6
text: And Delilah said to Samson, Please tell me where your great strength [lies], and with what you may be bound to afflict you.

title: Judges 16:7
text: And Samson said to her, If they bind me with seven green cords that were never dried, then I shall be weak and be as another man.

title: Judges 16:8
text: Then the lords of the Philistines brought up to her seven green cords which had not been dried, and she bound him with them.

title: Judges 16:9
text: And the ambush [was] sitting for her in the inner room. And she said to him, The Philistines [are] upon you, Samson! And he broke the cords like a thread of tow when it smells fire. And his strength was not known.

title: Judges 16:10
text: And Delilah said to Samson, Behold, you have mocked me and told me lies. Now, please, tell me with what you may be bound.

title: Judges 16:11
text: And he said to her, If they bind me fast with new ropes that have never been used, then I shall be weak and be as another man.

title: Judges 16:12
text: And Delilah took new ropes and bound him with them, and said to him, The Philistines [are] upon you, Samson! And the ambush [was] sitting for her in the inner room. And he broke them from off his arms like a thread.

title: Judges 16:13
text: And Delilah said to Samson, You have mocked me until now, and told me lies. Tell me with what you may be bound. And he said to her, If you weave the seven locks of my head with the web.

title: Judges 16:14
text: And she fastened [it] with the pin, and said to him, The Philistines are upon you, Samson! And He awakened out of his sleep, and pulled out the pin, the hand-loom and the web.

title: Judges 16:15
text: And she said to him, How can you say, I love you, and your heart [is] not with me? You have mocked me these three times, and have not told me in what your great strength [lies].

title: Judges 16:16
text: And it happened because she distressed him with her words daily, and urged him; and his soul was grieved to death.

title: Judges 16:17
text: And he told her all his heart, and said to her, A razor has not come on my hair, for I [am] a Nazirite to God from my mother's womb. If I am shaven, then my strength will go from me, and I will become weak and be like any man.

title: Judges 16:18
text: And when Delilah saw that he had told her all his heart, she sent and called for the lords of the Philistines, saying, Come this once, for he has showed me all his heart. Then the lords of the Philistines came up to her, and brought silver in their hand.

title: Judges 16:19
text: And she made him sleep upon her knees. And she called for a man, and she caused him to shave off the seven locks of his head. And she began to afflict him, and his strength went from him.

title: Judges 16:20
text: And she said, The Philistines [are] upon you, Samson! And he awoke out of his sleep and said, I will go out as at other times before, and shake myself. And he did not know that the LORD had departed from him.

title: Judges 16:21
text: And the Philistines took him and put out his eyes, and brought him down to Gaza, and bound him with fetters of brass. And he ground in the prison house.

title: Judges 16:22
text: However the hair of his head began to grow again after he had been shaven.

title: Judges 16:23
text: Then the lords of the Philistines gathered in order to offer a great sacrifice to Dagon their god, and to rejoice. For they said, Our god has delivered Samson our enemy into our hand.

title: Judges 16:24
text: And the people saw him and praised their god. For they said, Our god has delivered our enemy into our hand, and the destroyer of our country, who killed many of us.

title: Judges 16:25
text: And when their hearts were merry, it happened that they said, Call for Samson and he will make sport for us. And they called for Samson out of the prison house. And he made sport for them, and they set him between the pillars.

title: Judges 16:26
text: And Samson said to the lad who held him by the hand, Allow me to feel the pillars upon which the house stands, so that I may lean upon them.

title: Judges 16:27
text: Now the house was full of men and women. And all the lords of the Philistines [were] there. And on the roof were about three thousand men and women who watched while Samson made sport.

title: Judges 16:28
text: And Samson called to the LORD and said, O, Lord GOD, remember me, I pray You, and strengthen me, I pray You, only this once, O God, so that I may be at once avenged of the Philistines for my two eyes.

title: Judges 16:29
text: And Samson took hold of the two middle pillars upon which the house stood, and on which it was held up, of the one with his right hand, and of the other with his left.

title: Judges 16:30
text: And Samson said, Let me die with the Philistines. And he bowed himself mightily, and the house fell upon the lords and upon all the people in it. So the dead whom he killed at his death [were] more than those he killed in his life.

title: Judges 16:31
text: Then his brothers and all the house of his father came down, and took him, and brought [him] up and buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol in the burying-place of Manoah his father. And he judged Israel twenty years.

title: Judges 17:1
text: And there was a man of Mount Ephraim, and his name [was] Micah.

title: Judges 17:2
text: And he said to his mother, The eleven hundred [shekels] of silver which were taken from you, about which you cursed, and spoke of also in my ears, behold, the silver [is] with me. Behold, I took it. And his mother said, Be blessed of the LORD, my son.

title: Judges 17:3
text: And when he had given back the eleven hundred of silver to his mother, his mother said, I had wholly given the silver to the LORD from my hand for my son to make a graven image and a molten image. And now I am giving it to you.

title: Judges 17:4
text: And he gave the money back to his mother. And his mother took two hundred [shekels] of silver and gave them to a refiner, who made of it an engraved image and a molten image. And they were in the house of Micah.

title: Judges 17:5
text: And the man Micah had a house of gods, and made an ephod and household gods, and anointed one of his sons, who became his priest.

title: Judges 17:6
text: In those days [there was] no king in Israel, but every man did that which was right in his eyes.

title: Judges 17:7
text: And there was a young man out of Bethlehem-judah of the family of Judah, and he [was] a Levite. And he stayed there.

title: Judges 17:8
text: And the man went out of the city from Bethlehem-judah to live where he could find [a place]. And he came to Mount Ephraim to the house of Micah, as he journeyed.

title: Judges 17:9
text: And Micah said to him, Where do you come from? And he said to him, I [am] a Levite of Bethlehem-judah, and I go to live where I may find a place.

title: Judges 17:10
text: And Micah said to him, Live with me and be a father and a priest to me, and I will give you ten [shekels] of silver by the year, and a suit of clothes, and your food. And the Levite went in.

title: Judges 17:11
text: And the Levite was content to live with the man, and the young man was to him as one of his sons.

title: Judges 17:12
text: And Micah consecrated the Levite. And the young man became his priest, and was in the house of Micah.

title: Judges 17:13
text: Then Micah said, Now I know that the LORD will do me good, since I have a Levite as [my] priest.

title: Judges 18:1
text: In those days no king [was] in Israel. And in those days the tribe of the Danites looked for an inheritance for them to live in. For to that day it had not fallen to them by inheritance among the tribes of Israel.

title: Judges 18:2
text: And the sons of Dan sent from their family five men from their borders, men of war, from Zorah and from Eshtaol, to spy out the land and to search it. And they said to them, Go, search the land. And when they came to mount Ephraim to the house of Micah, they stayed there.

title: Judges 18:3
text: When they [were] at the house of Micah, they knew the voice of the young man the Levite. And they turned in there, and said to him, Who brought you here? And what are you doing in this [place]? And what have you here?

title: Judges 18:4
text: And he said to them, This is how Micah deals with me, and has hired me, and I am his priest.

title: Judges 18:5
text: And they said to him, We pray you, Ask counsel of God so that we may know whether our way which we go shall be prosperous.

title: Judges 18:6
text: And the priest said to them, Go in peace. Your way in which you go [is] before the LORD.

title: Judges 18:7
text: And the five men departed and came to Laish, and saw the people in it, how they lived carelessly, as the Sidonians do, quiet and secure. And there [was] no judge in the land who might put them to shame in a thing. And they were far from the Sidonians, and had no business with [any] man.

title: Judges 18:8
text: And they came to their brothers, to Zorah and Eshtaol. And their brothers said to them, What do you [say]?

title: Judges 18:9
text: And they said, Arise, so that we may go up against them. For we have seen the land, and, behold, [it is] very good. And will you sit quietly? Do not be too lazy to go; enter to possess the land.

title: Judges 18:10
text: When you go, you shall come to a people feeling safe, and to a large land. For God has given it into your hands, a place where [there is] no lack of anything in the earth.

title: Judges 18:11
text: And six hundred men of the family of the Danites moved from there, out of Zorah and out of Eshtaol, girded with weapons of war.

title: Judges 18:12
text: And they went up and pitched in Kirjath-jearim, in Judah. Therefore, they called that place A Camp of Dan to this day. Behold, [it is] behind Kirjath-jearim.

title: Judges 18:13
text: And they passed from there to mount Ephraim and came to the house of Micah.

title: Judges 18:14
text: Then the five men who went to spy out the country of Laish answered and said to their brothers, Did you know that there is in these houses an ephod, and household gods, and an engraved image and a molten image? And now consider what you have to do.

title: Judges 18:15
text: And they turned in that way, and came to the house of the young man the Levite, to the house of Micah, and greeted him.

title: Judges 18:16
text: And the six hundred men of the sons of Dan, girded with their weapons of war, stood by the entrance of the gate.

title: Judges 18:17
text: And the five men who went up to spy out the land came in there, and took the engraved image and the ephod and the household gods, and the molten image. And the priest stood the entrance of the gate with the six hundred men who [were] dressed with weapons of war.

title: Judges 18:18
text: And these went into Micah's house and brought out [the] carved image, the ephod, and the household gods, and the molten image. And the priest said to them, What are you doing?

title: Judges 18:19
text: And they said to him, Be quiet, lay your hand on your mouth and go with us, and be to us a father and a priest. [Is it] better for you to be a priest to the house of one man, or that you be a priest to a tribe and a family in Israel?

title: Judges 18:20
text: And the priest's heart was glad, and he took the ephod, and the household gods, and the carved image, and went in the midst of the people.

title: Judges 18:21
text: And they turned and departed, and put the little ones and the cattle and the valuables before them.

title: Judges 18:22
text: They had gone far away from the house of Micah, and the men in the houses near Micah's house had been called together and had overtaken the sons of Dan.

title: Judges 18:23
text: And [they] cried to the sons of Dan. And they turned their faces and said to Micah, What [ails] you, that you have been called together?

title: Judges 18:24
text: And he said, You have taken away my gods which I made, and the priest, and you have gone away. And what more do I have? And what [is] this you say to me, What [ails] you?

title: Judges 18:25
text: And the sons of Dan said to him, Do not let your voice be heard among us, lest angry fellows run upon you and you lose your life with the lives of your household.

title: Judges 18:26
text: And the sons of Dan went their way. And when Micah saw that they [were] too strong for him, he turned and went back to his house.

title: Judges 18:27
text: And they took [the things] which Micah had made, and the priest whom he had, and came to Laish, to a people quiet and feeling safe. And [they] struck them with the edge of the sword and burned the city with fire.

title: Judges 18:28
text: And [there was] no deliverer, because it [was] far from Sidon, and they had no business with [any] man. And it [was] in the valley that lies by Beth-rehob. And they built a city and lived in it.

title: Judges 18:29
text: And they called the name of the city Dan, after the name of Dan their father, who was born to Israel. However the name of the city [was] Laish at the first.

title: Judges 18:30
text: And the sons of Dan set up the engraved image. And Jonathan, the son of Gershom, the son of Manasseh, he and his sons were priests to the tribe of Dan until the day of the captivity of the land.

title: Judges 18:31
text: And they set up Micah's engraved image for themselves, the image which he made, all the time that the house of God was in Shiloh.

title: Judges 19:1
text: And it happened in those days, no king being in Israel, there was a certain Levite residing on the far side of Mount Ephraim, who took to him a concubine out of Bethlehem-judah.

title: Judges 19:2
text: And his concubine played the harlot against him, and went away from him to her father's house to Bethlehem-judah, and was there four whole months.

title: Judges 19:3
text: And her husband arose and went after her, to speak friendly to her, to bring her again, having his servant with him and a couple of asses. And she brought him into her father's house. And when the father of the girl saw him, he rejoiced to meet him.

title: Judges 19:4
text: And his father-in-law, the girl's father, kept him. And he stayed with him three days. So they ate and drank and stayed there.

title: Judges 19:5
text: And it happened on the fourth day when they arose early in the morning, he rose up to leave. And the girl's father said to his son-in-law, Comfort your heart [with] a piece of bread, and afterward go your way.

title: Judges 19:6
text: And they sat down and ate and drank, both of them together, for the girl's father had said to the man, Please be content, and stay all night, and let your heart be merry.

title: Judges 19:7
text: And when the man rose up to leave, his father-in-law urged him, and he stayed there again.

title: Judges 19:8
text: And he rose early in the morning on the fifth day to leave. And the girl's father said, Please comfort your heart. And they stayed till afternoon, and both of them ate.

title: Judges 19:9
text: And when the man rose up to leave, he and his concubine, and his servant, his father-in-law, the girl's father said to him, Behold, now the day draws toward evening. Please stay all night. Behold, the day grows to an end. Stay here so that your heart may be merry. And tomorrow go early on your way, so that you may go to your tent.

title: Judges 19:10
text: But the man would not stay that night, but he rose up and left, and came over against Jebus, which [is] Jerusalem. And there were with him two saddled asses. His concubine also was with him.

title: Judges 19:11
text: They [were] beside Jebus, and the day was far gone. And the servant said to his master, Please come, and let us turn in to this city of the Jebusites and stay in it.

title: Judges 19:12
text: And his master said to him, We will not turn aside here into the city of a stranger that [is] not of the sons of Israel. We will pass over to Gibeah.

title: Judges 19:13
text: And he said to his servant, Come and let us draw near one of these places to stay all night, in Gibeah or in Ramah.

title: Judges 19:14
text: And they passed on and went their way. And the sun went [down] on them beside Gibeah, which [is] of Benjamin.

title: Judges 19:15
text: And they turned aside there, to go in [and] to lodge in Gibeah. And he went in and sat down in a street of the city. For no man took them into his house to stay the night.

title: Judges 19:16
text: And behold, there came an old man from his work out of the field at evening, who [was] also from mount Ephraim. And he lived in Gibeah, but the men of the place [were] of Benjamin.

title: Judges 19:17
text: And when he had lifted up his eyes, he saw a traveler in the streets of the city. And the old man said, Where do you go, and where do you come from?

title: Judges 19:18
