text: And he said to him, We [are] passing from Bethlehem-judah to the side of mount Ephraim. I [am] from there, and I went to Bethlehem-judah, but I am going to the house of the LORD. And there is no man who receives me into his house.

title: Judges 19:19
text: Yet here is both straw and food for our asses. And there is bread and wine also for me, and for your slave woman, and for the young man [who is] with your servants. There is no lack of anything.

title: Judges 19:20
text: And the old man said, Peace [be] with you. Yet all that you lack [shall be] on me. Only do not stay in the street.

title: Judges 19:21
text: And he brought him into his house and mixed [fodder] for the asses. And they washed their feet, and ate and drank.

title: Judges 19:22
text: They were making their hearts merry. And, behold, the men of the city, certain sons of Belial, set upon the house all around [and] beat at the door and spoke to the master of the house, the old man, saying, Bring out the man that came to your house so that we may know him.

title: Judges 19:23
text: And the man, the master of the house, went out to them and said to them, No, my brothers, I pray you, do not do evil, since this man has come into my house. Do not do this foolish sin.

title: Judges 19:24
text: Behold, my daughter, a virgin, and his concubine. I will bring them out now, and you humble them and do with them what seems good to you. But do not do so vile a thing to this man.

title: Judges 19:25
text: But the men would not listen to him. And the man took his concubine and brought [her] out to them. And they knew her and rolled themselves on her all night until the morning. And they sent her away at the dawning of the day.

title: Judges 19:26
text: And the woman came, in the dawning of the day, and fell down [at] the door of the man's house where her lord [was], until it was light.

title: Judges 19:27
text: And her lord rose up in the morning and opened the doors of the house and went out to go his way. And behold, the woman, his concubine, had fallen down [at] the door of the house, and her hands were upon the threshold.

title: Judges 19:28
text: And he said to her, Up, and let us be going. But there was no answer. Then the man took her on an ass, and the man rose up and went to his place.

title: Judges 19:29
text: And [he] came into his house, [he] took a knife and laid hold on his concubine, and divided her, with her bones, into twelve pieces and sent her into all the borders of Israel.

title: Judges 19:30
text: And it was so that all that saw [it] said, There was no such deed done nor seen from the day that the sons of Israel came up out of the land of Egypt to this day. Think of it, take advice and speak.

title: Judges 20:1
text: Then all the sons of Israel went out, and the congregation was gathered together as one man, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, with the land of Gilead, to the LORD in Mizpeh.

title: Judges 20:2
text: And the leader of all the people, of all the tribes of Israel, presented themselves in the assembly of the people of God, four hundred thousand footmen that drew sword.

title: Judges 20:3
text: And the sons of Benjamin heard that the sons of Israel had gone up to Mizpeh. And the sons of Israel said, Speak. How did this evil happen?

title: Judges 20:4
text: And the Levite, the husband of the woman who was slain, answered and said, I came into Gibeah of Benjamin to stay the night, my concubine and I.

title: Judges 20:5
text: And the men of Gibeah rose against me and set upon the house all around me at night. They intended to kill me. And they raped my concubine, and she is dead.

title: Judges 20:6
text: And I took my concubine and cut her in pieces, and sent her throughout all the land of the inheritance of Israel. For they have committed evil and folly in Israel.

title: Judges 20:7
text: Behold, you [are] all sons of Israel. Give here your advice and counsel.

title: Judges 20:8
text: And all people rose as one man, saying, Let no man go to his tent, and do not let any of us turn to his house.

title: Judges 20:9
text: And now this [is] the thing which we will do to Gibeah, [going] against it by lot.

title: Judges 20:10
text: and we will take ten men of a hundred of all the tribes of Israel, and a hundred of a thousand, and a thousand out of ten thousand, to bring food for the people, so that when they come to Gibeah of Benjamin, they may do according to all the folly which they have done in Israel.

title: Judges 20:11
text: And every man of Israel was gathered against the city, all together as one man.

title: Judges 20:12
text: And the tribes of Israel sent men through all the tribe of Benjamin saying, What wickedness [is] this that is done among you?

title: Judges 20:13
text: Now, therefore, deliver the men, the sons of Belial, who [are] in Gibeah, so that we may put them to death and put away evil from Israel. But Benjamin would not listen to the voice of their brothers, the sons of Israel.

title: Judges 20:14
text: And the sons of Benjamin gathered out of the cities to Gibeah, to go out to battle against the sons of Israel.

title: Judges 20:15
text: And the sons of Benjamin were numbered on that day out of the cities twenty-six thousand men who drew sword, besides the inhabitants of Gibeah, who were numbered seven hundred chosen men.

title: Judges 20:16
text: Among all this people [were] seven hundred chosen men, left-handed. Every one could sling stones at a hair's breadth, and not miss.

title: Judges 20:17
text: And the men of Israel, besides Benjamin, were numbered four hundred thousand men who drew sword. All these [were] men of war.

title: Judges 20:18
text: And the sons of Israel rose and went up to the house of God and asked counsel of God, and said, Which of us [shall go up] first to the battle against the sons of Benjamin? And the LORD said, Judah first.

title: Judges 20:19
text: And the sons of Israel rose up early in the morning, and camped against Gibeah.

title: Judges 20:20
text: And the men of Israel went out to battle against Benjamin. And the men of Israel put themselves in order, ready to fight against them at Gibeah

title: Judges 20:21
text: And the sons of Benjamin came forth out of Gibeah and destroyed to the earth twenty-two thousand men of the Israelites that day.

title: Judges 20:22
text: And the people, the men of Israel, encouraged themselves and set their battle in order again in the place where they put themselves in order the first day.

title: Judges 20:23
text: And the sons of Israel went up and wept before the LORD until evening, and asked counsel from the LORD saying, Shall I go up again to battle against the sons of Benjamin my brother? And the LORD said, Go up against him.

title: Judges 20:24
text: And the sons of Israel came near against the sons of Benjamin the second day.

title: Judges 20:25
text: And Benjamin went forth to meet them again from Gibeah the second day and again destroyed to the earth eighteen thousand men of the sons of Israel. All these drew the sword.

title: Judges 20:26
text: And all the sons of Israel, and all the people, went up and came into the house of God, and wept, and sat there before the LORD and fasted that day until evening, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the LORD.

title: Judges 20:27
text: And the sons of Israel inquired of the LORD (for the ark of the covenant of God [was] there in those days,

title: Judges 20:28
text: and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the son of Aaron stood before it in those days,) saying, Shall I yet again go out to battle against the sons of Benjamin my brother, or shall I stop? And the LORD said, Go up, for tomorrow I will deliver them into your hand.

title: Judges 20:29
text: And Israel set ambushers all around Gibeah.

title: Judges 20:30
text: And the sons of Israel went up against the sons of Benjamin on the third day, and put themselves in order against Gibeah, as at other times.

title: Judges 20:31
text: And the sons of Benjamin went out against the people, [and] were drawn away from the city. [And they] began to strike some of the people and to kill, as at other times, in the highways-- one of which goes up to the house of God, and the other to Gibeah in the field-- about thirty men of Israel.

title: Judges 20:32
text: And the sons of Benjamin said, They [are] beaten before us as at the first. But the sons of Israel said, Let us flee and draw them from the city to the highways.

title: Judges 20:33
text: And all the men of Israel rose up out of their place and marshalled at Baal-tamar. And the ambush of Israel broke forth from their place, from the plains of Gibeah.

title: Judges 20:34
text: And there came against Gibeah ten thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and the battle was heavy. But they did not know that evil [was] near them.

title: Judges 20:35
text: And the LORD struck Benjamin before Israel. And the sons of Israel destroyed in Benjamin twenty-five thousand and a hundred men that day. All these drew the sword.

title: Judges 20:36
text: So the sons of Benjamin saw that they were beaten. For the men of Israel gave place to Benjamin because they trusted to the ambush which they had set against Gibeah.

title: Judges 20:37
text: And the ambush hurried and rushed against Gibeah. And the ambush marched and struck all the city with the edge of the sword.

title: Judges 20:38
text: And a sign was set between the men of Israel and the ambush, caused go up a great smoke rising up from the city.

title: Judges 20:39
text: And when the men of Israel retired in the battle, Benjamin began to strike [and] kill of the men of Israel about thirty persons. For they said, Surely they are stricken down before us as [in] the first battle.

title: Judges 20:40
text: And the rising of a pillar [of smoke] began to go up out of the city. And Benjamin turned behind them, and behold, the whole city had gone up toward the heavens.

title: Judges 20:41
text: And the men of Israel turned again, and the men of Benjamin were amazed. For they saw that evil had touched them.

title: Judges 20:42
text: And they turned before the men of Israel, to the way of the wilderness. But the battle overtook them. And those who [came] out of the cities they destroyed in the midst of them.

title: Judges 20:43
text: They encircled Benjamin [and] they chased them without rest, [and] trod them down until [they were] against Gibeah toward the sunrise.

title: Judges 20:44
text: And there fell from Benjamin eighteen thousand. All these [were] men of war.

title: Judges 20:45
text: And they turned and fled toward the wilderness to the rock of Rimmon. And they gleaned of [them] in the highways five thousand men, and pursued hard after them to Gidom and killed two thousand men of them.

title: Judges 20:46
text: So that all who fell that day of Benjamin were twenty-five thousand men who drew the sword. All of these [were] men of war.

title: Judges 20:47
text: But six hundred men turned and fled to the wilderness, to the rock Rimmon, and they stayed in the rock Rimmon four months.

title: Judges 20:48
text: And the sons of Israel turned again to the sons of Benjamin and struck them with the edge of the sword, from the entire city to livestock, to all that was found. Also they set on fire all the cities that they came to.

title: Judges 21:1
text: And the men of Israel had sworn in Mizpeh, saying, Not one of us shall give his daughter to Benjamin for a wife.

title: Judges 21:2
text: And the people came to the house of God and stayed there until evening before God, and lifted up their voice and wept grievously,

title: Judges 21:3
text: and said, O, LORD God of Israel, Why has this happened in Israel, that there should be today one tribe lacking in Israel?

title: Judges 21:4
text: And it happened on the next day the people rose early and built there an altar, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings.

title: Judges 21:5
text: And the sons of Israel said, Who [is there] among all the tribes of Israel that did not come up with the congregation to the LORD? For they had made a great oath concerning him who did not come up to the LORD to Mizpeh, saying, He shall surely be put to death.

title: Judges 21:6
text: And the sons of Israel repented themselves for Benjamin their brother, and said, There is one tribe cut off from Israel this day.

title: Judges 21:7
text: What shall we do for wives for those who are left, since we have sworn by the LORD that we will not give them of our daughters for wives?

title: Judges 21:8
text: And they said, What one [is there] of the tribes of Israel that did not come up to Mizpeh to the LORD? And, behold, there came none to the camp from Jabesh-gilead to the assembly.

title: Judges 21:9
text: For the people were numbered, and behold, none of the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead [were there.]

title: Judges 21:10
text: And the congregation sent there twelve thousand men of the most valiant, and commanded them, saying, Go, and you shall strike the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead with the sword, with the women and the sons.

title: Judges 21:11
text: And this [is] the thing that you shall do. You shall utterly destroy every male and every woman who has lain with man.

title: Judges 21:12
text: And they found among the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead four hundred young virgins who had known no man by lying with any male. And they brought them to the camp to Shiloh, which [is] in the land of Canaan.

title: Judges 21:13
text: And the whole congregation sent to speak to the sons of Benjamin who were in the rock Rimmon, and to call peaceably to them.

title: Judges 21:14
text: And Benjamin came again at that time. And they gave them wives whom they had saved alive, of the women of Jabesh-gilead. And yet so they were not enough for them.

title: Judges 21:15
text: And the people repented themselves for Benjamin, because the LORD had made a break in the tribes of Israel.

title: Judges 21:16
text: And the elders of the congregation said, What shall we do for wives for those who are left, since the women are destroyed out of Benjamin?

title: Judges 21:17
text: And they said, [There must be] an inheritance for those of Benjamin who have escaped, so that a tribe may not be destroyed out of Israel.

title: Judges 21:18
text: However, we may not give them wives of our daughters. For the sons of Israel have sworn, saying, Cursed [is] he who gives a wife to Benjamin.

title: Judges 21:19
text: Then they said, Behold, [there is] a feast of the LORD in Shiloh yearly on the north side of Bethel, on the east side of the highway that goes up from Bethel to Shechem, and on the south of Lebonah.

title: Judges 21:20
text: And they commanded the sons of Benjamin, saying, Go and lie in wait in the vineyards,

title: Judges 21:21
text: and see, and behold, if the daughters of Shiloh come out to dance in dances, then you come out of the vineyards and catch you a wife for every man from the daughters of Shiloh, and go to the land of Benjamin.

title: Judges 21:22
text: And it shall be, when their fathers or their brothers come to us to complain, we will say to them, Be favorable to them for our sakes, because we did not reserve each man a wife in the war. For if you did not give to them at this time, you would be guilty.

title: Judges 21:23
text: And the sons of Benjamin did so, and took wives according to their number, from those that danced, whom they caught. And they went and returned to their inheritance, and repaired the cities and lived in them.

title: Judges 21:24
text: And the sons of Israel departed from there at that time, each man to his tribe and to his family. And they went out from there every man to his inheritance.

title: Judges 21:25
text: In those days [there was] no king in Israel. Every man did the right in his own eyes.

title: Ruth 1:1
text: And it happened in the days when the judges ruled, there was a famine in the land. And a certain man of Bethlehem-judah went to live in the country of Moab, he and his wife and his two sons.

title: Ruth 1:2
text: And the name of the man [was] Elimelech, and the name of his wife Naomi, and the name of his two sons Mahlon and Chilion, Ephrathites of Bethlehem-judah. And they came to the fields of Moab and stayed there.

title: Ruth 1:3
text: And Elimelech, Naomi's husband, died. And she was left, and her two sons.

title: Ruth 1:4
text: And they took wives for themselves from the women of Moab. The name of the one [was] Orpah, and the name of the other Ruth. And they lived there about ten years.

title: Ruth 1:5
text: And Mahlon and Chilion also died, both of them. And the woman was left without her two sons and her husband.

title: Ruth 1:6
text: Then she arose with her daughters-in-law so that she might return from the fields of Moab. For she had heard in the fields of Moab how the LORD had visited His people in giving them bread.

title: Ruth 1:7
text: And she went out of the place where she was, and her two daughters-in-law with her, and they went on the way to return to the land of Judah.

title: Ruth 1:8
text: And Naomi said to her two daughters-in-law, Go, return each one to her mother's house. May the LORD deal kindly with you, as you have dealt with the dead and with me.

title: Ruth 1:9
text: May the LORD grant you that you may find rest, each in the house of her husband. Then she kissed them, and they lifted up their voice and wept.

title: Ruth 1:10
text: And they said to her, Surely we will return with you to your people.

title: Ruth 1:11
text: And Naomi said, Turn again, my daughters. Why will you go with me? [Are] there yet sons in my womb, that they may be your husbands?

title: Ruth 1:12
text: Turn again, my daughters, go. For I am too old to have a husband. If I should say, I have hope, [if] I should have a husband also tonight, and should also bear sons,

title: Ruth 1:13
text: would you wait for them until they were grown? Will you shut yourselves up, not to have a husband? No, my daughters, for it makes me very sad for your sakes that the hand of the LORD has gone out against me.

title: Ruth 1:14
text: And they lifted up their voice and wept again. And Orpah kissed her mother-in-law. But Ruth clung to her.

title: Ruth 1:15
text: And she said, Behold, Your sister-in-law has gone back to her people and to her gods. Return after your sister-in-law.

title: Ruth 1:16
text: And Ruth said, Do not beg me to leave you, to return from following after you. For where you go, I will go. Where you stay, I will stay. Your people [shall be] my people, and your God my God.

title: Ruth 1:17
text: Where you die, I will die, and there I will be buried. May the LORD do so to me, and more also, [if anything] but death parts you and me.

title: Ruth 1:18
text: When she saw that she was determined to go with her, then she quit speaking to her.

title: Ruth 1:19
text: And both of them went until they came to Bethlehem. And it happened when they had come to Bethlehem, all the city was moved about them, and they said, [Is] this Naomi?

title: Ruth 1:20
text: And she said to them, Do not call me Naomi, call me Mara. For the Almighty has dealt very bitterly with me.

title: Ruth 1:21
text: I went out full, and the LORD has brought me back empty. Why do you call me Naomi, since the LORD has testified against me, and the Almighty has afflicted me?

title: Ruth 1:22
text: And Naomi returned; and Ruth, who was of Moab, her daughter-in-law, was with her, returning out of the fields of Moab. And they came to Bethlehem in the beginning of barley harvest.

title: Ruth 2:1
text: And Naomi [had] a kinsman of her husband's, a mighty man of wealth, of the family of Elimelech. And his name [was] Boaz.

title: Ruth 2:2
text: And Ruth of Moab said to Naomi, Let me now go to the field and glean ears of grain after [him] in whose sight I shall find grace. And she said to her, Go, my daughter.

title: Ruth 2:3
text: And she went. And she came and gleaned in the field after the reapers. And she happened to come upon a part of the field of Boaz, who [was] of the kindred of Elimelech.

title: Ruth 2:4
text: And behold, Boaz came from Bethlehem and said to the reapers, The LORD [be] with you. And they answered him, The LORD bless you.

title: Ruth 2:5
text: And Boaz said to his servant who was set over the reapers, Whose girl [is] this?

title: Ruth 2:6
text: And the servant who was set over the reapers answered and said, It [is] the girl from Moab who came back with Naomi out of the country of Moab.

title: Ruth 2:7
text: And she said, Please let me glean and gather after the reapers among the sheaves. And she came, and has kept on from the morning until now, but that she stayed a little in the house.

title: Ruth 2:8
text: And Boaz said to Ruth, Do you not hear, my daughter? Do not go to glean in another field, neither go away from here, but stay here close by my maidens.

title: Ruth 2:9
text: [Let] your eyes [be] on the field that they reap, and go after them. Have I not commanded the young men that they shall not touch you? And when you are thirsty, go to the vessels and drink of that which the young men have drawn.

title: Ruth 2:10
text: Then she fell on her face and bowed herself to the ground, and said to him, Why have I found grace in your eyes, that you should take notice of me, since I [am] a stranger?

title: Ruth 2:11
text: And Boaz answered and said to her, It has been fully shown to me all that you have done to your mother-in-law since the death of your husband, And you left your father and your mother and the land of your birth, and have come to a people whom you did not know before now.

title: Ruth 2:12
text: May the LORD repay your work, and may a full reward be given you from the LORD God of Israel, under whose wings you have come to trust.

title: Ruth 2:13
text: Then she said, Let me find favor in your sight, my lord, for you have comforted me; for you have spoken kindly to your handmaid, though I am not like one of your handmaidens.

title: Ruth 2:14
text: And Boaz said to her, At mealtime come here and eat of the bread and dip your bit in the vinegar. And she sat beside the reapers. And he handed her roasted [grain], and she ate and was satisfied, and left.

title: Ruth 2:15
text: And when she had risen up to glean, Boaz commanded his young men saying, Let her glean even among the sheaves, and do not rebuke her.

title: Ruth 2:16
text: And also let fall of the handfuls on purpose for her, and leave them so that she may glean [them], and do not rebuke her.

title: Ruth 2:17
text: And she gleaned in the field until the evening, and beat out what she had gleaned. And it was about an ephah of barley.

title: Ruth 2:18
text: And she took [it] up and went into the city. And her mother-in-law saw what she had gleaned. And she brought it forth, and gave to her what she had kept after she was satisfied.

title: Ruth 2:19
text: And her mother-in-law said to her, Where have you gleaned today? And where did you work? Blessed is he who took notice of you. And she told her mother-in-law with whom she had worked, and said, The man's name with whom I worked today [is]  Boaz.

title: Ruth 2:20
text: And Naomi said to her daughter-in-law, Blessed [is] he of the LORD, who has not left off his kindness to the living and to the dead. And Naomi said to her, The man [is] near of kin to us, he is of our redeemers.

title: Ruth 2:21
text: And Ruth of Moab said, He said to me also, You shall keep close by my young men whom I have until they have ended all my harvest.

title: Ruth 2:22
text: And Naomi said to her daughter-in-law Ruth, Good, my daughter. You go out with his maidens so that they do not fall upon you in any other field.

title: Ruth 2:23
text: And she kept close by the maidens of Boaz to glean until the end of barley harvest and of wheat harvest. And she lived with her mother-in-law.

title: Ruth 3:1
text: And her mother-in-law Naomi said to her, My daughter, shall I not seek rest for you so that it may be well with you?

title: Ruth 3:2
text: And now [is] not Boaz of our kindred, he with whose maidens you were? Behold, he winnows barley tonight in the threshing-floor.

title: Ruth 3:3
text: Therefore wash yourself, and anoint yourself, and put your clothing upon you, and go down to the floor. Do not make yourself known to the man until he has finished eating and drinking.

title: Ruth 3:4
text: And when he lies down, you mark the place where he lies, and you shall go in and uncover his feet and lie down. And he will tell you what you shall do.

title: Ruth 3:5
text: And she said to her, All that you say, I will do.

title: Ruth 3:6
text: And she went down to the grain floor and did according to all that her mother-in-law had told her.

title: Ruth 3:7
text: And when Boaz had eaten and had drunk, and his heart was merry, he went to lie down at the end of the heap. And she came softly and uncovered his feet, and lay down.

title: Ruth 3:8
text: And it happened at midnight, the man trembled and turned himself. And, behold, a woman lay at his feet.

title: Ruth 3:9
text: And he said, Who [are] you? And she answered, I [am] your handmaid Ruth. And you shall spread your skirt over your handmaid, for you [are] a kinsman-redeemer.

title: Ruth 3:10
text: And He said, Blessed [be] you of the LORD, my daughter. You have shown more kindness in the latter end than at the beginning, in that you did not follow young men, whether poor or rich.

title: Ruth 3:11
text: And now, my daughter, do not fear. I will do to you all that you ask. For all the city of my people knows that you [are] a woman of virtue.

title: Ruth 3:12
text: And now it is true that I [am] your kinsman-redeemer. But there is also a kinsman nearer than I.

title: Ruth 3:13
text: Stay tonight, and it shall be in the morning, if he will redeem you, well; he will redeem. And if he does not delight to redeem you, [as] the LORD lives, then I will redeem you. Lie down until the morning.

title: Ruth 3:14
text: And she lay at his feet until the morning. And she rose up before one could know another. And he said, Do not let it be known that a woman came to the floor.

title: Ruth 3:15
text: Also, he said, Bring the veil on you, and hold it. And when she held it, he measured six [measures] of barley and laid it on her. And she went to the city.

title: Ruth 3:16
text: And when she came to her mother-in-law, she said, Who [are] you, my daughter? And she told her all that the man had done to her.

title: Ruth 3:17
text: And she said, These six [measures] of barley he gave to me. For he said to me, Do not go empty to your mother-in-law.

title: Ruth 3:18
text: And she said, Sit still, my daughter, until you know how the matter will fall. For the man will not rest until he has finished the thing today.

title: Ruth 4:1
text: And Boaz went up to the gate and sat down there. And behold, the kinsman of whom Boaz spoke came by. And he said, Such a one! Turn aside, sit down here. And he turned aside and sat down.

title: Ruth 4:2
text: And he took ten men of the elders of the city and said, Come sit down here. And they sat down.

title: Ruth 4:3
text: And he said to the kinsman, Naomi, who has come again out of the country of Moab, sells a parcel of land which [was] our brother Elimelech's.

title: Ruth 4:4
text: And I said I will tell it in your ear, saying, Buy [it] before those who live here, and before the elders of my people. If you will redeem, redeem [it]. But if you will not redeem, tell me so that I may know. For there is none to redeem besides you. And I am after you. And he said, I will redeem.

title: Ruth 4:5
text: And Boaz said, In the day you buy the field from the hand of Naomi, you must buy also from the hand of Ruth of Moab, the wife of the dead, to raise up the name of the dead upon his inheritance.

title: Ruth 4:6
text: And the kinsman said, I cannot redeem for myself, lest I mar my own inheritance. You redeem my right to yourself, for I cannot redeem.

title: Ruth 4:7
text: And this [was the custom] in former times in Israel concerning redeeming and concerning changing, to confirm everything. A man plucked off his sandal and gave it to his neighbor. And this was a testimony in Israel.

title: Ruth 4:8
text: Therefore the kinsman said to Boaz, Buy [it] for yourself. So he drew off his sandal.

title: Ruth 4:9
text: And Boaz said to the elders and all the people, You [are] witnesses this day that I have bought all that [was] Elimelech's and all that was Chilion's and Mahlon's, from the hand of Naomi.

title: Ruth 4:10
text: And also Ruth of Moab, the wife of Mahlon, I have purchased to be my wife, to raise up the name of the dead on his inheritance, so that the name of the dead may not be cut off from among his brothers and from the gate of his place. You [ are] witnesses this day.

title: Ruth 4:11
text: And all the people in the gate, and the elders, said, We [are] witnesses. May the LORD make the woman who has come into your house like Rachel and like Leah, for these two built the house of Israel. And may you be blessed in Ephratah, and be famous in Bethlehem.

title: Ruth 4:12
text: And let your house be like the house of Pharez, whom Tamar bore to Judah, of the seed which the LORD shall give you of this young woman.

title: Ruth 4:13
text: And Boaz took Ruth, and she was his wife. And when he went in to her, the LORD made her conceive. And she bore a son.

title: Ruth 4:14
text: And the women said to Naomi, Blessed [be] the LORD, who has not left you this day without a redeemer, so that his name may be famous in Israel.

title: Ruth 4:15
text: And he shall be to you as a restorer of life, and one who cheers your old age. For your daughter-in-law who loves you has borne him, she who is better to you than seven sons.

title: Ruth 4:16
text: And Naomi took the child and laid it in her bosom, and became nurse to it.

title: Ruth 4:17
text: And the women, her neighbors, gave it a name, saying, There is a son born to Naomi. And they called his name Obed. He [is] the father of Jesse, the father of David.

title: Ruth 4:18
text: And these [are] the generations of Pharez. Pharez fathered Hezron,

title: Ruth 4:19
text: and Hezron fathered Ram, and Ram fathered Amminadab,

title: Ruth 4:20
text: and Amminadab fathered Nahshon, and Nahshon fathered Salmon,

title: Ruth 4:21
text: and Salmon fathered Boaz, and Boaz fathered Obed,

title: Ruth 4:22
text: and Obed fathered Jesse, and Jesse fathered David.

title: I Samuel 1:1
text: And there was a certain man of Ramathaim-zophim from the hills of Ephraim, and his name [was] Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephrathite.

title: I Samuel 1:2
text: And he had two wives, the name of the one [was] Hannah, and the name of the second, Peninnah. And Peninnah had children, but Hannah had no children.

title: I Samuel 1:3
text: And this man went up out of his city from year to year, to worship and to sacrifice to the LORD of hosts in Shiloh. And the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, the priests of the LORD, [were] there.

title: I Samuel 1:4
text: And the time came that Elkanah offered, he gave portions to Peninnah his wife, and to all her sons and her daughters.

title: I Samuel 1:5
text: But to Hannah he gave one double portion, for he loved Hannah. But the LORD had shut up her womb.

title: I Samuel 1:6
text: And her foe also provoked her grievously, in order to make her tremble, because the LORD had shut up her womb.

title: I Samuel 1:7
text: And [as] he did so year by year, when she went up to the house of the LORD, so she provoked her. And she wept and did not eat.

title: I Samuel 1:8
text: And Elkanah her husband said to her, Hannah, why do you weep? And why do you not eat? And why is your heart grieved? [Am] I not better to you than ten sons?

title: I Samuel 1:9
text: And Hannah rose up after they had eaten in Shiloh and after they had drunk. And Eli the priest sat on the seat by the side post of the temple of the LORD.

title: I Samuel 1:10
text: And she [was] in bitterness of soul, and prayed to the LORD, and wept sorely.

title: I Samuel 1:11
text: And she vowed a vow and said, O, Lord of hosts, if You will indeed look upon the affliction of Your handmaid and remember me, and not forget Your handmaid, but will give to Your handmaid a man-child, then I will give him to the LORD all the days of his life, and there shall no razor come upon his head.

title: I Samuel 1:12
text: And it happened as she continued praying before the LORD, Eli noticed her mouth.

title: I Samuel 1:13
text: Now Hannah spoke in her heart, only her lips moved, but her voice was not heard. And Eli thought she had become drunk.

title: I Samuel 1:14
text: And Eli said to her, How long will you be drunken? Put away your wine from you!

title: I Samuel 1:15
text: And Hannah answered, No, my lord, I [am] a woman of a sorrowful spirit. I have neither drunk wine nor strong drink, but have poured out my soul before the LORD.

title: I Samuel 1:16
text: Do not count your handmaid for a daughter of wickedness, for out of the abundance of my meditation and grief I have spoken until now.

title: I Samuel 1:17
text: And Eli answered and said, Go in peace, and the God of Israel grant [to you] your petition that you have asked of Him.

title: I Samuel 1:18
text: And she said, Let your handmaid find grace in your sight. So the woman went her way and ate, and her face was no longer [sad].

title: I Samuel 1:19
text: And they rose up in the morning early, and worshiped before the LORD, and returned, and came to their house to Ramah. And Elkanah knew Hannah his wife, and the LORD remembered her.

title: I Samuel 1:20
text: And it happened when the time had come around, Hannah conceived and bore a son and called his name Samuel, [saying], Because I have asked him of the LORD.

title: I Samuel 1:21
text: And the man Elkanah and all his house went up to offer to the LORD the yearly sacrifice and his vow.

title: I Samuel 1:22
text: But Hannah did not go up. For she said to her husband, Until the child is weaned, and then I will bring him so that he may appear before the LORD and stay there forever.

title: I Samuel 1:23
text: And Elkanah her husband said to her, Do what seems good to you. Stay until you have weaned him. Only may the LORD establish His word. So the woman stayed and gave her son suck until she weaned him.

title: I Samuel 1:24
text: And when she had weaned him, she took him up with her, with three bulls and one ephah of flour, and a skin of wine, and brought him to the house of the LORD in Shiloh. And the child [was] young.

title: I Samuel 1:25
text: And they killed a bull, and brought the child to Eli.

title: I Samuel 1:26
text: And she said, O, my lord, [as] your soul lives, my lord, I [am] the woman who stood by you here, praying to the LORD.

title: I Samuel 1:27
text: For this boy I was praying, and the LORD has given me my petition which I asked of Him.

title: I Samuel 1:28
text: And I have returned him to the LORD. As long as he lives, he shall be given to the LORD. And he worshiped the LORD there.

title: I Samuel 2:1
text: And Hannah prayed and said, My heart rejoices in the LORD, my horn is exalted in the LORD. My mouth is enlarged over my enemies because I rejoice in Your salvation.

title: I Samuel 2:2
text: [There is] none holy as the LORD, for there is none beside You. Neither [is there] any rock like our God.

title: I Samuel 2:3
text: Talk no more so very proudly. Remove arrogance out of your mouth, for the LORD is a God of knowledge, and by Him actions are weighed.

title: I Samuel 2:4
text: The bows of the mighty [are] broken, and they that stumbled are girded with strength.

title: I Samuel 2:5
text: [They that were] full have hired themselves out for bread, and they that were hungry ceased; yea, while the barren has borne seven, and she who had many sons has languished.

title: I Samuel 2:6
text: The LORD kills and makes alive. He brings down to Sheol, and brings up.

title: I Samuel 2:7
text: The LORD takes away, and He gives riches; He brings low; yea, He lifts up high.

title: I Samuel 2:8
text: He raises up the poor out of the dust; He lifts up the needy from the dunghill to set [them] among princes; yea, He causes them to inherit a throne of honor; for to the LORD [are] the pillars of the earth; and He sets the habitable world on them.

title: I Samuel 2:9
text: He keeps the feet of his saints, and the wicked are silenced in darkness; for by strength shall no man prevail.

title: I Samuel 2:10
text: The foes of the LORD shall be broken to pieces. He thunders in the heavens upon them. The LORD shall judge the ends of the earth. And He shall give strength to His king, and exalts the horn of His anointed.

title: I Samuel 2:11
text: And Elkanah went to Ramah to his house. And the child served the LORD before Eli the priest.

title: I Samuel 2:12
text: And the sons of Eli [were] sons of Belial. They did not know the LORD.

title: I Samuel 2:13
text: And the priests' custom with the people [was]: If any man offered sacrifice, the priest's servant came while the flesh was boiling, with a flesh-hook of three teeth in his hand.

title: I Samuel 2:14
text: And [he] stuck [it] into the pan or kettle or caldron or pot. All that the flesh-hook brought up the priest took for himself. So they did in Shiloh to all the Israelites that came there.

title: I Samuel 2:15
text: Yea, before they burned the fat, the priest's servant came and said to the man who sacrificed, Give flesh to roast for the priest. For he will not have boiled flesh from you, but raw!

title: I Samuel 2:16
text: And [if] any man said to him, Let them not fail to burn the fat at once, and then take as your soul desires, then he would answer him, No! But you shall give now! And if not, I will take it by force.

title: I Samuel 2:17
text: And the sin of the young men was very great before the LORD. For men despised the offering of the LORD.

title: I Samuel 2:18
text: And Samuel served before the LORD, a child girded [with] a linen ephod.

title: I Samuel 2:19
text: And his mother made him a little coat, and brought [it] to him from year to year when she came up with her husband to offer the yearly sacrifice.

title: I Samuel 2:20
text: And Eli blessed Elkanah and his wife, and said, May the LORD give you seed of this woman for the loan which is loaned to the LORD. And they went to their own home.

title: I Samuel 2:21
text: And the LORD visited Hannah so that she conceived, and she bore three sons and two daughters. And the child Samuel grew before the LORD.

title: I Samuel 2:22
text: And Eli was very old, and heard all that his sons did to all Israel, and how they lay with the women who gathered [at] the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

title: I Samuel 2:23
text: And he said to them, Why do you do such things? For I hear of your evil dealings by all the people.

title: I Samuel 2:24
text: No, my sons, for [it is] no good report that I hear. You make the LORD's people to transgress.

title: I Samuel 2:25
text: If one man sins against another, the judge shall judge him. But if a man sins against the LORD, who shall plead for him? But they did not listen to the voice of their father, because the LORD desired to kill them.

title: I Samuel 2:26
text: And the child Samuel went on [growing] both in stature and in good [looks], both with the LORD and also with men.

title: I Samuel 2:27
text: And there came a man of God to Eli, and said to him, So says the LORD: Did I plainly appear to the house of your father when they were in Egypt in Pharaoh's house?

title: I Samuel 2:28
text: And did I choose him out of all the tribes of Israel [to be] My priest, to offer upon My altar, to burn incense, to wear an ephod before Me? And did I give to the house of your father all the offerings made by fire from the sons of Israel?

title: I Samuel 2:29
text: Why do you kick at My sacrifice and My offering, which I have commanded [in My] house? [Do you] honor your sons above Me, to make yourselves fat with the best of all the offerings of Israel My people?

title: I Samuel 2:30
text: And the LORD God of Israel says, I said indeed, Your house and the house of your father should walk before Me forever. But now the LORD says, Be it far from Me! For those who honor Me I will honor, and those that think little of Me shall be lightly regarded.

title: I Samuel 2:31
text: Behold, the days come when I will cut off your arm and the arm of your father's house, so that no old man shall be in your house.

title: I Samuel 2:32
text: And you shall see an adversary [in My] house, in all the good which he does with Israel. And there shall not be an old man in your house forever.

title: I Samuel 2:33
text: And that man of yours [whom] I shall not cut off from My altar, shall be left in order to make your eyes fail, and to grieve your heart. And all the increase of your house shall die [young] men.

title: I Samuel 2:34
text: And this [shall be] a sign to you, which shall come upon your two sons, on Hophni and Phinehas; in one day both of them shall die.

title: I Samuel 2:35
text: And I will raise up a faithful priest to Myself, one who shall do according to what [is] in My heart and in My mind. And I will build him a sure house, and he shall walk before My anointed forever.

title: I Samuel 2:36
text: And it shall be that everyone who is left in your house shall come [and] bow down to him for a piece of silver and a piece of bread. And [they] shall say, Please put me into one of the priests' offices so that I may eat a piece of bread.

title: I Samuel 3:1
text: And the child Samuel served the LORD before Eli. And the word of the LORD was precious in those days. [There was] no open vision.

title: I Samuel 3:2
text: And it happened at that time, when Eli [was] lying down in his place, and his eyes began to become dim so that he could not see.

title: I Samuel 3:3
text: And the lamp of God had not gone out. And Samuel was lying down in the temple of the LORD, where the ark of God [was].

title: I Samuel 3:4
text: And the LORD called Samuel. And he answered, Here [am] I.

title: I Samuel 3:5
text: And he ran to Eli, and said, Here [am] I. For you called me. And he said, I did not call. Go and lie down again. And he went to lie down.

title: I Samuel 3:6
text: And the LORD called again, Samuel! And Samuel arose and went to Eli and said, Here [am] I, for you called me. And he answered, I did not call, my son. Go back, lie down.

title: I Samuel 3:7
text: And Samuel did not yet know the LORD, and the word of the LORD had not yet been revealed to him.

title: I Samuel 3:8
text: And the LORD called Samuel again, the third time. And he arose and went to Eli and said, Here [am] I, for you called me. And Eli saw that the LORD had called the child.

title: I Samuel 3:9
text: And Eli said to Samuel, Go, lie down; and it shall be, if [One] calls you, you shall say, Speak, LORD, for Your servant hears. And Samuel went to lie down in his place.

title: I Samuel 3:10
text: And the LORD came and stood, and called as at other times, Samuel, Samuel! Then Samuel answered, Speak, for Your servant hears.

title: I Samuel 3:11
text: And the LORD said to Samuel, Behold, I will do a thing in Israel at which both the ears of everyone who hears it shall tingle.

title: I Samuel 3:12
text: In that day I will confirm to Eli all that which I have spoken as to his house, beginning and making an end.

title: I Samuel 3:13
text: For I have told him that I will judge his house forever for the iniquity which he knows, because his sons made themselves vile and he did not restrain them.

title: I Samuel 3:14
text: And therefore I have sworn to the house of Eli that the iniquity of Eli's house shall not be purged with sacrifice nor offering forever.

title: I Samuel 3:15
text: And Samuel lay until morning, and opened the doors of the house of the LORD. And Samuel feared to show Eli the vision.

title: I Samuel 3:16
text: And Eli called Samuel and said, Samuel, my son. And he answered, Here [am] I.

title: I Samuel 3:17
text: And he said, What [is] the word which He has said to you? Please do not hide [it] from me. God do so to you, and more also, if you hide a thing from me of all the words that He said to you.

title: I Samuel 3:18
text: And Samuel told him all the words, and hid nothing from him. And he said, It [is] the LORD; let Him do what seems good to Him.

title: I Samuel 3:19
text: And Samuel grew, and the LORD was with him and let none of his words fall to the ground.

title: I Samuel 3:20
text: And all Israel, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, knew that Samuel [was] established to be a prophet of the LORD.

title: I Samuel 3:21
text: And the LORD appeared again in Shiloh. For the LORD revealed himself to Samuel in Shiloh by the word of the LORD.

title: I Samuel 4:1
text: And the word of Samuel was [revealed] to all Israel. And Israel went out against the Philistines to battle, and pitched beside Ebenezer. And the Philistines pitched in Aphek.

title: I Samuel 4:2
text: And the Philistines put themselves in order against Israel. And the battle was joined. And Israel was beaten before the Philistines. And they killed about four thousand men of the army in the field.

title: I Samuel 4:3
text: And when the people had come to the camp, the elders of Israel said, Why has the LORD beaten us today before the Philistines? Let us bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of Shiloh to us, so that when it comes among us it may save us out of the hand of our enemies.

title: I Samuel 4:4
text: And the people sent to Shiloh in order to bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD of hosts from there, [the ark] which dwells [between] the cherubs. And the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were there with the ark of the covenant of God.

title: I Samuel 4:5
text: And it happened when the ark of the covenant of the LORD came into camp, all Israel shouted with a great shout, so that the earth rang again.

title: I Samuel 4:6
text: And when the Philistines heard the noise of the shout, they said, What is the noise of this great shout in the camp of the Hebrews? And they saw that the ark of the LORD had come into the camp.

title: I Samuel 4:7
text: And the Philistines were afraid, for they said, God has come into the camp, And they said, Woe to us! For there has not been a thing like this before.

title: I Samuel 4:8
text: Woe to us! Who shall deliver us out of the hand of these mighty gods? These [are] the gods that struck the Egyptians with all the plagues in the wilderness.

title: I Samuel 4:9
text: Be strong and fight like men, O, Philistines, so that you may not be servants to the Hebrews, [as] they have been to you. Be men and fight!

title: I Samuel 4:10
text: And the Philistines fought, and Israel was beaten, and each one of them fled into his tent. And there was a very great slaughter, for there fell thirty thousand footmen of Israel.

title: I Samuel 4:11
text: And the ark of God was taken. And Hophni and Phinehas, the two sons of Eli, were slain.

title: I Samuel 4:12
text: And a man of Benjamin ran out of the army. And he came to Shiloh the same day with his clothes torn and with earth upon his head.

title: I Samuel 4:13
text: And he came in, and behold, Eli sat on a seat by the wayside watching. For his heart trembled for the ark of God. And when the man came into the city and told [it], all the city cried out.

title: I Samuel 4:14
text: And when Eli heard the noise of the crying, he said, What [is] the noise of this tumult? And the man hurried in and told Eli.

title: I Samuel 4:15
text: And Eli was ninety-eight years old, and his eyes were set so that he could not see.

title: I Samuel 4:16
text: And the man said to Eli, I [am] he who came out of the army, and I fled today out of the army. And he said, How did the matter go, my son?

title: I Samuel 4:17
text: And the messenger answered and said, Israel has fled before the Philistines, and there has been a great slaughter among the people also. And also your two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, are dead, and the ark of God is taken.

title: I Samuel 4:18
text: And it happened when he spoke of the ark of God, he fell backward off the seat, by the side of the gate. And his neck broke, and he died, for he was an old man, and heavy. And he had judged Israel forty years.

title: I Samuel 4:19
text: And his daughter-in-law, Phinehas' wife, was with child, ready to be delivered. And when she heard the report that the ark of God was taken, and that her father-in-law and her husband were dead, she bowed herself and travailed, for her pains came upon her.

title: I Samuel 4:20
text: And about the time of her death the women that stood by her said to her, Do not fear, for you have borne a son. But she did not answer, nor set her heart.

title: I Samuel 4:21
text: And she named the child Ichabod, saying, The glory has departed from Israel, because the ark of God had been taken, and because of her father-in-law and her husband.

title: I Samuel 4:22
text: And she said, The glory has departed from Israel, for the ark of God is taken.

title: I Samuel 5:1
text: And the Philistines took the ark of God, and brought it from Ebenezer to Ashdod.

title: I Samuel 5:2
text: And the Philistines took the ark of God and brought it into the house of Dagon, and set it beside Dagon.

title: I Samuel 5:3
text: And when those of Ashdod arose early on the next day, behold, Dagon [had] fallen upon his face to the earth before the ark of the LORD. And they took Dagon and set him in his place again.

title: I Samuel 5:4
text: And when they arose early on the next morning, behold, Dagon [had] fallen on his face to the earth before the ark of the LORD. And the head of Dagon, and both the palms of his hands, [were] cut off upon the threshold. Only the stump of Dagon was left to him.

title: I Samuel 5:5
text: And neither the priests of Dagon, nor any that come into Dagon's house, tread on the threshold of Dagon in Ashdod to this day.

title: I Samuel 5:6
text: And the hand of the LORD was heavy on the people of Ashdod, and He destroyed them and struck them with hemorrhoids, Ashdod and its borders.

title: I Samuel 5:7
text: And the men of Ashdod saw that [it was] so. And they said, The ark of the God of Israel shall not stay with us. For His hand is sore upon us and upon Dagon our god.

title: I Samuel 5:8
text: And they sent and gathered all the lords of the Philistines to them. And they said, What shall we do with the ark of the God of Israel? And they answered, Let the ark of the God of Israel be carried around to Gath. And they carried the ark of the God of Israel around.

title: I Samuel 5:9
text: And it happened after they had carried it around, the hand of the LORD was against the city [with] a very great destruction. And He struck the men of the city, both small and great, and hemorrhoids broke forth in them.

title: I Samuel 5:10
text: And it happened that they sent the ark of God [to] Ekron. And it happened as the ark of God came to Ekron, the Ekronites cried out, saying, They have brought around the ark of the God of Israel to us in order to kill us and our people.

title: I Samuel 5:11
text: And they sent and gathered all the lords of the Philistines, and said, Send away the ark of the God of Israel, and let it go again to its own place, so that it does not kill us and our people. For there was a deadly destruction throughout all the city. The hand of God was very heavy there.

title: I Samuel 5:12
text: And the men that did not die were stricken with the hemorrhoids. And the cry of the city went up to the heavens.

title: I Samuel 6:1
text: And the ark of the LORD was in the field of the Philistines seven months.

title: I Samuel 6:2
text: And the Philistines called for the priests and the diviners, saying, What shall we do to the ark of the LORD? Tell us with what we shall send with it to its place.

title: I Samuel 6:3
text: And they said, If you send away the ark of the God of Israel, do not send it empty. For you shall certainly send a guilt offering to him. Then you shall be healed, and it shall be known to you why His hand is not removed from you.

title: I Samuel 6:4
text: And they said, What [shall be] the guilt offering which we shall return to Him? And they answered, Five golden hemorrhoids, and five golden mice, for the number of the lords of the Philistines. For one plague [was] on you all, and on your lords.

title: I Samuel 6:5
text: And you shall make images of your hemorrhoids, and images of your mice which mar the land. And you shall give glory to the God of Israel. Perhaps He will lighten His hand from off you, and from off your gods, and from off your land.

title: I Samuel 6:6
text: And why do you harden your hearts, as the Egyptians and Pharaoh hardened their hearts? When He had worked wonderfully among them, did they not let the people go, and did they not depart?

title: I Samuel 6:7
text: And now make a new cart, and take two milk cows on which there has come no yoke, and tie the cows to the cart, and bring their calves home from them.

title: I Samuel 6:8
text: And take the ark of the LORD and lay it on the cart. And put the jewels of gold which you return to Him [for] a trespass offering in a box in its side. And send it away so that it may go.

title: I Samuel 6:9
text: And watch. If it goes up by the way of its own border to Beth-shemesh, He has done us this great evil. But if not, then we shall know that [it is] not His hand that struck us. It was a chance that happened to us.

title: I Samuel 6:10
text: And the men did so. And they took two milk cows and tied them to the cart, and shut up their calves at home.

title: I Samuel 6:11
text: And they laid the ark of the LORD on the cart, and the box [with] the mice of gold and the images of their hemorrhoids.

title: I Samuel 6:12
text: And the cows took the straight way to the way of Beth-shemesh, going along the highway, lowing as they went. And they did not turn aside [to] the right or to the left. And the lords of the Philistines went after them to the border of Beth-shemesh.

title: I Samuel 6:13
text: And [the people] of Beth-shemesh [were] reaping their wheat harvest in the valley. And they lifted up their eyes and saw the ark, and rejoiced to see [it].

title: I Samuel 6:14
text: And the cart came into the field of Joshua, a Bethshemite, and stood there and there was a great stone. And they cut the wood of the cart and offered the cows as a burnt offering to the LORD.

title: I Samuel 6:15
text: And the Levites took down the ark of the LORD and the box in it, in which the jewels of gold were, and put [them] on the great stone. And the men of Beth-shemesh offered burnt offerings and sacrificed sacrifices the same day to the LORD.

title: I Samuel 6:16
text: And when the five lords of the Philistines had seen, they returned [to] Ekron on that day.

title: I Samuel 6:17
text: And these [are] the golden hemorrhoids which the Philistines returned [for] a guilt offering to the LORD: for Ashdod, one; for Gaza, one; for Askelon one; for Gath, one; for Ekron, one.

title: I Samuel 6:18
text: And the golden mice were [according to] the number of all the cities of the Philistines for the five lords, of fortified cities and of country villages, even to the great meadow on which they set down the ark of the LORD to this day, in the field of Joshua the Bethshemite.

title: I Samuel 6:19
text: And He struck the men of Beth-shemesh because they had looked into the ark of the LORD. He even struck seventy among the people, [including] fifty chief men. And the people lamented because the LORD had struck the people with a great slaughter.

title: I Samuel 6:20
text: And the men of Beth-shemesh said, Who is able to stand before this holy LORD God? And to whom shall He go up from us?

title: I Samuel 6:21
text: And they sent messengers to the people of Kirjath-jearim, saying, The Philistines have brought again the ark of the LORD. Come down [and] bring it up to yourselves.

title: I Samuel 7:1
text: And the men of Kirjath-jearim came and brought up the ark of the LORD, and brought it into the house of Abinadab in the hill. And they sanctified Eleazar his son to keep the ark of the LORD.

title: I Samuel 7:2
text: And it happened from the day the ark [began] to dwell in Kirjath-jearim, the days became many; yea, they were twenty years. And all the house of Israel yearned after the LORD.

title: I Samuel 7:3
text: And Samuel spoke to all the house of Israel saying, If you return to the LORD with all your hearts, then put away the strange gods and Ashtaroth from among you, and prepare your hearts to the LORD, and serve Him only. And He will deliver you out of the hand of the Philistines.

title: I Samuel 7:4
text: And the sons of Israel put away the Baals and the Ashtaroth, and served the LORD only.

title: I Samuel 7:5
text: And Samuel said, Gather all Israel to Mizpeh, and I will pray for you to the LORD.

title: I Samuel 7:6
text: And they were gathered to Mizpeh, and drew water, and poured out before the LORD, and fasted on that day, and said there, We have sinned against the LORD. And Samuel judged the sons of Israel in Mizpeh.

title: I Samuel 7:7
text: And the Philistines heard that the sons of Israel had come together to Mizpeh. And the lords of the Philistines went up against Israel. And the sons of Israel heard, and they were afraid of the Philistines.

title: I Samuel 7:8
text: And the sons of Israel said to Samuel, Do not cease from crying to the LORD our God for us, so that He will save us out of the hand of the Philistines.

title: I Samuel 7:9
text: And Samuel took a suckling lamb, and offered a whole burnt offering to the LORD. And Samuel cried to the LORD for Israel, and the LORD answered him.

title: I Samuel 7:10
text: And it happened [as] Samuel was offering up the burnt offering, the Philistines drew near to battle against Israel. But the LORD thundered with a great noise on that day on the Philistines, and troubled them. And they were beaten before Israel.

title: I Samuel 7:11
text: And the men of Israel went out of Mizpeh, and pursued the Philistines, and struck them as far as below Beth-car.

title: I Samuel 7:12
text: And Samuel took a stone and set [it] between Mizpeh and Shen, and called the name of it Ebenezer, saying, The LORD has helped us until now.

title: I Samuel 7:13
text: And the Philistines were beaten, and they did not come any more into the border of Israel. And the hand of the LORD was against the Philistines all the days of Samuel.

title: I Samuel 7:14
text: And the cities which the Philistines had taken from Israel were given back to Israel, from Ekron even to Gath. And Israel delivered its borders out of the hand of the Philistines. And there was peace between Israel and the Amorites.

title: I Samuel 7:15
text: And Samuel judged Israel all the days of his life.

title: I Samuel 7:16
text: And he went from year to year in a circuit to Bethel and Gilgal and Mizpeh, and judged Israel [in] all those places.

title: I Samuel 7:17
text: And his return [was] to Ramah, for his house [was] there. And he judged Israel there. And he built an altar there to the LORD.

title: I Samuel 8:1
text: And it happened when Samuel was old, he made his sons judges over Israel.

title: I Samuel 8:2
text: And the name of his first-born was Joel, and the name of his second was Abiah, judges in Beer-sheba.

title: I Samuel 8:3
text: And his sons did not walk in his ways, but turned aside after ill gain and took bribes and perverted judgment.

title: I Samuel 8:4
text: And all the elders of Israel gathered themselves and came to Samuel to Ramah.

title: I Samuel 8:5
text: And [they] said to him, Behold, you are old, and your sons do not walk in your ways. Now make us a king to judge us like all the nations.

title: I Samuel 8:6
text: But the thing was evil in the eyes of Samuel, when they said, Give us a king to judge us. And Samuel prayed to the LORD.

title: I Samuel 8:7
text: And the LORD said to Samuel, Listen to the voice of the people in all that they say to you. For they have not rejected you, but they have rejected Me, that I should not reign over them.

title: I Samuel 8:8
text: According to all the works which they have done since the day that I brought them up out of Egypt even until this day--[works] with which they have forsaken Me and served other gods-- so they do also to you.

title: I Samuel 8:9
text: And now listen to their voice. Only, you shall surely protest solemnly to them, and show them the kind of king who shall reign over them.

title: I Samuel 8:10
text: And Samuel told all the words of the LORD to the people who asked a king of him.

title: I Samuel 8:11
text: And he said, This will be the privilege of the king who shall reign over you. He shall take your sons and appoint [them] for himself, for his chariots, and his horsemen. And they shall run before his chariots.

title: I Samuel 8:12
text: And [he] will appoint commanders over thousands, and commanders over fifties, and some to plow his ground and reap his harvest, and make his weapons of war and weapons for his chariots.

title: I Samuel 8:13
text: And he will take your daughters [to be] perfumers and cooks and bakers.

title: I Samuel 8:14
text: And he will take your fields and your vineyards and your olive-yards, the best, and give [them] to his servants.

title: I Samuel 8:15
text: And he will take the tenth of your seed and of your vineyards, and give [it] to his eunuchs and to his servants.

title: I Samuel 8:16
text: And he will take your male slaves and your slave girls, and your finest young men, and your asses, and put [them] to his work.

title: I Samuel 8:17
text: He will take the tenth of your sheep, and you shall be his servants.

title: I Samuel 8:18
text: And you shall cry out in that day because of your king whom you have chosen for yourselves, and the LORD will not answer you in that day.

title: I Samuel 8:19
text: But the people refused to obey the voice of Samuel. And they said, No, but we will have a king over us.

title: I Samuel 8:20
text: And we shall be, also we, like all the nations, so that our king may judge us and go out before us and fight our battles.

title: I Samuel 8:21
text: And Samuel heard all the words of the people, and he repeated them in the ears of the LORD.

title: I Samuel 8:22
text: And the LORD said to Samuel, Listen to their voice, and make them a king. And Samuel said to the men of Israel, Every man go to his city.

title: I Samuel 9:1
text: And there was a man of Benjamin, and his name [was] Kish, the son of Abiel, the son of Zeror, the son of Bechorath, the son of Aphiah, a Benjamite, a mighty man of power.

title: I Samuel 9:2
text: And he had a son named Saul, a young and handsome one. And there was not a man among the sons of Israel more handsome than he, being taller than any of the people from his shoulder and upward.

title: I Samuel 9:3
text: And the asses of Kish, Saul's father, were lost. And Kish said to Saul his son, Please take one of the servants with you and rise, and go look for the asses.

title: I Samuel 9:4
text: And he passed through mount Ephraim, and passed through the land of Shalisha, but they did not find [them]. And they passed through the land of Shaalim, and nothing there. And he passed through the land of Benjamin, but they did not find [them].

title: I Samuel 9:5
text: And they came to the land of Zuph, and Saul said to his servant who [was] with him, Come and let us return lest my father quit [caring] for the asses, and be anxious about us.

title: I Samuel 9:6
text: And he said to him, Behold now, in this city [is] a man of God, and an honorable man. All that he says surely comes to pass. Now let us go there. Perhaps he can declare our way to us, how to go.

title: I Samuel 9:7
text: Then Saul said to his young man, But behold, [if] we go, what shall we bring the man? For the bread in our vessels is gone, and [there is] no present to bring to the man of God. What do we have?

title: I Samuel 9:8
text: And the young man answered Saul again, and said, Behold, I have found the fourth of a shekel of silver. I will give it to the man of God to tell us our way.

title: I Samuel 9:9
text: (In the old days in Israel, when a man went to inquire of God, he said this: Come, let us go to the seer, for the prophet of today was before called a seer.)

title: I Samuel 9:10
text: And Saul said to his young man, Your word is good. Come, let us go. So they went into the city where the man of God [was].

title: I Samuel 9:11
text: [As] they went up the hill to the city, they found young women going out to draw water, and said to them, Is the seer here?

title: I Samuel 9:12
text: And they answered them and said, He is. Behold, [he is] before you. Hurry now, for he came today to the city, for [there is] a feast of the people today in the high place.

title: I Samuel 9:13
text: As you come to the city, you shall immediately find him before he goes up to the high place to eat. For the people will not eat until he comes, because he blesses the feast. Afterwards those who have been invited eat. And now go up, for about this time you shall find him.

title: I Samuel 9:14
text: And they went up into the city. When they had come into the middle of the city, behold, Samuel came out to meet them, to go up to the high place.

title: I Samuel 9:15
text: And the LORD had told Samuel in his ear a day before Saul came, saying,

title: I Samuel 9:16
text: Tomorrow about this time I will send you a man out of the land of Benjamin. And you shall anoint him [to be] leader over My people Israel, so that he may save My people out of the hand of the Philistines. For I have looked on My people because their cry has come to Me.

title: I Samuel 9:17
text: And when Samuel saw Saul, the LORD said to him, Behold the man of whom I spoke to you! This [one] shall reign over My people.

title: I Samuel 9:18
text: And Saul drew near to Samuel in the gate and said, Please tell me where the seer's house [is].

title: I Samuel 9:19
text: And Samuel answered Saul and said, I [am] the seer. Go up before me to the high place. For you shall eat with me today, and tomorrow I will let you go, and will tell you all that is in your heart.

title: I Samuel 9:20
text: And as to the asses [which were] lost to you three days ago, do not set your mind on them. For they are found. And on whom [is] all the desire of Israel? Is it not on you and on all your father's house?

title: I Samuel 9:21
text: And Saul answered and said, [Am] I not a Benjamite, of the smallest of the tribes of Israel? And [is] not my family the least of all the families of the tribe of Benjamin? Why then do you speak so to me?

title: I Samuel 9:22
text: And Samuel took Saul and his young man and brought them into the room, and gave them a place at the head of the invited ones, about thirty persons.

title: I Samuel 9:23
text: And Samuel said to the cook, Bring that part which I gave you, [of] which I said to you, Set it beside you.

title: I Samuel 9:24
text: And the cook took up the shoulder and that on it, and set [it] before Saul. And Samuel said, Behold that which is reserved! Set [it] before you [and] eat. For until this set time it has been kept for you, since I said, I have invited the people. And Saul ate with Samuel that day.

title: I Samuel 9:25
text: And they came down from the high place into the city, and he spoke with Saul on the top of the house.

title: I Samuel 9:26
text: And they arose early. And it happened about the spring of the day that Samuel called Saul to the top of the house, saying, Up, so that I may send you away. And Saul arose, and both of them went out, he and Samuel outside.

title: I Samuel 9:27
text: They were going down to the end of the city, and Samuel said to Saul, Tell the servant to pass on before us and pass on. And you stand still awhile, so that I may cause you to hear the word of God.

title: I Samuel 10:1
text: And Samuel took a vial of oil and poured on his head, and kissed him, and said, [Is it] not because the LORD has anointed you for a leader over His inheritance?

title: I Samuel 10:2
text: When you have departed from me today, then you shall find two men by Rachel's tomb in the border of Benjamin at Zelzah. And they will say to you, The asses which you went to seek are found. And, lo, your father has quit caring for the asses and sorrows for you, saying, What shall I do for my son?

title: I Samuel 10:3
text: And you shall go forward from there, and you shall come to the great tree of Tabor. And there you shall meet three men going up to God to Bethel, one carrying three kids, and another carrying three loaves of bread, and another carrying a skin of wine.

title: I Samuel 10:4
text: And they will greet you and give you two [loaves] of bread, which you shall take from their hand.

title: I Samuel 10:5
text: After that you shall come to the hill of God, where the garrison of the Philistines [is]. And it will happen to you when you come there to the city, even you shall meet a company of prophets coming down from the high place with a harp and a tambourine and a flute and a lyre before them. And they shall prophesy.

title: I Samuel 10:6
text: And the spirit of the LORD will come powerfully on you, and you shall prophesy with them, and shall be turned into another man.

title: I Samuel 10:7
text: And it will be when these signs have come to you, you will do for yourself what your hand finds; for God [is] with you.

title: I Samuel 10:8
text: And you shall go down before me to Gilgal. And, behold, I will come down to you to offer burnt offerings [and] to sacrifice peace offerings. You shall stay seven days until I come to you and make known to you what you shall do.

title: I Samuel 10:9
text: And it happened when he had turned his back to go from Samuel, God changed him with another heart. And all those signs came on that day.

title: I Samuel 10:10
text: And they came there to the hill, behold, a company of prophets met him. And the Spirit of God came on him, and he prophesied among them.

title: I Samuel 10:11
text: And it happened when all who knew him before saw him, behold, he prophesied among the prophets. And the people said to one another, What [is] this that has happened to the son of Kish? Is Saul also among the prophets?

title: I Samuel 10:12
text: And a man from there answered and said, And who [is] their father? Therefore it became a proverb, [Is] Saul also among the prophets?

title: I Samuel 10:13
text: And he finished from prophesying, and he came to the high place.

title: I Samuel 10:14
text: And Saul's uncle said to him and to his young man, Where did you go? And he said, To look for the asses. And when we saw that [they were] nowhere, we came to Samuel.

title: I Samuel 10:15
text: And Saul's uncle said, Please tell me, what Samuel said to you.

title: I Samuel 10:16
text: And Saul said to his uncle, He told us plainly that the asses were found. But he did not tell him of the matter of the kingdom of which Samuel spoke.

title: I Samuel 10:17
text: And Samuel called the people together to the LORD to Mizpeh.

title: I Samuel 10:18
text: And he said to the sons of Israel, So says the LORD God of Israel, I brought up Israel out of Egypt, and delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of all kingdoms, of those who oppressed you.

title: I Samuel 10:19
text: And you have this day rejected your God who Himself saved you out of all your calamities and your tribulations. And you have said to Him, But set a king over us. And now present yourselves before the LORD by your tribes and by your thousands.

title: I Samuel 10:20
text: And when Samuel had caused all the tribes of Israel to come near, the tribe of Benjamin was taken.

title: I Samuel 10:21
text: When he had caused the tribe of Benjamin to come near by their families, the family of Matri was taken, and Saul the son of Kish was taken. And they looked for him, but he could not be found.

title: I Samuel 10:22
text: And they inquired of the LORD further, Has the man yet come here? And the LORD answered, Behold, he is hiding himself among the baggage.

title: I Samuel 10:23
text: And they ran and brought him from there. And when he stood among the people, he was taller than all of the people from the shoulders and upward.

title: I Samuel 10:24
text: And Samuel said to all the people, Do you see him whom the LORD has chosen, that [there is] none like him among all the people? And all the people shouted, and said, Let the king live!

title: I Samuel 10:25
text: Then Samuel told the people the duties of the kingdom, and wrote in a book and laid it up before the LORD. And Samuel sent all the people away, each to his house.

title: I Samuel 10:26
text: And Saul also went home to Gibeah. And a band of men went with him, whose hearts God had touched.

title: I Samuel 10:27
text: But the sons of Belial said, How shall this man save us? And they despised him and brought him no present. But he was silent.

title: I Samuel 11:1
text: And Nahash the Ammonite came up and camped against Jabesh-gilead. And all the men of Jabesh said to Nahash, Make a covenant with us, and we will serve you.

title: I Samuel 11:2
text: And Nahash the Ammonite answered them, With this I will make a covenant with you, when all your right eyes are dug out and I will make it a reproach on all Israel.

title: I Samuel 11:3
text: And the elders of Jabesh said to him, Bear with us seven days, so that we may send messengers to all the territory of Israel. And then if [there is] no man to save us, we will come out to you.

title: I Samuel 11:4
text: Then the messengers came to Gibeah of Saul, and told the news in ears of the people. And all the people lifted up their voices and wept.

title: I Samuel 11:5
text: And, behold, Saul came after the herd out of the field. And Saul said, What [is wrong] with the people that they weep? And they told him the words of the men of Jabesh.

title: I Samuel 11:6
text: And the Spirit of God came powerfully on Saul when he heard those words, and his anger was kindled greatly.

title: I Samuel 11:7
text: And he took a yoke of oxen and cut them in pieces, and sent throughout all the territory of Israel by the hands of messengers, saying, Whoever does not come out after Saul and after Samuel, so shall it be done to his oxen. And the fear of the LORD fell on the people, and they came out as one man.

title: I Samuel 11:8
text: And when he numbered them in Bezek, the sons of Israel were three hundred thousand, and the men of Judah thirty thousand.

title: I Samuel 11:9
text: And they said to the messengers that came, So shall you say to the men of Jabesh-gilead, Tomorrow by [the time] the sun is hot, you shall have help. And the messengers came and told the men of Jabesh, and they were glad.

title: I Samuel 11:10
text: And the men of Jabesh said, Tomorrow we will come out to you, and you shall do with us all that seems good to you.

title: I Samuel 11:11
text: And it was [so] on the next day, Saul put the people in three companies, and they came into the middle of the army at the morning watch. And they killed the Ammonites until the heat of the day. And the ones who remained were scattered, so that two of them were not left together.

title: I Samuel 11:12
text: And the people said to Samuel, Who [is] he that said, Shall Saul reign over us? Bring the men so that we may put them to death.

title: I Samuel 11:13
text: And Saul said, There shall not a man be put to death this day, for today the LORD has worked salvation in Israel.

title: I Samuel 11:14
text: Then Samuel said to the people, Come and let us go to Gilgal and renew the kingdom there.

title: I Samuel 11:15
text: And all the people went [to] Gilgal, and made Saul king before the LORD in Gilgal, and there they sacrificed sacrifices of peace offerings before the LORD. And there Saul and all the men of Israel rejoiced greatly.

title: I Samuel 12:1
text: And Samuel said to all Israel, Behold, I have listened to your voice in all that you said to me, and have made a king over you.

title: I Samuel 12:2
text: And now, behold, the king walks before you. And I am old and gray-headed, and, behold, my sons [are] with you. And I have walked before you from my childhood to this day.

title: I Samuel 12:3
text: Behold, here I [am]. Witness against me before the LORD and before His anointed. Whose ox have I taken? Or whose ass have I taken? Or whom have I defrauded? Whom have I oppressed? Or from whose hand have I received a bribe, to blind my eyes with it? And I will restore it to you.

title: I Samuel 12:4
text: And they said, You have not defrauded us nor oppressed us, neither have you taken from any man's hand.

title: I Samuel 12:5
text: And he said to them, The LORD [is] witness against you, and His anointed [is] witness this day, that you have not found anything in my hand. And they answered, He is witness.

title: I Samuel 12:6
text: And Samuel said to the people, [It is] the LORD who made Moses and Aaron, and who brought your fathers up out of the land of Egypt.

title: I Samuel 12:7
text: And now stand still, so that I may reason with you before the LORD of all the righteous acts of the LORD which He did to you and to your fathers.

title: I Samuel 12:8
text: When Jacob had come into Egypt, and your fathers cried to the LORD, then the LORD sent Moses and Aaron, who brought your fathers out of Egypt and made them live in this place.

title: I Samuel 12:9
text: And they forgot the LORD their God. And He sold them into the hand of Sisera, captain of the army of Hazor, and into the hand of the Philistines, and into the hand of the king of Moab, and they fought against them.

title: I Samuel 12:10
text: And they cried to the LORD, and said, We have sinned because we have forsaken the LORD, and have served the Baals and Ashtoreths. But now deliver us out of the hand of our enemies, and we will serve You.

title: I Samuel 12:11
text: And the LORD sent Jerubbaal, and Bedan, and Jephthah, and Samuel, and delivered you out of the hand of your enemies on every side, and you lived safely.

title: I Samuel 12:12
text: And when you saw that Nahash the king of the sons of Ammon came against you, you said to me, No, but a king shall reign over us, even though the LORD your God [was] your King.

title: I Samuel 12:13
text: And now, behold the king whom you have chosen, whom you have desired! And behold, the LORD has set a king over you!

title: I Samuel 12:14
text: If you will fear the LORD, and serve Him, and listen to His voice, and not rebel against the command of the LORD, then both you and also the king who reigns over you shall continue following the LORD your God.

title: I Samuel 12:15
text: But if you will not listen to the voice of the LORD, but rebel against the command of the LORD, then the hand of the LORD shall be against you as [it was] against your fathers.

title: I Samuel 12:16
text: Also, now stand and see this great thing which the LORD shall do before your eyes.

title: I Samuel 12:17
text: [Is it] not wheat harvest today? I will call to the LORD, and He shall send thunder and rain, so that you may perceive and see that your wickedness is great, that which you have done in the sight of the LORD, in asking a king for you.

title: I Samuel 12:18
text: And Samuel called to the LORD, And the LORD sent thunder and rain that day. And all the people greatly feared the LORD and Samuel.

title: I Samuel 12:19
text: And all the people said to Samuel, Pray for your servants to the LORD your God, so that we will not die. For we have added evil to all our sins, to ask a king for us.

title: I Samuel 12:20
