text: And Samuel said to the people, Do not fear. You have done all this wickedness. Yet do not turn aside from following the LORD, but serve the LORD with all your heart.

title: I Samuel 12:21
text: And do not turn aside to go after vanities, which cannot profit nor deliver. For they [are] vain.

title: I Samuel 12:22
text: For the LORD will not forsake His people for His great name's sake, because it has pleased the LORD to make you His people.

title: I Samuel 12:23
text: Also, I, far be it from me that I should sin against the LORD from ceasing to pray for you. But I will teach you the good and the right way.

title: I Samuel 12:24
text: Only fear the LORD, and serve Him in truth with all your heart. For consider what great [things] He has done for you.

title: I Samuel 12:25
text: But if you shall still do wickedly, both you and your king, will be swept away.

title: I Samuel 13:1
text: Saul reigned one year, and when he had reigned two more years over Israel,

title: I Samuel 13:2
text: then Saul chose for himself three thousand from Israel. Two thousand of these were with Saul in Michmash and in mount Bethel, and a thousand were with Jonathan in Gibeah of Benjamin. And of the rest of the people he sent each man to his tent.

title: I Samuel 13:3
text: And Jonathan struck the garrison of the Philistines in Geba, and the Philistines heard. And Saul blew the ram's horn throughout all the land, saying, Let the Hebrews hear.

title: I Samuel 13:4
text: And all Israel heard, saying, Saul has struck a garrison of the Philistines, and also Israel has made himself stink to the Philistines. And the people were called to Gilgal after Saul.

title: I Samuel 13:5
text: And the Philistines gathered to fight with Israel, thirty thousand chariots, and six thousand horsemen, and people like the sand on the seashore in multitude. And they came up and pitched in Michmash, eastward from Beth-aven.

title: I Samuel 13:6
text: And the men of Israel saw that they were in a tight place (for the people were distressed). And the people hid themselves in caves, and in thickets, and in rocks, and in high places, and in pits.

title: I Samuel 13:7
text: And the Hebrews went over Jordan to the land of Gad and Gilead. And Saul [was] still in Gilgal, and all the people followed him, trembling.

title: I Samuel 13:8
text: And he waited seven days, according to the set time with Samuel. But Samuel did not come to Gilgal. And the people were scattered from him.

title: I Samuel 13:9
text: And Saul said, Bring a burnt offering here to me, and peace offerings. And he offered the burnt offering.

title: I Samuel 13:10
text: And it happened as soon as he had made an end of offering the burnt offering, behold, Samuel came. And Saul went out to meet him and to kneel to him.

title: I Samuel 13:11
text: And Samuel said, What have you done? And Saul said, Because I saw that the people were scattered from me, and you did not come in the days appointed, and the Philistines gathered themselves at Michmash,

title: I Samuel 13:12
text: and I said, The Philistines will come down now on me to Gilgal, and I have not made supplication to the LORD. And I forced myself and offered a burnt offering.

title: I Samuel 13:13
text: And Samuel said to Saul, You have done foolishly. You have not kept the commandment of the LORD your God, which He commanded you. For now the LORD would have established your kingdom on Israel forever.

title: I Samuel 13:14
text: But now your kingdom shall not stand. The LORD has sought Him a man after His own heart, and the LORD has appointed him to be leader over His people, because you have not kept what the LORD commanded you.

title: I Samuel 13:15
text: And Samuel arose and went up from Gilgal to Gibeah of Benjamin. And Saul numbered the people present with him, about six hundred men.

title: I Samuel 13:16
text: And Saul, and his son Jonathan, and the people present with them, stayed in Gibeah of Benjamin. But the Philistines camped in Michmash.

title: I Samuel 13:17
text: And the spoilers came out of the camp of the Philistines in three companies. One company turned to the way [to] Ophrah, to the land of Shual.

title: I Samuel 13:18
text: And another company turned the way [to] Beth-horon. And one company turned the way of the border that looks toward the valley of Zeboim toward the wilderness.

title: I Samuel 13:19
text: And there was no smith found throughout all the land of Israel. For the Philistines said, Lest the Hebrews make swords or spears.

title: I Samuel 13:20
text: But all the Israelites went down [to] the Philistines, each man to sharpen his plowshare, and his mattock, and his axe, and his coulter.

title: I Samuel 13:21
text: And there was the [charge] of a pim for the plowshares, and for the mattocks, and for the three-pronged forks, and for the axes, and to sharpen the plowshares.

title: I Samuel 13:22
text: And it happened in the day of battle there was neither sword nor spear found in the hand of any of the people with Saul and Jonathan. But with Saul and with his son Jonathan there [was] found [sword and spear].

title: I Samuel 13:23
text: And the garrison of the Philistines went out to the passage of Michmash.

title: I Samuel 14:1
text: And the day came that Jonathan the son of Saul said to the young man who bore his armor, Come and let us go over to the Philistines' garrison which [is] on the other side. But he did not tell his father.

title: I Samuel 14:2
text: And Saul stayed in the edge of Gibeah under the pomegranate tree in Migron. And the people who were with him were about six hundred men.

title: I Samuel 14:3
text: And Ahiah, the son of Ahitub, Ichabod's brother, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eli, the LORD's priest in Shiloh, was wearing an ephod. And the people did not know that Jonathan was gone.

title: I Samuel 14:4
text: And between the passages by which Jonathan sought to go over to the Philistines' garrison [there was] a rocky crag on the one [side] and a rocky crag on the other [side]. And the name of the one [was] Bozez, and the name of the other Seneh.

title: I Samuel 14:5
text: The one crag [was] a pillar on the north in front of Michmash, and the other southward in front of Gibeah.

title: I Samuel 14:6
text: And Jonathan said to the young man who bore his armor, Come, and let us go over to the garrison of these uncircumcised ones. It may be that the LORD will work for us. For [there is] no restraint to the LORD, to save by many or by few.

title: I Samuel 14:7
text: And his armor-bearer said to him, Do all that [is] in your heart. Turn, for behold, I am with you according to your heart.

title: I Samuel 14:8
text: And Jonathan said, Behold, we will go over to [these] men, and we will show ourselves to them.

title: I Samuel 14:9
text: If they say this to us, Stand still until we come to you, then we will stand still [in] our place and will not go up to them.

title: I Samuel 14:10
text: But if they say this, Come up to us, then we will go up, for the LORD has delivered them up into our hand. And this [shall be] a sign to us.

title: I Samuel 14:11
text: And both of them showed themselves to the garrison of the Philistines. And the Philistines said, Behold, the Hebrews come out of the holes where they have hidden themselves.

title: I Samuel 14:12
text: And the men of the garrison answered Jonathan and his armor-bearer and said, Come up to us, and we will teach you a thing. And Jonathan said to his armor-bearer, Come up after me, for the LORD has delivered them into the hand of Israel.

title: I Samuel 14:13
text: And Jonathan climbed up on his hands and feet, and his armor-bearer after him. And they fell before Jonathan, and his armor-bearer killed after him.

title: I Samuel 14:14
text: And this [was] the first blow, when Jonathan and his armor-bearer struck about twenty men in about half of a furrow of an acre of a field.

title: I Samuel 14:15
text: And there was trembling in the army, in the field, and among all the people. The garrison and the spoilers also trembled, and the earth quaked, and it was a very great trembling.

title: I Samuel 14:16
text: And the watchmen of Saul in Gibeah of Benjamin looked, and behold, the multitude had melted away and went on here and there.

title: I Samuel 14:17
text: And Saul said to the people with him, Number now and see who is gone from us. And when they had counted, behold, Jonathan and his armor-bearer [were] not [there.]

title: I Samuel 14:18
text: And Saul said to Ahiah, Bring the ark of God here. For the ark of God was at that time with the sons of Israel.

title: I Samuel 14:19
text: And it happened, while Saul talked to the priest, the noise in the army of the Philistines went on and grew greater. And Saul said to the priest, Withdraw your hand.

title: I Samuel 14:20
text: And Saul and all the people with him gathered, and they went to the battle. And, behold, every man's sword [was] against his fellow, a very great panic.

title: I Samuel 14:21
text: And the Hebrews that [were] with the Philistines before, who had gone up with them into the camp all around, even they also [turned] to be with the Israelites who were with Saul and Jonathan.

title: I Samuel 14:22
text: And all the men of Israel who had hidden themselves in mount Ephraim heard that the Philistines had fled, even they also followed them in the battle.

title: I Samuel 14:23
text: And the LORD saved Israel that day, and the battle passed over to Beth-aven.

title: I Samuel 14:24
text: And the men of Israel were distressed on that day. For Saul had commanded the people, saying, Cursed [is] the man that eats food until evening, so that I may be avenged on my enemies. So none of the people tasted any food.

title: I Samuel 14:25
text: And all the [men of] the land came into a forest, and there was honey on the ground.

title: I Samuel 14:26
text: And when the people had come into the woods, behold, a flow of honey! But no one put his hand to his mouth, for the people feared the oath.

title: I Samuel 14:27
text: But Jonathan did not hear when his father made the people swear. And [he] put forth the end of the rod in his hand and dipped it in a honeycomb, and put his hand to his mouth. And his eyes were lightened.

title: I Samuel 14:28
text: And one from the people answered and said, Your father strictly charged the people with an oath, saying, Cursed [is] the man who eats food this day. And the people were weary.

title: I Samuel 14:29
text: Then Jonathan said, My father has troubled the land. Please see how my eyes have been lightened because I tasted a little of this honey.

title: I Samuel 14:30
text: How much more if the people had happened to eat freely today of the spoil of their enemies which they found? For would not there have been a much greater slaughter among the Philistines?

title: I Samuel 14:31
text: And they struck the Philistines that day from Michmash to Aijalon, and the people were very faint.

title: I Samuel 14:32
text: And the people flew on the spoil, and took sheep and oxen and calves, and killed [them] on the ground. And the people ate with the blood.

title: I Samuel 14:33
text: And they told Saul, saying, Behold, the people sin against the LORD in that they eat with the blood. And he said, You have transgressed. Roll a great stone to me today.

title: I Samuel 14:34
text: And Saul said, Disperse yourselves among the people and say to them, Let each one bring his ox here, and each man his sheep, and kill [them] here, and eat. And do not sin against the LORD in eating with the blood. And each man of all the people brought his ox in his hand that night, and killed them there.

title: I Samuel 14:35
text: And Saul built an altar to the LORD. The same was the first altar that he built to the LORD.

title: I Samuel 14:36
text: And Saul said, Let us go down after the Philistines by night and spoil them until the morning light, and let us not leave a man of them. And they said, Do all that seems good to you. Then the priest said, Let us draw near here to God.

title: I Samuel 14:37
text: And Saul asked counsel of God: Shall I go down after the Philistines? Will You deliver them into the hand of Israel? But He answered him not that day.

title: I Samuel 14:38
text: And Saul said, Draw near here, all the chief of the people, and know and see what this sin has been today.

title: I Samuel 14:39
text: For, [as] the LORD lives, He who saves Israel, though it is in Jonathan my son, he shall surely die. But there was not a man among all the people answered.

title: I Samuel 14:40
text: Then he said to all Israel, You be on one side, and Jonathan my son and I will be on the other side. And the people said to Saul, Do what seems good to you.

title: I Samuel 14:41
text: And Saul said to the LORD God of Israel, Give a perfect [lot]. And Saul and Jonathan were taken, but the people escaped.

title: I Samuel 14:42
text: And Saul said, Cast [lots] between me and my son Jonathan. And Jonathan was taken.

title: I Samuel 14:43
text: Then Saul said to Jonathan, Tell me what you have done. And Jonathan told him and said, I did but taste a little honey with the end of the rod in my hand. Behold me, I must die.

title: I Samuel 14:44
text: And Saul answered, God do so and more also, for you shall surely die, Jonathan.

title: I Samuel 14:45
text: And the people said to Saul, Shall Jonathan die, who has worked out this great salvation in Israel? Far be it! [As] the LORD lives, not one hair of his head shall fall to the ground, for he has worked with God this day. So the people rescued Jonathan, so that he did not die.

title: I Samuel 14:46
text: Then Saul went up from following the Philistines. And the Philistines went to their own place.

title: I Samuel 14:47
text: And Saul took the kingdom over Israel and fought against all his enemies on every side, with Moab, and with the sons of Ammon, and with Edom, and with the kings of Zobah, and with the Philistines. And wherever he turned himself, he troubled [them].

title: I Samuel 14:48
text: And he gathered an army and struck the Amalekites, and delivered Israel out of the hands of those who spoiled them.

title: I Samuel 14:49
text: And the sons of Saul were Jonathan, and Ishui, and Melchishua. And the names of his two daughters: the first-born's name [was] Merab, and the name of the younger, Michal.

title: I Samuel 14:50
text: And the name of Saul's wife [was] Ahinoam, the daughter of Ahimaaz. And the name of the commander of his army [was] Abner, the son of Ner, Saul's uncle.

title: I Samuel 14:51
text: And Kish [was] the father of Saul. And Ner the father of Abner [was] the son of Abiel.

title: I Samuel 14:52
text: And the war was heavy against the Philistines all the days of Saul. And when Saul saw any strong man, or any brave man, he took him to himself.

title: I Samuel 15:1
text: And Samuel said to Saul, The LORD sent me to anoint you to be king over His people, over Israel. And now listen to the voice of the words of the LORD.

title: I Samuel 15:2
text: So says the LORD of hosts, I will visit Amalek with what he did to Israel, how he set against him in the way when he came up from Egypt.

title: I Samuel 15:3
text: Now go and strike Amalek, and completely destroy all that they have, and do not spare them. But kill both man and woman, infant and suckling, ox and sheep, camel and ass.

title: I Samuel 15:4
text: And Saul gathered the people together and numbered them in Telaim, two hundred thousand footmen and ten thousand men of Judah.

title: I Samuel 15:5
text: And Saul came to a city of Amalek and lay in wait in the valley.

title: I Samuel 15:6
text: And Saul said to the Kenites, Go! Depart! Get down from among the Amalekites, lest I destroy you with them. For you showed kindness to all the sons of Israel when they came up out of Egypt. So the Kenites departed from among the Amalekites.

title: I Samuel 15:7
text: And Saul struck the Amalekites from Havilah, as you come to Shur, which [is] over across from Egypt.

title: I Samuel 15:8
text: And he took Agag the king of the Amalekites alive. And he completely destroyed all the people with the edge of the sword.

title: I Samuel 15:9
text: But Saul and the people spared Agag and the best of the sheep and of the oxen and of the fatlings and the lambs, and all [that was] good, and would not completely destroy them. But everything [that was] vile and feeble they completely destroyed.

title: I Samuel 15:10
text: And the word of the LORD came to Samuel saying,

title: I Samuel 15:11
text: It repents Me that I have set up Saul [to be] king. For he has turned back from following Me and has not done My commands. And it grieved Samuel, and he cried [out to] the LORD all night.

title: I Samuel 15:12
text: And when Samuel rose up early in the morning to meet Saul, it was told to Samuel, saying, Saul came to Carmel, and behold, he set up a place for himself, and has gone around and passed on and gone down to Gilgal.

title: I Samuel 15:13
text: And Samuel came to Saul. And Saul said to him, You [are] blessed of the LORD. I have done the command of the LORD.

title: I Samuel 15:14
text: And Samuel said, What then [is] this bleating of the flock in my ears? And [what is] the sound of the herd which I hear?

title: I Samuel 15:15
text: And Saul said, They have brought them from the Amalekites. For the people spared the best of the sheep and of the oxen to sacrifice to the LORD your God. And the rest we have completely destroyed.

title: I Samuel 15:16
text: And Samuel said to Saul, Stop! And I will tell you what the LORD has said to me tonight. And he said to him, Speak.

title: I Samuel 15:17
text: And Samuel said, When you [were] little in your own sight, did you not become the head of the tribes of Israel? And the LORD anointed you king over Israel.

title: I Samuel 15:18
text: And the LORD sent you on the way and said, Go and completely destroy the sinners, Amalek, and fight against them until you destroy them.

title: I Samuel 15:19
text: Why then did you not obey the voice of the LORD? Why did you fly on the spoil and do evil in the sight of the LORD?

title: I Samuel 15:20
text: And Saul said to Samuel, Yes, I have obeyed the voice of the LORD, and have gone the way which the LORD sent me, and have brought Agag the king of Amalek, and have completely destroyed the Amalekites.

title: I Samuel 15:21
text: But the people took from the spoil, of [the] flocks and herd, [the] best of the things devoted to sacrifice to the LORD your God in Gilgal.

title: I Samuel 15:22
text: And Samuel said, Does the LORD delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices as in obeying the voice of the LORD? Behold, to obey [is] better than sacrifice! To listen [is] better than the fat of rams!

title: I Samuel 15:23
text: For rebellion [is as] the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness is as iniquity and idol-worship. Because you have rejected the word of the LORD, He has also rejected you from being king!

title: I Samuel 15:24
text: And Saul said to Samuel, I have sinned. For I have disobeyed the command of the LORD, and your word, because I feared the people and obeyed their voice.

title: I Samuel 15:25
text: And now please pardon my sin and turn again with me so that I may worship the LORD.

title: I Samuel 15:26
text: And Samuel said to Saul, I will not return with you, for you have rejected the word of the LORD, and the LORD has rejected you from being king over Israel.

title: I Samuel 15:27
text: And Samuel turned around to go, and he laid hold on the skirt of his robe, and it tore.

title: I Samuel 15:28
text: And Samuel said to him, The LORD has torn the kingdom of Israel from you this day, and has given it to a neighbor of yours [who is] better than you.

title: I Samuel 15:29
text: And also the Glory of Israel will not lie nor repent, for He [is] not a man that He should repent.

title: I Samuel 15:30
text: Then he said, I have sinned. Please honor me now before the elders of my people and before Israel, and turn again with me. And I shall worship the LORD your God.

title: I Samuel 15:31
text: And Samuel turned again after Saul, and Saul worshiped the LORD.

title: I Samuel 15:32
text: And Samuel said, Bring here to me Agag the king of the Amalekites. And Agag came to him daintily. And Agag said, Surely the bitterness of death is past.

title: I Samuel 15:33
text: And Samuel said, As your sword has made women childless, so shall your mother be childless among women. And Samuel cut Agag in pieces before the LORD in Gilgal.

title: I Samuel 15:34
text: And Samuel went to Ramah. And Saul went up to his house to Gibeah of Saul.

title: I Samuel 15:35
text: And Samuel never again saw Saul until the day of his death, for Samuel mourned for Saul. And the LORD repented that he had made Saul king over Israel.

title: I Samuel 16:1
text: And the LORD said to Samuel, How long will you mourn for Saul, since I have rejected him from reigning over Israel? Fill your horn with oil and go. I will send you to Jesse of Bethlehem. For I have seen a king for Me among his sons.

title: I Samuel 16:2
text: And Samuel said, How can I go? If Saul hears, he will kill me. And the LORD said, Take a heifer of the herd in your hand with you and say, I have come to sacrifice to the LORD.

title: I Samuel 16:3
text: And call Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will show you what you shall do. And you shall anoint for Me whomever I name to you.

title: I Samuel 16:4
text: And Samuel did what the LORD said, and came to Bethlehem. And the elders of the town trembled at his coming and said, Do you come peaceably?

title: I Samuel 16:5
text: And he said, Peaceably. I have come to sacrifice to the LORD. Sanctify yourselves and come with me to the sacrifice. And he sanctified Jesse and his sons, and called them to the sacrifice.

title: I Samuel 16:6
text: And it happened as they came in, he saw Eliab and said, Surely the LORD's anointed [is] before the LORD.

title: I Samuel 16:7
text: But the LORD said to Samuel, Do not look on his face, nor on his height, because I have refused him. For He does not see as man sees. For man looks on the outward appearance, but the LORD looks on the heart.

title: I Samuel 16:8
text: And Jesse called Abinadab, and he passed him before Samuel, but he said, Also the LORD has not chosen this one.

title: I Samuel 16:9
text: And Jesse passed Shammah by, but he said, Also the LORD has not chosen this one.

title: I Samuel 16:10
text: And Jesse passed seven of his sons before Samuel, but Samuel said to Jesse, The LORD has not chosen these.

title: I Samuel 16:11
text: And Samuel said to Jesse, Are all the young men here? And he said, There remains yet the youngest, and behold, he keeps the sheep. And Samuel said to Jesse, Send and bring him, for we will not sit down until he comes here.

title: I Samuel 16:12
text: And he sent and brought him in. And he [was] ruddy, with beautiful eyes and good form. And the LORD said, Arise, anoint him. For this is he.

title: I Samuel 16:13
text: And Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed him in the midst of his brothers. And the spirit of the LORD came on David from that day forward. And Samuel rose up and went to Ramah.

title: I Samuel 16:14
text: But the spirit of the LORD departed from Saul, and an evil spirit from the LORD terrified him.

title: I Samuel 16:15
text: And Saul's servants said to him, Behold now, an evil spirit from God terrifies you.

title: I Samuel 16:16
text: Let our lord now command his servants before you to seek out a man who knows to play on a harp. And it shall be, when the evil spirit from God is on you, then he shall play [with] his hand, and [it shall be] well with you.

title: I Samuel 16:17
text: And Saul said to his servants, Now look for me a man who can play well, and bring [him] to me.

title: I Samuel 16:18
text: And one of the servants answered and said, Behold, I have seen a son of Jesse the Bethlehemite who is skillful in playing, and a mighty warrior and a man of battle, and prudent in speech. And he is a person of good form, and the LORD [is]  with him.

title: I Samuel 16:19
text: And Saul sent messengers to Jesse and said, Send me your son David, who [is] with the sheep.

title: I Samuel 16:20
text: And Jesse took an ass [loaded] with bread and a skin of wine and a kid, and sent [them] by David his son to Saul.

title: I Samuel 16:21
text: And David came to Saul and stood before him. And he loved him greatly, and he became his armor-bearer.

title: I Samuel 16:22
text: And Saul sent to Jesse saying, Please let David stand before me, for he has found favor in my sight.

title: I Samuel 16:23
text: And it happened when the spirit from God was on Saul, that David took a harp and played with his hand. And there was relief for Saul, and [it was] well with him, and the evil spirit departed from him.

title: I Samuel 17:1
text: And the Philistines gathered their armies for battle, and gathered at Socoh [of] Judah, and pitched between Socoh and Azekah, in Ephes-dammim.

title: I Samuel 17:2
text: And Saul and the men of Israel had gathered and pitched by the valley of Elah, and set the battle in order against the Philistines.

title: I Samuel 17:3
text: And the Philistines stood on a mountain on the one [side], and Israel stood on a mountain on the other [side]. And [there was] a valley between them.

title: I Samuel 17:4
text: And a champion named Goliath came out of the Philistines camp; he was from Gath. His height [was] six cubits and a span.

title: I Samuel 17:5
text: And a bronze helmet was on his head, and he [was] armed with scaled armor. And the weight of the coat [was] five thousand shekels of bronze.

title: I Samuel 17:6
text: And greaves of bronze [were] on his legs, and a bronze javelin [was] between his shoulders.

title: I Samuel 17:7
text: And the staff of his spear [was] like a weaver's beam. And his spear's head [weighed] six hundred shekels of iron. And the shield bearer went in front of him.

title: I Samuel 17:8
text: And he stood and cried to the armies of Israel, and said to them, Why have you come out to set [your] battle in order? [Am] I not a Philistine, and are you not servants to Saul? Choose a man for you, and let him come down to me.

title: I Samuel 17:9
text: If he is able to fight with me and kill me, then we will be your slaves. But if I prevail against him and kill him, then you shall be our slaves and serve us.

title: I Samuel 17:10
text: And the Philistine said, I defy the armies of Israel this day. Give me a man, and we will fight together.

title: I Samuel 17:11
text: And Saul and all Israel heard those words of the Philistine, and they were dismayed and greatly afraid.

title: I Samuel 17:12
text: And David [was] the son of an Ephrathite of Bethlehem-judah named Jesse. And to him [were] eight sons. And the man [was] old among men in the days of Saul.

title: I Samuel 17:13
text: And the three oldest sons of Jesse went out, [and] followed Saul to the battle. And the names of his three sons that went to the battle [were] Eliab the first-born; and his second, Abinadab; and the third Shammah.

title: I Samuel 17:14
text: And David [was] the youngest. And the three oldest followed Saul.

title: I Samuel 17:15
text: And David went and returned from Saul to feed his father's sheep at Bethlehem.

title: I Samuel 17:16
text: And the Philistine drew near morning and evening, and presented himself forty days.

title: I Samuel 17:17
text: And Jesse said to his son David, Please take for your brothers an ephah of this parched [grain], and these ten loaves, and run to the camp to your brothers.

title: I Samuel 17:18
text: And carry these ten cuttings of cheeses to the commander of [their] thousand, and see how your brothers are faring, and take their pledge.

title: I Samuel 17:19
text: And Saul, and they, and all the men of Israel, [were] in the valley of Elah fighting with the Philistines.

title: I Samuel 17:20
text: And David rose up early in the morning and left the sheep with a keeper, and got up and went as Jesse had commanded him. And he came to the barricade, and to the army which was going out to fight, and shouted for the battle.

title: I Samuel 17:21
text: For Israel and the Philistines had put the battle in order, rank to rank.

title: I Samuel 17:22
text: And David left his baggage in the hand of the keeper of the baggage and ran into the army, and came and greeted his brothers.

title: I Samuel 17:23
text: And he was speaking with them. And, behold, the champion man, named Goliath, the Philistine of Gath, came up out of the ranks of the Philistines, and spoke according to these words. And David heard.

title: I Samuel 17:24
text: And all the men of Israel, when they saw the man, they ran from him and were very much afraid.

title: I Samuel 17:25
text: And the men of Israel said, Have you seen this man that has come up? Surely he has come up to defy Israel. And it shall be, the king will enrich the man who kills him with great riches, and will give him his daughter, and make his father's house free in Israel.

title: I Samuel 17:26
text: And David spoke to the men who stood by him, saying, What shall be done to the man who kills this Philistine and takes away this shame from Israel? For who [is] this uncircumcised Philistine that he should defy the armies of the living God?

title: I Samuel 17:27
text: And the people answered him in this way, saying, So shall it be done to the man who kills him.

title: I Samuel 17:28
text: And his oldest brother Eliab heard when he spoke to the men. And Eliab's anger was kindled against David. And he said, Why have you come down? And with whom have you left those few sheep in the wilderness? I know your pride and the naughtiness of your heart. For you have come down to see the battle.

title: I Samuel 17:29
text: And David said, What have I done now? Was it not [only] a word?

title: I Samuel 17:30
text: And he turned from him toward another, and spoke according to this word. And the people answered him again in the same way.

title: I Samuel 17:31
text: And the words which David spoke were heard. And they were told before Saul. And he sent for him.

title: I Samuel 17:32
text: And David said to Saul, Let no man's heart fail because of him. Your servant will go and fight with this Philistine.

title: I Samuel 17:33
text: And Saul said to David, You are not able to go against this Philistine to fight with him. For you [are but] a youth, and he is a man of war from his youth.

title: I Samuel 17:34
text: And David said to Saul, Your servant kept his father's sheep, and there came a lion and a bear, and took a lamb out of the flock.

title: I Samuel 17:35
text: And I went out after it and struck it, and delivered [the lamb] out of its mouth. And when it rose against me, I caught [it] by the beard, and struck it and killed it.

title: I Samuel 17:36
text: Your servant killed both the lion and the bear. And this uncircumcised Philistine shall be like one of them, since he has defied the armies of the living God.

title: I Samuel 17:37
text: And David said, The LORD who has delivered me out of the paw of the lion and out of the paw of the bear, He will deliver me out of the hand of this Philistine. And Saul said to David, Go, and may the LORD be with you.

title: I Samuel 17:38
text: And Saul armed David with his armor, and he put a helmet of bronze on his head. He also armed him [with] scaled armor.

title: I Samuel 17:39
text: And David girded his sword on his armor, and he tried to go. But he had not tested [it]. And David said to Saul, I cannot go with these, for I have not tested [them]. And David put them off him.

title: I Samuel 17:40
text: And he took his staff in his hand, and chose five smooth stones out of the brook for himself, and put them in a shepherd's vessel which he had, even in a bag. And his sling [was] in his hand. And he drew near the Philistine.

title: I Samuel 17:41
text: And the Philistine came on and drew near David. And the man who bore the shield [was] before him.

title: I Samuel 17:42
text: And the Philistine looked and saw David, and disdained him. For he was [only] a youth, and ruddy, with a handsome appearance.

title: I Samuel 17:43
text: And the Philistine said to David, [Am] I a dog that you come to me with sticks? And the Philistine cursed David by his gods.

title: I Samuel 17:44
text: And the Philistine said to David, Come to me, and I will give your flesh to the birds of the air and to the beasts of the field.

title: I Samuel 17:45
text: And David said to the Philistine, You come to me with a sword and with a spear and with a javelin. But I come to you in the name of Jehovah of hosts, the God of the armies of Israel, whom you have defied.

title: I Samuel 17:46
text: Jehovah will deliver you into my hand today, and I will strike you and take your head from you and give the bodies of the army of the Philistines to the birds of the air today, and to the wild beasts of the earth, so that all the earth may know that there is a God in Israel.

title: I Samuel 17:47
text: And all this multitude shall know that Jehovah does not save with sword and spear; for the battle [is] Jehovah's, and He will give you into our hands.

title: I Samuel 17:48
text: And it happened when the Philistine rose and went and drew near to meet David, David hurried and ran toward the ranks to meet the Philistine.

title: I Samuel 17:49
text: And David put his hand into his bag and took a stone from there, and slung [it] and struck the Philistine in his forehead, so that the stone sank into his forehead. And he fell on his face to the earth.

title: I Samuel 17:50
text: And David was stronger than the Philistine with a sling and with a stone. And he struck the Philistine, and killed him. But no sword [was] in the hand of David.

title: I Samuel 17:51
text: And David ran and stood on the Philistine, and took out his sword and drew it out of its sheath, and killed him, and cut off his head with it. And the Philistines saw that their champion [was] dead, and fled.

title: I Samuel 17:52
text: And the men of Israel rose up and shouted, and Judah pursued the Philistines until you come to the valley, and to the gates of Ekron. And the wounded of the Philistines fell down by the way to Shaaraim, even to Gath and to Ekron.

title: I Samuel 17:53
text: And the sons of Israel returned from chasing after the Philistines, and they spoiled their tents.

title: I Samuel 17:54
text: And David took the head of the Philistine and brought it to Jerusalem. But he put his armor in his tent.

title: I Samuel 17:55
text: And when Saul saw David go forth against the Philistine, he said to Abner, the captain of the army, Abner, whose son [is] this young man? And Abner said, [As] your soul lives, O king, I cannot tell.

title: I Samuel 17:56
text: And the king said, You go ask whose son the young man [is].

title: I Samuel 17:57
text: And as David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, Abner took him and brought him before Saul, with the head of the Philistine in his hand.

title: I Samuel 17:58
text: And Saul said to him, Whose son [are] you, young man? And David answered, I am the son of your servant Jesse of Bethlehem.

title: I Samuel 18:1
text: And it happened when he had finished speaking to Saul, the soul of Jonathan was joined with the soul of David, and Jonathan loved him as he did his own soul.

title: I Samuel 18:2
text: And Saul took him that day and would not let him go home to his father's house any more.

title: I Samuel 18:3
text: And Jonathan and David cut a covenant, because he loved him as his own soul.

title: I Samuel 18:4
text: And Jonathan stripped off the robe [was] on him and gave it to David, and his apparel, even to his sword and to his bow and to his girdle.

title: I Samuel 18:5
text: And David went out wherever Saul sent him, behaving himself wisely. And Saul set him over the men of war, and it was good in the sight of all the people, and also in the sight of Saul's servants.

title: I Samuel 18:6
text: And it happened as they came in, as David returned from striking the Philistine, the women came out of all cities of Israel, singing and dancing, to meet king Saul with tabrets, with joy, and with instruments of music.

title: I Samuel 18:7
text: And the women answered as they played, and said, Saul has slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands.

title: I Samuel 18:8
text: And Saul was very angry, and this thing was evil in his eyes. And he said, They have given David ten thousands, and to me they have given [only] thousands. And what more can he have but the kingdom?

title: I Samuel 18:9
text: And Saul eyed David from that day and forward.

title: I Samuel 18:10
text: And it happened on the next day the evil spirit from God came on Saul, and he prophesied in the midst of the house. And David played with his hand, as at other times. And a spear [was] in Saul's hand.

title: I Samuel 18:11
text: And Saul threw the spear. For he said, I will strike David even to the wall. And David drew back out of his presence twice.

title: I Samuel 18:12
text: And Saul was afraid of David, because the LORD was with him and had departed from Saul.

title: I Samuel 18:13
text: And Saul moved him away from himself, and made him his commander over a thousand. And he went out and came in before the people.

title: I Samuel 18:14
text: And David behaved himself wisely in all his ways. And the LORD [was] with him.

title: I Samuel 18:15
text: And when Saul saw that he behaved himself very wisely, he was afraid of him.

title: I Samuel 18:16
text: But all Israel and Judah loved David, because he went out and came in before them.

title: I Samuel 18:17
text: And Saul said to David, Behold I will give you my older daughter Merab for a wife. Only you be a brave son for me and fight the LORD's battles. For Saul said, Let not my hand be on him, but let the hand of the Philistines be on him.

title: I Samuel 18:18
text: And David said to Saul, Who [am] I, and what is my life, or my father's family in Israel, that I should be son-in-law to the king?

title: I Samuel 18:19
text: And it happened at the time when Merab, Saul's daughter should have been given to David, she was given to Adriel the Meholathite to be his wife.

title: I Samuel 18:20
text: And Saul's daughter Michal loved David. And they told Saul, and the thing pleased him.

title: I Samuel 18:21
text: And Saul said, I will give her to him, so that she may be a trap to him, and so that the hand of the Philistines may be against him. And Saul said to David a second time, Today you shall be my son-in-law.

title: I Samuel 18:22
text: And Saul commanded his servants, Talk with David secretly [and say], Behold, the king delights in you, and all his servants love you. And now be the king's son-in-law.

title: I Samuel 18:23
text: And Saul's servants spoke these words in the ears of David. And David said, [Is it a] light [thing] to be a king's son-in-law, since I am a poor man and of little worth?

title: I Samuel 18:24
text: And the servants of Saul told him saying, This is the way David spoke.

title: I Samuel 18:25
text: And Saul said, You shall say this to David, The king does not desire any dowry except a hundred foreskins of the Philistines, to be avenged of the king's enemies. But Saul thought to make David fall by the hand of the Philistines.

title: I Samuel 18:26
text: And when his servants told David these words, it was right in the eyes of David to be the king's son-in-law. And the days were not fulfilled.

title: I Samuel 18:27
text: And David arose and went forth, he and his men. And [they] killed two hundred men of the Philistines. And David brought their foreskins, and they gave them in full number to the king so that he might be the king's son-in-law. And Saul gave him his daughter Michal for a wife.

title: I Samuel 18:28
text: And Saul saw and knew that the LORD [was] with David, and that Michal, Saul's daughter, loved him.

title: I Samuel 18:29
text: And Saul was still more afraid of David. And Saul became David's enemy continually.

title: I Samuel 18:30
text: And the rulers of the Philistines came out. And it happened as often as they came out, David acted more wisely than all the servants of Saul, so that his name was very precious.

title: I Samuel 19:1
text: And Saul said to his son Jonathan, and to all his servants, to kill David.

title: I Samuel 19:2
text: But Jonathan, Saul's son, loved David very much. And Jonathan told David, saying, My father Saul seeks to kill you. And now please be careful until morning, and stay in a secret [place], and hide yourself.

title: I Samuel 19:3
text: And I will go out and stand beside my father in the field where you [are], and I will talk about you with my father. And I will tell you what I see.

title: I Samuel 19:4
text: And Jonathan spoke good of David to Saul his father, and said to him, Do not let the king sin against his servant, against David, because he has not sinned against you, and because his works [are] very good toward you.

title: I Samuel 19:5
text: For he took his life in his hand and killed the Philistine, and the LORD worked out a great salvation for all Israel. You saw and rejoiced! Why then will you sin against innocent blood, to kill David without a cause?

title: I Samuel 19:6
text: And Saul listened to the voice of Jonathan. And Saul swore, [As] the LORD lives, he shall not die.

title: I Samuel 19:7
text: And Jonathan called David, and Jonathan showed him all those things. And Jonathan brought David to Saul, and he was in his presence as in times past.

title: I Samuel 19:8
text: And there was war again. And David went out and fought with the Philistines, and killed them with a great slaughter. And they fled from him.

title: I Samuel 19:9
text: And the evil spirit from the LORD was on Saul as he sat in his house with his spear in his hand. And David played with [his] hand.

title: I Samuel 19:10
text: And Saul thought to strike David even to the wall with the spear. But he burst forth from Saul's presence, and he struck the spear into the wall. And David fled and escaped that night.

title: I Samuel 19:11
text: Saul also sent messengers to David's house to watch him and to kill him in the morning. And David's wife Michal told him saying, If you do not save your life tonight, tomorrow you shall be killed.

title: I Samuel 19:12
text: And Michal let David down through a window. And he left and hurried away, and escaped.

title: I Samuel 19:13
text: And Michal took an image and laid [it] in the bed, and put a pillow of goats' [hair] at its head, and covered it with a cloth.

title: I Samuel 19:14
text: And when Saul sent messengers to take David, she said, He [is] sick.

title: I Samuel 19:15
text: And Saul sent the messengers to see David, saying, Bring him up to me in the bed so that I may kill him.

title: I Samuel 19:16
text: And the messengers came in, and behold, the image [was] in the bed with a pillow of goats' [hair] at its head.

title: I Samuel 19:17
text: And Saul said to Michal, Why have you deceived me so, and sent away my enemy so that he has escaped? And Michal answered Saul, He said to me, Let me go; why should I kill you?

title: I Samuel 19:18
text: And David fled, and escaped, and came to Samuel, to Ramah, and told him all that Saul had done to him. And he and Samuel went and lived in Naioth.

title: I Samuel 19:19
text: And it was told to Saul, saying, Behold, David [is] at Naioth in Ramah.

title: I Samuel 19:20
text: And Saul sent messengers to take David. And when they saw the company of the prophets prophesying, and Samuel standing [as] appointed over them, the Spirit of God came on the messengers of Saul, and they also prophesied.

title: I Samuel 19:21
text: And they told Saul, and he sent other messengers, and they also prophesied. And Saul sent messengers the third time, and they prophesied also.

title: I Samuel 19:22
text: And he also went to Ramah, and came to a great well in Sechu. And he asked and said, Where [are] Samuel and David? And [one] said, Behold, at Naioth in Ramah.

title: I Samuel 19:23
text: And he went there to Naioth in Ramah. And the Spirit of God was on him also, and going on he went and prophesied, until he came to Naioth in Ramah.

title: I Samuel 19:24
text: And he stripped off his clothes also, and prophesied before Samuel, even he. And he lay down disrobed all that day and all that night. Because of this they say, [Is] Saul also among the prophets?

title: I Samuel 20:1
text: And David fled from Naioth in Ramah, and came and said before Jonathan, What have I done? What [is] my iniquity, and what my sin before your father, that he seeks my life?

title: I Samuel 20:2
text: And he said to him, Far be it. You shall not die! Behold, my father will do nothing either great or small that he will not show to me. And why should my father hide this thing from me? It [is] not [so].

title: I Samuel 20:3
text: And David swore again and said, Your father certainly knows that I have found grace in your eyes. And he said, Do not let Jonathan know this, lest he be full of sorrow. But truly [as] the LORD lives, and as your soul lives, only a step [is] between me and death.

title: I Samuel 20:4
text: And Jonathan said to David, Whatever your soul desires, I will even do for you.

title: I Samuel 20:5
text: And David said to Jonathan, Behold, tomorrow [is] the new moon, and I should not fail to sit at table with the king. But let me go so that I may hide myself in the field until the third day at evening.

title: I Samuel 20:6
text: If your father misses me at all, then say, David earnestly asked me that he might run to his city Bethlehem. For [there is] a yearly sacrifice there for all the family.

title: I Samuel 20:7
text: If he says so, [It is] well, peace [will be] to your servant, but if he is very angry, be sure that evil is determined by him.

title: I Samuel 20:8
text: And you shall deal kindly with your servant, for you have brought your servant into a covenant of the LORD with you. But if there is any iniquity in me, kill me yourself. For why should you bring me to your father?

title: I Samuel 20:9
text: And Jonathan said, Far be it from you. For if I knew certainly that evil was determined by my father to come on you, then would I not tell you?

title: I Samuel 20:10
text: Then David said to Jonathan, Who shall tell me? Or what [if] your father answers you roughly?

title: I Samuel 20:11
text: And Jonathan said to David, Come, and let us go into the field. And both of them went out into the field.

title: I Samuel 20:12
text: And Jonathan said to David, By the LORD, the God of Israel, when I search my father about this time tomorrow [or] the third [day], behold, [if there is] good toward David, then shall I not send to you and reveal [it] in your ear?

title: I Samuel 20:13
text: So may the LORD do to Jonathan and more if it seem good my father [to do] you evil, then I will reveal [it] in your ear and send you away, and you may go in peace. And may the LORD be with you, as He was with my father.

title: I Samuel 20:14
text: And you shall not only show me the kindness of the LORD while I still live, so that I do not die,

title: I Samuel 20:15
text: but you shall not cut off your kindness from my house forever, no, not when the LORD has cut off the enemies of David, every one, from the face of the earth.

title: I Samuel 20:16
text: So Jonathan covenanted with the house of David, saying, Let the LORD even require [it] at the hand of David's enemies.

title: I Samuel 20:17
text: And Jonathan caused David to swear again, because he loved him. For he loved him as he loved his own soul.

title: I Samuel 20:18
text: And Jonathan said to David, Tomorrow [is] the new moon. And you shall be missed, because your seat will he empty.

title: I Samuel 20:19
text: And on the third [day] you shall quickly come down and shall come there to the place where you were hidden in the day of the deed. And [you] shall remain near the stone Ezel.

title: I Samuel 20:20
text: And I will shoot three arrows on the side, as though I shot at a mark.

title: I Samuel 20:21
text: And behold, I will send a lad, [saying], Go find the arrows. If I carefully say to the lad, Behold, the arrows are on this side of you, take them, then you may come, for there is peace to you, and no hurt, [as] the LORD lives.

title: I Samuel 20:22
text: But if I say this to the young man, Behold, the arrows [are] beyond you, go your way, for the LORD has sent you away.

title: I Samuel 20:23
text: And [as to] the matter which you and I have spoken of, behold, may the LORD be between you and me forever.

title: I Samuel 20:24
text: And David hid himself in the field. And when the new moon had come, the king sat down by the food to eat.

title: I Samuel 20:25
text: And the king sat on his seat as at other times, on a seat by the wall. And Jonathan arose, and Abner sat by Saul's side, and David's place was empty.

title: I Samuel 20:26
text: And Saul did not speak anything that day. For he thought, Something has happened to him; he [is] not clean. Surely he [is] not clean.

title: I Samuel 20:27
text: And it happened on the next day, the second of the month, David's place was empty. And Saul said to his son Jonathan, Why does the son of Jesse not come to the meal, neither yesterday nor today?

title: I Samuel 20:28
text: And Jonathan answered Saul, David earnestly asked of me [to go] to Bethlehem,

title: I Samuel 20:29
text: and he said, Please send me away, for we have a family sacrifice in the city. And my brother commanded me [to be] there. And now, if I have found favor in your eyes, I pray you let me get away and see my brothers. And he does not come to the king's table.

title: I Samuel 20:30
text: And Saul's anger was kindled against Jonathan, and he said to him, You son of a perverse, rebellious [woman], do I not know that you have chosen the son of Jesse to your own confusion, and to the shame of your mother's nakedness?

title: I Samuel 20:31
text: For as long as the son of Jesse lives on the earth, you shall not be established, nor your kingdom. And now send and bring him to me, for he shall surely die.

title: I Samuel 20:32
text: And Jonathan answered Saul his father and said to him, Why shall he be killed? What has he done?

title: I Samuel 20:33
text: And Saul threw a spear at him to strike him, and by this Jonathan knew that his father was determined to kill David.

title: I Samuel 20:34
text: And Jonathan rose from the table in fierce anger, and did not eat food on the second day of the new moon. For he was grieved for David, because his father had put him to shame.

title: I Samuel 20:35
text: And it happened, in the morning Jonathan went out into the field at the time appointed with David. And a little lad [was] with him.

title: I Samuel 20:36
text: And he said to this lad, Run now, find the arrows which I shoot. As the lad ran, he shot an arrow, causing it to pass over him.

title: I Samuel 20:37
text: And when the lad had come to the place of the arrow which Jonathan had shot, Jonathan cried after the lad and said, [Is] not the arrow beyond you?

title: I Samuel 20:38
text: And Jonathan cried after the lad, Hurry, make haste, do not stand. And Jonathan's lad gathered the arrow and came to his master.

title: I Samuel 20:39
text: But the lad did not know anything. Only Jonathan and David knew the matter.

title: I Samuel 20:40
text: And Jonathan gave his weapons to his lad and said to him, Go, bring [to] the city.

title: I Samuel 20:41
text: As soon as the lad had gone, David rose from the south, and fell on his face to the ground, and bowed himself three times. And they kissed one another, and wept with one another, until David exceeded.

title: I Samuel 20:42
text: And Jonathan said to David, Go in peace because we have both sworn in the name of the LORD, saying, The Lord shall be between me and you, and between my seed and your seed, forever. And he rose and went away. And Jonathan went [into] the city.

title: I Samuel 21:1
text: And David came to Nob, to Ahimelech the priest. And Ahimelech was afraid at the meeting of David, and said to him, Why [are] you alone, and no man with you?

title: I Samuel 21:2
text: And David said to Ahimelech the priest, The king has commanded me a business and has said to me, Let no man know anything [of] the business about which I send you, and what I have sent you. And I have sent servants to such and such a place.

title: I Samuel 21:3
text: And therefore, what is under your hand? Give five [loaves] of bread in my hand, or what there is to be found.

title: I Samuel 21:4
text: And the priest answered David and said, [There is] no common bread under my hand, but there is holy bread if the young men have kept themselves at least from women.

title: I Samuel 21:5
text: And David answered the priest and said to him, Truly women [have been] kept from us for about three days, since I came out, and the vessels of the young men are holy, and [in] a way the holy [bread] is common. Also surely today it is sanctified in the vessels.

title: I Samuel 21:6
text: And the priest gave him holy [bread]. For there was no bread there but the Bread of the Presence that was taken from before the LORD, in order to put hot bread in on the day when it was taken away.

title: I Samuel 21:7
text: And a man from the servants of Saul [was] there that day, held before the LORD. And his name [was] Doeg, an Edomite, the chief of Saul's herdsmen.

title: I Samuel 21:8
text: And David said to Ahimelech, And is there not here under your hand spear or sword? For I have not brought my sword nor my weapons with me, because the king's business needed haste.

title: I Samuel 21:9
text: And the priest said, The sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom you killed in the valley of Elah, behold, it [is] wrapped in a cloth under the ephod, if you will take, take it for yourself, for there is no other here except that one. And David said, There is none like that. Give it to me.

title: I Samuel 21:10
text: And David arose and fled that day for fear of Saul, and went to Achish the king of Gath.

title: I Samuel 21:11
text: And the servants of Achish said to him, [Is] not this David the king of the land? Did they not sing to one another of him in dances, saying, Saul has slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands?

title: I Samuel 21:12
text: And David laid up these words in his heart, and was very much afraid of Achish the king of Gath.

title: I Samuel 21:13
text: And he changed his behavior before them, and pretended himself to be mad in their hands, and marked on the doors of the gate and let his spittle fall down on his beard.

title: I Samuel 21:14
text: Then Achish said to his servants, Lo, you see the man is mad. Why have you brought him to me?

title: I Samuel 21:15
text: Do I have need of mad men, that you have brought this one to show madness in my presence? Shall this one come into my house?

title: I Samuel 22:1
text: And David left there and escaped to the cave Adullam. And his brothers and all his father's house heard, and went down to him there.

title: I Samuel 22:2
text: And every man in distress, and every man who had a creditor, and every man bitter of soul, gathered themselves to him. And he became commander over them. And about four hundred men were with him.

title: I Samuel 22:3
text: And David went from there to Mizpeh of Moab. And he said to the king of Moab, Please let my father and my mother come forth [and be] with you until I know what God will do for me.

title: I Samuel 22:4
text: And he brought them before the king of Moab. And they lived with him all the time that David was in the stronghold.

title: I Samuel 22:5
text: And the prophet Gad said to David, Do not stay in the stronghold. Leave and go into the land of Judah. And David left and came into the forest of Hareth.

title: I Samuel 22:6
text: And Saul heard that David and the men with him had been discovered. And Saul was staying in Gibeah under the tamarisk tree in Ramah, having his spear in his hand. And all his servants were standing about him.

title: I Samuel 22:7
text: And Saul said to his servants standing by him, Now hear, Benjamites, will the son of Jesse give to any of you fields and vineyards, [and] make you all commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds?

title: I Samuel 22:8
text: But all of you have conspired against me, and none of you was revealing [in] my ear when my son cut [a covenant] with the son of Jesse? And not one of you is sorry for me, even [to] reveal in my ear that my son has stirred up my servant against me, to lie in wait, as today.

title: I Samuel 22:9
text: And answered Doeg the Edomite, who was set over the servants of Saul, and said, I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob, to Ahimelech the son of Ahitub.

title: I Samuel 22:10
text: And he asked of the LORD for him and gave him food and gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine.

title: I Samuel 22:11
text: And the king sent to call Ahimelech the priest, the son of Ahitub, and all his father's house, the priests in Nob. And they came, all of them, to the king.

title: I Samuel 22:12
text: And Saul said, Hear now, you son of Ahitub. And he answered, Here I [am], my lord.

title: I Samuel 22:13
text: And Saul said to him, Why have you conspired against me, you and the son of Jesse, in that you have given him bread and a sword, and have asked of God for him, that he should rise against me to lie in wait, as at this day?

title: I Samuel 22:14
text: And Ahimelech answered the king and said, And who [is so] faithful among all your servants as David, who is the king's son-in-law, and [who] goes at your bidding, and who is honorable in your house?

title: I Samuel 22:15
text: Have I today begun to ask of God for him? Be it far from me. Do not let the king charge a thing to his servant, nor to all the house of my father. For your servant knew nothing of all this, more or less.

title: I Samuel 22:16
text: And the king said, Ahimelech, you shall surely die, you and all your father's house.

title: I Samuel 22:17
text: And the king said to the guard that stood around him, Turn and kill the priests of the LORD, because their hand also [is] with David, and because they knew when he fled, and did not reveal it to me. But the servants of the king would not put forth their hand to fall on the priests of the LORD.

title: I Samuel 22:18
text: And the king said to Doeg, You turn and fall on the priests. And Doeg the Edomite turned and fell on the priests. And on that day he killed eighty-five persons who wore a linen ephod.

title: I Samuel 22:19
text: And he struck Nob, the city of the priests, with the edge of the sword, both men and women, children and babes, and oxen, and asses, and sheep, with the edge of the sword.

title: I Samuel 22:20
text: And one of the sons of Ahimelech the son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped and fled after David.

title: I Samuel 22:21
text: And Abiathar told David that Saul had slain the LORD's priests.

title: I Samuel 22:22
text: And David said to Abiathar, I knew that day, when Doeg the Edomite [was] there, that he would surely tell Saul. I have caused the death of all the persons of your father's house.

title: I Samuel 22:23
text: Stay with me, and do not fear. For he who seeks my life seeks your life. But you [shall be] in safekeeping with me.

title: I Samuel 23:1
text: And they told David, saying, Behold, the Philistines fight against Keilah, and they rob the threshing-floors.

title: I Samuel 23:2
text: And David asked of the LORD, saying, Shall I go? And shall I strike these Philistines? And the LORD said to David, Go and strike the Philistines, and save Keilah.

title: I Samuel 23:3
text: And David's men said to him, Behold, we are afraid here in Judah. How much more then if we come to Keilah against the armies of the Philistines?

title: I Samuel 23:4
text: And David inquired of the LORD once again. And the LORD answered him and said, Arise, go down [to] Keilah. For I will deliver the Philistines into your hand.

title: I Samuel 23:5
text: And David and his men went to Keilah and fought with the Philistines. And they led away their cattle and struck them with a great slaughter. And David saved the people of Keilah.

title: I Samuel 23:6
text: And it happened when Abiathar the son of Ahimelech fled [to] David to Keilah, he came down [with] an ephod in his hand.

title: I Samuel 23:7
text: And it was told Saul that David had come to Keilah. And Saul said, God has delivered him into my hands, for he is shut in by entering into a town that has gates and bars.

title: I Samuel 23:8
text: And Saul [called] all the people together to war, to go down [to] Keilah to besiege David and his men.

title: I Samuel 23:9
text: And David knew that Saul secretly planned evil against him. And [he] said to Abiathar the priest, Bring the ephod here.

title: I Samuel 23:10
text: And David said, O Lord God of Israel, Your servant has surely heard that Saul seeks to come to Keilah, to destroy the city for my sake.

title: I Samuel 23:11
text: Will the men of Keilah deliver me up into his hand? Will Saul come down as Your servant has heard? O LORD God of Israel, I beg of You, tell Your servant. And the LORD said, He will come down.

title: I Samuel 23:12
text: And David said, Will the men of Keilah shut up me and my men into the hand of Saul? And the LORD said, They will shut [you up].

title: I Samuel 23:13
text: And David and his men, about six hundred, arose and departed out of Keilah and went wherever they could go. And it was told to Saul that David had escaped from Keilah. And he did not go forth.

title: I Samuel 23:14
text: And David stayed in the wilderness in strongholds, and remained in the stronghold in the wilderness of Ziph. And Saul looked for him every day, but God did not deliver him into his hand.

title: I Samuel 23:15
text: And David saw that Saul had come out to seek his life. And David [was] in the wilderness of Ziph in a woods.

title: I Samuel 23:16
text: And Jonathan, Saul's son, arose and went to David into the woods, and strengthened his hand in God.

title: I Samuel 23:17
text: And he said to him, Do not fear, for the hand of Saul my father shall not find you. And you shall be king over Israel, and I shall be next to you. And my father Saul knows that also.

title: I Samuel 23:18
text: And the two of them cut a covenant before the LORD. And David stayed in the forest, and Jonathan went to his house.

title: I Samuel 23:19
text: And the men of Ziph came up to Saul, to Gibeah, saying, Does not David hide himself with us in strongholds in the forest, in the hill of Hachilah, which [is] on the south of the wilderness?

title: I Samuel 23:20
text: And now, O king, come down according to all the desire of your soul. Come down, and it is for us to shut him up into the king's hand.

title: I Samuel 23:21
text: And Saul said, Blessed [are] you from the LORD, for you have pity on me.

title: I Samuel 23:22
text: Please go, make more sure, and know and see the place where his foot is. Who has seen him there? For I am told that he is very subtle.

title: I Samuel 23:23
text: And see and know of all the hiding places where he hides himself there, and return to me prepared. And I will go with you. And it shall be, if he is in the land, I will search him out throughout all the thousands of Judah.

title: I Samuel 23:24
text: And they arose and went to Ziph before Saul. But David and his men [were] in the wilderness of Maon, in the plain, on the south of the desert.

title: I Samuel 23:25
text: Saul and his men also went to look [for him]. And they told David. And he came down from the rock and stayed in the wilderness of Maon. And when Saul heard, he followed after David in the wilderness of Maon.

title: I Samuel 23:26
text: And Saul went on this side of the mountain, and David and his men on that side of the mountain. And David hurried to get away before Saul. For Saul and his men were encircling David and his men, to take them.

title: I Samuel 23:27
text: And a messenger came to Saul, saying, Hurry and come! For the Philistines have invaded the land.

title: I Samuel 23:28
text: And Saul returned from pursuing David, and went against the Philistines. Therefore they called that place, The Rock of the Division.

title: I Samuel 23:29
text: And David went up from there and stayed in strongholds [at] Engedi.

title: I Samuel 24:1
text: And it happened when Saul had returned from following the Philistines, they told him, saying, Behold, David [is] in the wilderness of Engedi.

title: I Samuel 24:2
text: And Saul took three thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and went to seek David and his men on the front of the rocks of the wild goats.

title: I Samuel 24:3
text: And he came to the folds of the flock on the way, where there [was] a cave. And Saul went in to cover his feet. And David and his men remained in the sides of the cave.

title: I Samuel 24:4
text: And the men of David said to him, Behold, this is the day of which the LORD said to you, Behold, I will deliver your enemy into your hand so that you may do to him as it shall seem good to you. And David arose and cut off the skirt of Saul's robe secretly.

title: I Samuel 24:5
text: And it happened afterward David's heart struck him because he had cut off Saul's skirt.

title: I Samuel 24:6
text: And he said to his men, Far be it from me, by the LORD, if I will do this thing to my lord, the LORD's anointed, to stretch forth my hand against him, since he is the anointed of the LORD.

title: I Samuel 24:7
text: And David held back his men with words, and did not allow them to rise against Saul. And Saul rose up out of the cave and went on [his] way.

title: I Samuel 24:8
text: And David arose afterward and went out of the cave, and cried after Saul, saying, My lord the king! And Saul looked behind him. And David bowed his face to the earth and prostrated himself.

title: I Samuel 24:9
text: And David said to Saul, Why do you hear man's words, saying, Behold, David seeks to do you evil?

title: I Samuel 24:10
text: Behold, your eyes have seen today how the LORD had delivered you today into my hand in the cave. And [one] said to kill you. But [I] had pity on you. And I said, I will not put forth my hand against my lord, for he is the LORD's anointed.

title: I Samuel 24:11
text: And, my father, behold! Yes, see the skirt of your robe in my hand. For in that I cut off the skirt of your robe and did not kill you, know and see that [there is] neither evil nor transgression in my hand, and I have not sinned against you. Yet you hunt my soul to take it.

title: I Samuel 24:12
text: May the LORD judge between me and you, and may the LORD avenge me of you. But my hand shall not be on you.

title: I Samuel 24:13
text: As the ancient proverb says, Wickedness proceeds from the wicked. But my hand shall not be on you.

title: I Samuel 24:14
text: After whom has the king of Israel come out? After whom do you pursue? After a dead dog? After a flea?

title: I Samuel 24:15
text: May the LORD therefore be judge, and judge between you and me, and see, and plead my cause, and deliver me out of your hand.

title: I Samuel 24:16
text: And it happened when David had made an end of speaking these words to Saul, Saul said, [Is] this your voice, my son David? And Saul lifted up his voice and wept.

title: I Samuel 24:17
text: And he said to David, You [are] more righteous than I, for you have rewarded me with good, but I have rewarded you evil.

title: I Samuel 24:18
text: And you have shown this day how you have dealt well with me, because when the LORD shut me up into your hand, you did not kill me.

title: I Samuel 24:19
text: For if a man finds his enemy, will he let him go completely away? And may the LORD reward good for what you have done to me this day.

title: I Samuel 24:20
text: And now, behold, I know well that you shall surely be king, and that the kingdom of Israel shall he established in your hand.

title: I Samuel 24:21
text: And swear therefore to me before the LORD that you will not cut off my seed after me, and that you will not destroy my name out of my father's house.

title: I Samuel 24:22
text: And David swore to Saul. And Saul went home, but David and his men went up into the hold.

title: I Samuel 25:1
text: And Samuel died. And all the Israelites were gathered, and lamented him and buried him in his house at Ramah. And David arose and went down to the wilderness of Paran.

title: I Samuel 25:2
text: And a certain man [was] in Maon, and his work [was] in Carmel. And the man [was] very great, and [had] three thousand sheep and a thousand goats. And he was shearing his sheep in Carmel.

title: I Samuel 25:3
text: And the man's name [was] Nabal, and his wife's name [was] Abigail. And [she was] a woman of good understanding, and of a beautiful form. But the man [was] cruel and evil in his dealings. And he [was] of Caleb.

title: I Samuel 25:4
text: And David heard in the wilderness that Nabal was shearing his sheep.

title: I Samuel 25:5
text: And David sent out ten young men. And David said to the young men, Go up to Carmel and go to Nabal, and greet him in my name.

title: I Samuel 25:6
text: And you shall say this, Long life and peace [be] to you, and peace to your house, and peace to all that you have.

title: I Samuel 25:7
text: And now I have heard that you have shearers. And we did not hurt your shepherds who were with us; neither was there anything missing to them all the while they were in Carmel.

title: I Samuel 25:8
text: Ask your young men, and they will tell you. And let the young men find favor in your eyes, for we come in a good day. Please give whatever comes to your hand to your servants and to your son David.

title: I Samuel 25:9
text: And David's young men came, they spoke to Nabal according to all these words in the name of David, and stopped.

title: I Samuel 25:10
text: And Nabal answered David's servants and said, Who [is] David? And who [is] the son of Jesse? The servants who have broken away, each man from his master, have multiplied.

title: I Samuel 25:11
text: Shall I then take my bread and my water and my meat that I have killed for my shearers, and give [it] to men about whom I know not where they come from?

title: I Samuel 25:12
text: And David's young men turned their way and went again, and came and told him all those things.

title: I Samuel 25:13
text: And David said to his men, Let each man gird on his sword. And they each one girded on his sword, and David also girded on his sword. And about four hundred men went up after David, and two hundred stayed by the stuff.

title: I Samuel 25:14
text: And one of the young men told Abigail, Nabal's wife, saying, Behold! David sent messengers out of the wilderness to greet our master, and he screamed at them.

title: I Samuel 25:15
text: But the men [were] very good to us, and we were not hurt, neither did we miss anything as long as we were going to and fro among them, when we were in the fields.

title: I Samuel 25:16
text: They were a wall to us both by night and day all the while we were with them keeping the sheep.

title: I Samuel 25:17
text: And now know and consider what you will do, for evil is determined against our master and against all his household. For he [is] a son of worthlessness, so that none can speak to him.

title: I Samuel 25:18
text: And Abigail made haste and took two hundred loaves, and two skins of wine, and five sheep ready dressed, and five measures of roasted [grain], and a hundred clusters of raisins, and laid them on asses.

title: I Samuel 25:19
text: And she said to her servants, Go on before me. Behold, I am coming after you. But she did not tell her husband Nabal.

title: I Samuel 25:20
text: And it happened, she was riding on the ass and coming down under cover of the mountain. And behold, David and his men came down across from her. And she met them.

title: I Samuel 25:21
text: And David had said, Surely in vain I have kept all that belongs to this fellow in the wilderness, so that nothing was missed of all that [was] his. And he has requited me evil for good.

title: I Samuel 25:22
text: So and more also may God do to the enemies of David, if I leave to the light of the morning any that [is] his of one who urinates against the wall.

title: I Samuel 25:23
text: And Abigail saw David and hurried and dismounted from the ass, and fell before David on her face, and bowed herself to the ground.

title: I Samuel 25:24
text: And she fell at his feet and said, On me, my lord, [on] me let this iniquity [be]. And please let your handmaid speak in your ears, and hear the words of your handmaid.

title: I Samuel 25:25
text: Please do not let my lord regard this man of worthlessness, Nabal. For as his name [is], so he [is]. Nabal [is] his name, and foolishness [is] with him. And I, your handmaid, did not see the young men of my lord, whom you sent.

title: I Samuel 25:26
text: And now, my lord, [as] the LORD lives and [as] your soul lives, since the LORD has withheld you from coming to shed blood, and from avenging yourself with your own hand, now let your enemies, and those that seek to do evil to my lord, be as Nabal.

title: I Samuel 25:27
text: And now this blessing which your handmaid has brought to my lord, let it even be given to the young men who follow my lord.

title: I Samuel 25:28
text: Please forgive the trespass of your handmaid. For the LORD will certainly make a sure house for my lord, because my lord fights the battles of the LORD, and evil has not been found in you [all] your days.

title: I Samuel 25:29
text: Yet a man has risen to pursue you and to seek your soul. But the soul of my lord shall be bound in the bundle of life with the LORD your God. And the souls of your enemies, He shall sling them from the hollow of a sling.

title: I Samuel 25:30
text: And it shall be, when the LORD has done to my lord according to all the good that He has spoken concerning you, and commanded you to [be] ruler over Israel,

title: I Samuel 25:31
text: this shall be no stumbling to you, nor offence of heart to my lord, either that you have shed blood for nothing, or [that] my lord has delivered himself. And may the LORD deal well with my lord, and you remember your handmaid.

title: I Samuel 25:32
text: And David said to Abigail, Blessed [be] the LORD God of Israel, who sent you today to meet me.

title: I Samuel 25:33
text: And blessed [is] your advice, and blessed [are] you who have kept me from coming to shed blood today, and from delivering myself [with] my own hand.

title: I Samuel 25:34
text: And truly, [as] the LORD God of Israel lives, who has kept me back from doing evil to you, for unless you had hurried and come to meet me, surely there would not have been left to Nabal by the morning light one who urinates against the wall.

title: I Samuel 25:35
text: And David received from her hand that which she had brought him, and said to her, Go up in peace to your house. See, I have listened to your voice and have accepted your person.

title: I Samuel 25:36
text: And Abigail came to Nabal. And behold, he held a feast in his house like the feast of a king. And Nabal's heart [was] merry within him, for he [was] very drunk. And she did not tell him anything, more or less, until the morning light.

title: I Samuel 25:37
text: And it happened in the morning, when the wine had gone out of Nabal and his wife had told him these things, his heart died within him and he became [like] a stone.

title: I Samuel 25:38
text: And it happened about ten days [afterward] the LORD struck Nabal so that he died.

title: I Samuel 25:39
text: And David heard that Nabal had died, and he said, Blessed [is] the LORD who has pleaded the cause of my reproach from the hand of Nabal, and has kept His servant from evil. For the LORD has returned the wickedness of Nabal on his own head. And David sent and spoke with Abigail, to take her to him for a wife.

title: I Samuel 25:40
text: And David's servants came to Abigail at Carmel, and spoke to her, saying, David sent us to you to take you to him for a wife.

title: I Samuel 25:41
text: And she arose and bowed herself on [her] face to the earth, and said, Behold, [let] your handmaid be a servant to wash the feet of the servants of my lord.

title: I Samuel 25:42
text: And Abigail hurried and arose, and rode on an ass, with five of her maidens who went after her. And she followed the messengers of David and became his wife.

title: I Samuel 25:43
text: David also took Ahinoam of Jezreel. And they became, both of them, his wives.

title: I Samuel 25:44
text: And Saul gave his daughter Michal, David's wife, to Phalti the son of Laish, who [was] of Gallim.

title: I Samuel 26:1
text: And the Ziphites came to Saul at Gibeah, saying, Is not David hiding himself in the hill of Hachilah, on the edge of the desert?

title: I Samuel 26:2
text: And Saul arose and went down to the wilderness of Ziph to seek David in the wilderness of Ziph, having three thousand chosen men of Israel with him.

title: I Samuel 26:3
text: And Saul pitched in the hill of Hachilah, which [is] on the edge of the desert, by the highway. And David was staying in the wilderness. And he saw that Saul came after him into the wilderness.

title: I Samuel 26:4
text: And David sent out spies and knew that Saul had come indeed.

title: I Samuel 26:5
text: And David arose and came to the place where Saul had pitched. And David saw the place where Saul lay. And Abner the son of Ner, the captain of his army, and Saul were lying within the barricade. And the people pitched all around him.

title: I Samuel 26:6
text: And David answered and said to Ahimelech the Hittite, and to Abishai the son of Zeruiah, the brother of Joab, saying, Who will go down with me to the camp to Saul? And Abishai said, I will go down with you.

title: I Samuel 26:7
text: So David and Abishai came to the people by night. And behold, Saul lay sleeping in the tent, and his spear stuck in the ground at his head. But Abner and the people lay around him.

title: I Samuel 26:8
text: And Abishai said to David, God has shut up your enemy into your hand this day. And please let me strike him with the spear even to the earth at once, and I will not repeat [it] to him.

title: I Samuel 26:9
text: And David said to Abishai, Do not destroy him. For who can stretch forth his hand against the LORD's anointed and be guiltless?

title: I Samuel 26:10
text: And David said, [As] the LORD lives, except the LORD strike him, or his day shall come, and he dies, or he goes down to battle and is consumed,

title: I Samuel 26:11
text: far be it from me by the LORD, from putting forth my hand against the LORD's anointed. And now, please take the spear at his head and the cruse of water, and we will go.

title: I Samuel 26:12
text: And David took the spear and the cruse of water from Saul's head. And they went away, and no one saw, and no one knew; and no one was awake; for all of them [were] sleeping, because a deep sleep [from] the LORD had fallen on them.

title: I Samuel 26:13
text: And David went over [to] the other side and stood on the top of a hill afar off, a great space between them.

title: I Samuel 26:14
text: And David cried to the people and to Abner the son of Ner, saying, Do you not answer, Abner? And Abner answered and said, Who [are] you that cries to the king?

title: I Samuel 26:15
text: And David said to Abner, [Are] you not a man? And who is like you in Israel? But why have you not watched over your lord the king? For one of the people came in to destroy your lord the king.

title: I Samuel 26:16
